draft.rationale: As a cavalry family, their movement is defined by a coordinated, overwhelming advance. This action enables the 'Blighted Reckoning' effect by ensuring targets are afflicted with rot through their sweeping, rhythmic momentum.

draft.flavor: The enemy is showered in a flurry of heavy, gilded kernels that strike with the weight of wealth, coating the battlefield in a slick, buttery sheen.
draft.name: Golden Harvest
draft.rationale: The action describes the 'throwing' (投出) of 'corn kernels' (玉米粒) that resemble 'coins' (钱币) and 'contain' (含有) a layer of 'butter' (黄油), triggering the Butter Seal effect.

draft.flavor: The family scatters a rich, buttery bounty that enriches the soil and the coffers alike.
draft.name: Golden Yield
draft.rationale: The action involves throwing (投出) a scattering of golden, buttery (黄油) kernels (玉米粒) that contain (含有) wealth (钱币), acting as a support mechanism to bolster allies through economic or resource-based growth (atom.econ-muster) and applying a coating (atom.buttering).

draft.flavor: A sudden burst of wealth and sustenance, showering the battlefield in a flurry of precious grains.
draft.name: Golden Scatter
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's ability to scatter wealth and sustenance. It incorporates the motif of throwing (投出) golden grains (玉米粒) that contain (含有) butter (黄油) and currency (钱币), manifesting as a status effect that grants economic bounty (midas/econ-toll) and the buttering status (buttering).

draft.flavor: The chronobotanical cycle does not merely pass; it strikes with the weight of seasons compressed into a single, inevitable moment.
draft.name: Temporal Bloom
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'freezing' enabler to set up the 'chill-punisher' payoff. It expresses the family's mastery over time (回溯/超时空) by manifesting a sudden, heavy surge of seasonal force (力量) that punishes those caught in its frost.

draft.flavor: The chronobotanical essence ripples, pulling the immediate past into the present to mend what was lost.
draft.name: Temporal Recurrence
draft.rationale: As a defense mechanism for the chronobotanical family, this action utilizes '回溯' (Retrace/Backtrack) to trigger 'atom.regeneration', restoring vitality by reverting the self to a previous state of health.

draft.flavor: The chronobotanical pulse ripples through the lineage, anchoring the present to the vitality of the past.
draft.name: Temporal Bloom
draft.rationale: The action utilizes '回溯' (reversion/backtracking) and '超时空' (spacetime) by restoring health to allies based on the vitality of the lineage, effectively 'reversing' recent damage. It expresses '力量' (strength/power) through the magnitude of the restoration and '传送' (teleportation/displacement) via the non-local application of healing across the multi-target ally group. The '咬者' (biter/consumer) motif is represented by the consumption of temporal energy to fuel the restorative surge.

draft.flavor: The chronobotanical essence anchors the target's timeline, forcing their essence to bloom and wither in a recursive cycle of decay.
draft.name: Temporal Rooting
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'chronobotanical' nature by applying a status that links the target's current state to a previous moment (回溯/Temporal), using the strength of growth (力量/Power) to inflict a biting, parasitic decay (咬者/Biter) that transcends standard time (超时空/Spacetime) by shifting the target's position in the combat sequence (传送/Translocation).

draft.flavor: The clover's petals harden into jagged ice, shattering upon impact to freeze the very air around the foe.
draft.name: Frost-Bitten Thicket
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a freezing effect on the enemy, setting up the specific payoff for the chill-punisher atom family.

draft.flavor: The clover's leaves thicken and crystallize, turning every impact into a freezing catalyst.
draft.name: Frost-Grafting
draft.rationale: The action applies a chilling effect to the target, serving as the necessary enabler for the chill-punisher pairing by ensuring targets are frozen for subsequent damage multipliers.

draft.flavor: The clover's essence spreads, nourishing the roots of those who stand together.
draft.name: Triple-Leaf Bloom
draft.rationale: The action provides a payoff for rot-punisher by ensuring that targets afflicted by the enabler families (bloodletting, sporing, venomous, withering) are more susceptible to the rot-punisher's bonus damage, effectively blooming the potential of the clover family's support role.

draft.flavor: The clover's essence surges through its stems, preparing the ground for a more devastating rot.
draft.name: Triple-Leaf Sprouting
draft.rationale: The action facilitates the 'rot-punisher' motif by ensuring the target is afflicted with rot, thereby enabling the bonus damage. It represents the growth and spreading nature of the clover family through a movement-based roll that sets up the offensive synergy.

draft.flavor: The target is branded by a three-lobed sigil, leaving them vulnerable to the family's growing influence.
draft.name: Triple Leaf Mark
draft.rationale: The clover motif is expressed through the 'marking' atom, which applies a status to the enemy. This action is a mid-tier status application that defines the family's ability to tag targets for future interactions.

draft.flavor: The colony erupts in a sudden, blooming cloud of fungal spores, saturating the air to ensure the rot takes hold.
draft.name: Spore Burst
draft.rationale: The action describes the formation and sudden eruption (mushrooming/spore burst) of a fungal cloud that spreads (diffusion) across the target area, fulfilling the family's core identity of spreading spores.

draft.flavor: Upon being struck, the colony releases a cloud of spores that settles upon the aggressor, chilling their blood and preparing them for the harvest.
draft.name: Spore Cloud
draft.rationale: The action describes a defensive release (spore burst/diffusion) that forms a cloud around the user, applying a chill effect to the attacker to enable the 'chill-punisher' pairing.

draft.flavor: The colony spreads its influence, forming a network of fungal growth that empowers its kin.
draft.name: Spore Colony Expansion
draft.rationale: The action triggers a spore burst (喷菇) that spreads (扩散) across the area, forming (形成) a fungal network (蘑菇) that provides support to allies, specifically acting as the payoff for rot-punisher by amplifying the presence of afflictions.

draft.flavor: The colony releases a cloud of fungal spores that settles upon the battlefield, ensuring that any wound inflicted carries the weight of decay.
draft.name: Spore Dispersal
draft.rationale: The action describes the collective movement of the colony to spread spores (扩散/喷菇) which then form (形成) a layer of fungal growth (蘑菇) on the target. By applying both Spore Burst and Soft Rot, it fulfills the requirement of being an enabler for Rot Punisher by ensuring targets are both infested and rotting.

draft.flavor: Upon impact, the colony releases a cloud of fungal matter that settles into the earth and spreads across the battlefield.
draft.name: Spore Proliferation
draft.rationale: The action describes the characteristic behavior of the family: releasing spores (喷菇/mushroom) that form (形成) new growths (蘑菇) which spread (扩散) across the area of effect.

draft.flavor: The frozen remains of the fallen release a biting chill upon those who dare strike them.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a reaction against an enemy. It utilizes the 'freezing' family to enable the 'chill-punisher' payoff, creating a cycle where being struck by a frozen enemy results in a retaliatory frost-based strike.

draft.flavor: The fallen are not lost, but repurposed to fuel the hunger of the swarm.
draft.name: Carrion Feast
draft.rationale: As a support action for the 'colossus' family (the undead/zombie motif), this action provides a payoff for the 'Blighted Reckoning' (rot-punisher) mechanic. It targets allies to bolster them, specifically scaling with the presence of afflicted targets to ensure the swarm's survival and continued aggression.

draft.flavor: The fallen do not rest; they rise to serve the hunger of the swarm.
draft.name: Necrotic Reanimation
draft.rationale: The family action focuses on the core identity of the 'zombie' motif: the ability to turn death into more of the same. By utilizing 'Summoner' and 'Gravemaking', the action ensures that every member of the family contributes to the growing horde through the creation of new entities or markers of their presence upon death or impact.

draft.flavor: The front line converges into a single, overwhelming presence, channeling the essence of the collective to shatter frozen defenses.
draft.name: Subspecies Unification
draft.rationale: The action targets enemies from the front line, utilizing the collective strength of the subspecies to deliver a crushing blow that scales with the presence of frost, effectively turning a defensive status into an offensive payoff.

draft.flavor: The collective presence of the lineage vibrates in unison, hardening the very air around the vanguard to ensure the frost takes hold.
draft.name: Subspecies Resonance
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'sust-callus' to provide the defensive 'self' relation (gaining a shield when struck) and 'chilling' to enable the target's vulnerability to 'chill-punisher'. It represents the family's shared ability to act as a defensive front-line (前排) that simultaneously prepares the battlefield for their kin (一体/亚种) through a pungent, defensive aura (大蒜/兼具).

draft.flavor: The front line surges forward, leaving a trail of infectious rot in their wake.
draft.name: Spore Advance
draft.rationale: The action enables rot-punisher by ensuring the front line (前排) moves in unison (一体) to spread spores (sporing/亚种) while maintaining a sturdy, collective presence (resilience/arm-hardening/vitality) that combines movement with status application (兼具/大蒜).

draft.flavor: The front line exhales a thick, stinging cloud that binds the enemy to their fate.
draft.name: Pungent Vanguard
draft.rationale: The action targets the front line (前排) with a pungent, garlic-like (大蒜) miasma. It is a unified (一体) status effect that is both offensive and defensive (兼具), applying an affliction (atom.affliction) that entangles (atom.entangling) the enemy while simultaneously bolstering the resilience (atom.resilience) of the family's sub-species (亚种).

draft.flavor: The combustion family draws in the surrounding heat, converting the very friction of conflict into a protective shroud of warmth.
draft.name: Thermal Absorption
draft.rationale: The action allows the combustion family to absorb incoming energy (吸纳) to fuel a self-sustaining thermal layer (取暖) that cycles through repeated pulses (反复) to bolster their defensive integrity.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic surge of heat and pressure that feeds the flame and drives the swarm forward.
draft.name: Combustion Resurgence
draft.rationale: This action functions as a multi-target support mechanism that cycles through the combustion family's core traits. It absorbs the potency of existing afflictions (吸纳) to fuel a rhythmic, repeating burst (反复) of thermal energy. This energy is projected outward (喷射) to bolster allies (号令), providing them with a protective warmth (取暖) that adapts to the specific biological or elemental sub-types (亚种) present in the fray.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic expulsion of heat that fuels the spreading blight.
draft.name: Combustion Surge
draft.rationale: The action describes a repetitive, rhythmic expulsion (喷射, 反复) of elemental energy (吸如/吸纳) that serves as a command (号令) to spread the rot, while simultaneously providing a thermal byproduct (取暖) that empowers the various subspecies (亚种) within the combustion family. It acts as a mid-tier movement-based enabler for rot-punisher by priming targets with elemental surge.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic expulsion of heat that draws in the surrounding cold to fuel a violent, repeating discharge.
draft.name: Thermal Surge
draft.rationale: The action represents the combustion family's core cycle: absorbing ambient energy (吸纳/取暖), cycling through internal variations (亚种), and releasing it in rhythmic, commanded bursts (喷射/反复/号令). By using elemental power surge/surfeit/overflow, the action scales the magnitude of the thermal release without using specific numbers.

draft.flavor: The commander signals the charge, ensuring that no matter the resistance, the momentum of the kin remains unbroken and the strike finds its mark.
draft.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
draft.rationale: The action empowers the commander to lead the family into a decisive engagement. By leveraging the synergy between freezing and the subsequent punishment of chilled targets, the commander ensures the family's collective assault is both relentless and devastatingly effective against the enemy.

draft.flavor: The commander's presence binds the lineage, ensuring that as one falls, the collective thrives.
draft.name: 一族
draft.rationale: The action provides a payoff for rot-punisher by amplifying the effectiveness of the affliction against allies of the same lineage, fulfilling the 'one family' requirement through a shared structural benefit.

draft.flavor: The collective strength of the lineage flows through the commander, ensuring no single blow can break the bond of the many.
draft.name: 一族の誓い
draft.rationale: The action provides a shared defensive status (Resilience and Arm-hardening) that scales with the presence of the family, embodying the 'one clan' (一族) motif by strengthening the whole through the commander's presence, ensuring they do not fail (不负) their duty in the battle (一战).

draft.flavor: The commander repositions their influence, turning the battlefield into a grid of inevitable strikes where every movement serves a grander strategy of attrition and dominance.
draft.name: Nine Palaces Gambit
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'Nine Palaces' (九宫) motif to establish a structural grid for the 'attack' on the 'self' (repositioning/fortifying), while the 'subordinate' (下属) and 'struggle' (争夺) motifs drive the 'payoff' for freezing targets. It functions as a strategic setup that enables the 'Frost Reckoning' (atom.chill-punisher) by ensuring the enemy is trapped within the commander's tactical geometry.

draft.flavor: The commander positions their subordinates to contest the board, creating a defensive grid that punishes those who attempt to break the line.
draft.name: Nine Palaces Formation
draft.rationale: The action uses the 'Nine Palaces' (九宫) and 'Chinese Chess' (中国象棋) motifs to establish a defensive grid. It utilizes 'Subordinates' (下属) to create a zone of 'Contention' (争夺) that prevents enemies from 'Staying' (不住) within the formation. By applying 'Evade' (atom.evd-shift), the commander ensures the unit's positioning makes them difficult to pin down, acting as a defensive enabler for freezing effects.

draft.flavor: The commander repositions their forces to seize the advantage, forcing the opponent to contend with a tightening perimeter.
draft.name: Strategic Encroachment
draft.rationale: The action facilitates movement to occupy critical positions (九宫/Chinese Chess) to facilitate the struggle for territory (争夺), effectively trapping or preventing the opponent from staying in place (不住) by leveraging the positioning of their subordinates (下属).

draft.flavor: The commander dictates the flow of the engagement, pinning the enemy within a tightening perimeter of influence.
draft.name: Strategic Encirclement
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'marking' to represent the strategic positioning and control of the board (九宫/Chinese Chess). By marking targets, the commander exerts influence over 'subordinates' (下属) and creates a state of 'struggle' (争夺) where the enemy cannot find stability or escape (不住).

draft.flavor: A sudden, freezing collision that shatters the warmth from the target.
draft.name: Frostbite Impact
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for freezing effects, dealing increased damage to targets already afflicted by cold, fulfilling the requirement of being a payoff for atom.chill-punisher while utilizing the enabler atom.freezing.

draft.flavor: A dense, frozen layer forms around the construct, turning incoming impacts into shattering kinetic energy.
draft.name: Frost-Hardened Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides resistance to element critical hits (evd-harden), which serves as a defensive enabler for the family's construct. It utilizes the 'nut' (坚果) and 'bullet' (子弹) motifs to describe the hardening/projectile nature of the defense, and the 'zombie' (僵尸) and 'damage' (伤害) motifs to ground the action in the family's core identity. The 'bowling ball' (保龄球) motif is expressed through the heavy, crushing nature of the defensive shell.

draft.flavor: A sudden burst of corrosive projectiles that accelerates the spread of rot among the fallen.
draft.name: Blighted Volley
draft.rationale: The action provides a multi-target payoff for the rot-punisher atom by firing a volley of bullets that applies or amplifies the rot status, fulfilling the support role of enabling the family's offensive potential through damage and status application.

draft.flavor: A sudden, heavy collision that shatters the target's composure and leaves them vulnerable to the coming onslaught.
draft.name: Impactful Rupture
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the 'damage' and 'zombie' motifs by ensuring that upon the death of a member, a burst of force is released. This represents the kinetic, heavy-hitting nature of the family's constructs (like bowling balls or bullets) without specifying a single species or using forbidden anti-motifs.

draft.flavor: The collective essence of the family converges into a singular, unstoppable force, consuming the very fabric of reality to ensure nothing remains of the opposition.
draft.name: World-Binding Onslaught
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's ability to unify their essence (一体) to construct (制成) a grand (伟大) phenomenon that reshapes the world (世界), leaving nothing (不剩) of the enemy behind, driven by the relentless advance of the undead (僵尸). It acts as the payoff for chilling effects by turning the frozen state into a totalizing destruction.

draft.flavor: As the world is consumed, the remains are processed into a singular, unbreaking shell that refuses to leave anything behind.
draft.name: The Unyielding World-Husk
draft.rationale: The action utilizes atom.sust-husk to provide a defensive shield upon being struck, embodying the 'one body' (一体) and 'processed' (制成) nature of the family. It represents a 'great' (伟大) and 'world-encompassing' (世界) defense that ensures 'nothing is left' (不剩) of the original form, turning the 'undead' (僵尸) essence into a permanent, defensive structure.

draft.flavor: As the many become one, the rot spreads to ensure nothing remains of the old order.
draft.name: The Great Unification of the World
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's ability to consolidate the essence of the fallen into a singular, overwhelming force. By marking the world with their presence, they ensure that what is broken is repurposed into their collective whole, turning the remnants of the world into the very substance of their advancement.

draft.flavor: A singular, inevitable decay that consumes the world, turning every fallen remnant into a part of the whole.
draft.name: The Unifying Blight
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's ability to spread a pervasive, transformative rot that consumes everything in its path, ensuring that no part of the world remains untouched and all are integrated into the collective mass of the undead.

draft.flavor: The collective presence of the family weaves a singular, unstoppable reality where nothing remains of the old world, only the greatness of the whole.
draft.name: World-Forging Unity
draft.rationale: The action uses 'atom.summoner' to represent the family's ability to construct a new world from the remains of the old. By raising a collective of the fallen, they ensure that nothing of the previous state remains, turning the battlefield into a singular, unified entity of their own making.

draft.flavor: When the fallen rest, the living feast upon their memory to harden the shell.
draft.name: Grave-Eater's Bastion
draft.rationale: The action triggers upon the removal of a target, causing a tombstone to rise from the site. As the tombstone emerges, it draws in the essence of the fallen to swallow incoming threats, providing a defensive layer for the user.

draft.flavor: The consumer arrives to claim what was lost, turning the fallen into fuel and the living into monuments of their hunger.
draft.name: Grave-Eater's Consumption
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's core cycle: they arrive (来) to consume (吞噬) existing statuses or life (移除), leaving behind a marker of their passage (墓碑).

draft.flavor: A concentrated burst of sunlight channeled through a rapid succession of projectiles, turning the target into a scorched mark.
draft.name: Solar Flare Volley
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'Volley' atom to represent the rapid-fire 'bullet' motif and 'Elemental Power Surge' to manifest the 'sunlight' motif. As a payoff for 'Chill Punisher', this provides the necessary elemental buildup and offensive pressure required to facilitate the freezing/frost mechanics of the enabler family.

draft.flavor: The creature absorbs the brilliance of the sun, condensing it into a shimmering barrier that deflects incoming projectiles with blinding intensity.
draft.name: Solar Refraction
draft.rationale: The action uses '阳光' (sunlight) to create a defensive barrier that triggers '子弹' (bullets) via 'atom.hit-retort', reflecting projectiles back at the attacker. This serves as a mid-tier defensive enabler for 'atom.chill-punisher' by positioning the target for elemental retaliation.

draft.flavor: A radiant burst of light and lead that punishes the afflicted.
draft.name: Solar Salvo
draft.rationale: The action triggers when an ally is afflicted by the enabler families, releasing a burst of sunlight and projectiles to maximize the impact of rot-punishment.

draft.flavor: The creature propels itself through the air, trailing a streak of concentrated sunlight that strikes like a projectile.
draft.name: Solar Trajectory
draft.rationale: The action describes a movement-based trajectory (bullet/projectile) that utilizes solar energy (sunlight) to empower the user's state, serving as a mid-tier enabler for rot-punishment by ensuring the target is struck with high-intensity elemental force.

draft.flavor: A sudden burst of light and lead that marks the target for the coming dawn.
draft.name: Solar Volley
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'volley' to represent the bullet motif, 'marking' to represent the status effect on the enemy, and 'sunbloom' to incorporate the sunlight motif through the utility of the sun resource.

draft.flavor: The creature's surface hardens into a crystalline layer, absorbing the impact of strikes to fuel a sudden, freezing release.
draft.name: Frost-Bound Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer (Shield Surge/Sustained Husk) that absorbs incoming damage (Absorption/化险为夷) to create a protective area (Range/范围) around the user, specifically designed to enable the 'Frost Reckoning' pairing by ensuring the target remains in proximity and under status effects.

draft.flavor: The presence of the rot is not a sudden strike, but a lingering inevitability that feeds upon the very life it consumes.
draft.name: Sustained Decay
draft.rationale: As a support payoff for rot-based affliction, this action creates a localized area where the weight of existing ailments accelerates the consumption of vitality, turning the target's own decay into a source of sustenance for the family.

draft.flavor: The air thickens with a heavy, golden haze as the swarm moves, leaving a trail of lingering rot in their wake.
draft.name: Spore-Drift
draft.rationale: The action allows the family to release a wide area of spores (范围/出) that absorb essence from the environment (吸收) to mitigate incoming threats (化险为夷), specifically designed to prime targets for the rot-punisher effect.

draft.flavor: The ground erupts in jagged, frozen shards that pierce through the warmth of the living.
draft.name: Frostbite Spikes
draft.rationale: The action causes the user to erupt frozen spikes (地刺) from their own position, dealing damage to enemies via physical impact (触感) and potentially raising a frozen corpse (僵尸) to serve. This action serves as the perfect payoff for atom.chill-punisher, as it scales with the number of frozen targets present.

draft.flavor: The ground erupts in jagged, frozen shards that punish any movement through the frost.
draft.name: Permafrost Spikes
draft.rationale: The action creates a field of frozen spikes (地刺) that can be felt by those stepping through (触感), potentially raising the fallen (僵尸) or freezing them in place to enable the chill-punisher synergy.

draft.flavor: The frozen ground erupts in jagged, numbing spikes that feast upon the rot of the fallen.
draft.name: Frostbite Thorns
draft.rationale: The action creates jagged terrain (地刺) that reacts to the presence of the deceased (僵尸) and the sensation of being pierced (触感). It serves as a payoff for rot-punisher by amplifying the effectiveness of damage dealt to targets already suffering from decay.

draft.flavor: The ground erupts in jagged, freezing shards, leaving a trail of frozen earth that punishes those who stumble through it.
draft.name: Frostbite Spikes
draft.rationale: The action creates a movement-based area effect of jagged ice spikes (地刺) that provides a tactile, freezing sensation (触感) to any zombie (僵尸) passing through, applying a chill effect that enables the rot-punisher synergy.

draft.flavor: The ground erupts in jagged, frozen shards that pierce through the warmth of the living.
draft.name: Frostbite Spikes
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'chilling' to represent the cryo family's essence and 'terraforming' to manifest the '地刺' (ground spikes) motif. The '僵尸' (zombie) motif is integrated through the target's vulnerability to the frozen terrain, and '触感' (tactile sensation) is evoked by the sharp, piercing nature of the spikes.

draft.flavor: The crushing weight of a frozen vine shatters the spirit of the unwary.
draft.name: Frost-Bitten Harvest
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a payoff mechanism. By utilizing the freezing state, it sets up the conditions for a high-tier damage burst against frozen enemies, embodying the heavy, crushing nature of the family's thematic essence.

draft.flavor: The outer layer hardens and swells, absorbing the impact of a strike to prepare a frost-laden counter-burst.
draft.name: Thickened Rind
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer that, upon being struck, triggers a chilling effect, enabling the synergy with chill-punisher.

draft.flavor: The heavy, overripe essence of the vine seeps into the earth, turning every wound into a spreading rot.
draft.name: Blighted Harvest
draft.rationale: The action provides a payoff for the rot-punisher motif by amplifying the effectiveness of afflictions. As a member of the cucurbit family, the action focuses on the spreading, heavy, and transformative nature of their growth, turning an existing affliction into a source of increased damage for allies.

draft.flavor: The family expands its reach, leaving a trail of decay in its wake.
draft.name: Sprawl
draft.rationale: As a movement action for the cucurbit family, Sprawl describes the way they expand and roll across the terrain. By utilizing the rotting atom family, the movement itself becomes the enabler for rot-punisher, as the act of spreading ensures that targets are afflicted, thereby maximizing the effectiveness of subsequent rot-based strikes.

draft.flavor: The weight of the vine pulls the enemy into the soil.
draft.name: Overgrowth
draft.rationale: The cucurbit family is defined by rapid, sprawling growth and the release of seeds or spores to claim territory. This action applies a status to the enemy that represents being overtaken by the family's essence.

draft.flavor: The weight of accumulated wealth and the stability of precious metals manifest as a shimmering, impenetrable layer of protection.
draft.name: Gilded Preservation
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer of plating and shield capacity, representing the 'stability' and 'gold quality' of the family's essence. It 'brings' protection to the user, ensuring that even in the face of 'destruction', their structural integrity remains 'stable' and 'wealthy' in its resilience.

draft.flavor: The weight of wealth and the inevitability of ruin converge, turning every strike into a heavy, golden toll that stabilizes the cycle of destruction.
draft.name: Gilded Decay
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for rot-punisher by converting the entropy of blight into a stable, golden currency of destruction. It brings a heavy, metallic weight to the battlefield, ensuring that as targets succumb to decay, they leave behind a lasting, precious residue that reinforces the structural integrity of the user's presence.

draft.flavor: The weight of wealth meets the inevitability of ruin.
draft.name: Gilded Decay
draft.rationale: The action provides a stable foundation of wealth (gold/money) that, upon the inevitable destruction (ruin/decay) of the target, brings forth a devastating surge of power.

draft.flavor: The weight of prosperity becomes a crushing burden upon the fallen.
draft.name: Gilded Ruin
draft.rationale: The action manifests a status that brings (带来) a heavy, golden (金质) weight to the enemy. This weight provides stability (稳定) to the user's position while ensuring that the enemy's eventual destruction (毁灭) yields a significant bounty (金钱) from their remains.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic, sweeping motion that leaves a trail of frost in its wake, setting the stage for a shattering conclusion.
draft.name: The Choreographed Frost
draft.rationale: The action functions as a rhythmic setup (dancing/tempo) that applies a freezing effect to the target, which then triggers increased damage via the chill-punisher payoff.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic, chilling performance that leaves a trail of frost in its wake.
draft.name: The Frozen Waltz
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the family's shared ability to induce a chilling state, setting the stage for the 'Frost Reckoning' through a coordinated, rhythmic movement.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic, synchronized movement that marks the stage for the rot to take hold.
draft.name: The Grand Choreography
draft.rationale: The action functions as a rhythmic setup (the dance) that applies a blight (the mark) to the target, enabling the subsequent rot-punisher effect. It captures the essence of a coordinated performance that leaves a lasting, decaying impression.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic, synchronized display of movement that leaves a lasting impression on the battlefield.
draft.name: The Grand Performance
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Tempo Shift' to represent the rhythmic, choreographed nature of the family's movement (舞蹈学院/杰克逊). The 'status' category and 'enemy' relation are fulfilled by the rhythmic imposition of a tempo that affects the opposition. The 'mid tier' power is achieved through the structural axis of temporal manipulation.

draft.flavor: The target is consumed by a massive surge of tangled vegetation, absorbing the impact of the strike to fuel a sudden, violent expansion.
draft.name: Overgrowth Burst
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'sporing' to represent the 'plant' and 'mass' (大量) motifs. It functions as a 'payoff' for 'freezing' by dealing damage based on 'damage taken' (承伤) through a 'fusion' (融合) of the target's own physical state and the incoming spores, resulting in a 'nut-like' (坚果) hard impact.

draft.flavor: A dense, tangled layer of flora and hardened matter that absorbs the impact of blows to fuel a sudden, blooming resurgence.
draft.name: Overgrowth Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer (承伤) by merging (融合) a massive (大量) amount of plant (植物) matter and nut-like (坚果) shells into a protective coating that restores health or shields upon being struck.

draft.flavor: The debris of the family coalesces, merging organic matter and hard shells to mend the wounded.
draft.name: Nutrient Fusion
draft.rationale: This action fulfills the 'support' role by targeting allies to provide healing (mending/life-graft). It utilizes the 'fusion' (融合) of 'nut/shell' (坚果) and 'plant' (植物) motifs to represent the biological debris, and addresses 'damage taken' (承伤) by providing 'large amounts' (大量) of restoration to the group.

draft.flavor: The collective vitality of the grove surges forward, weaving through the wounded to fuel a sudden, overwhelming growth.
draft.name: Verdant Surge
draft.rationale: This movement action utilizes the 'Verdant Surge' to move the family toward targets. It integrates the 'Plant' and 'Massive' motifs by allowing the family to merge their vitality into a single forward momentum. It utilizes 'Damage Taken' as a catalyst, where the more the family absorbs, the more 'Plant' life is grafted onto them, enabling the 'Rot Punisher' by ensuring targets are heavily afflicted by the resulting spore-laden surge.

draft.flavor: The target's essence is absorbed into a dense, fibrous shell, merging their vitality with the surrounding growth to harden their very existence.
draft.name: Nutrient Fusion
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'bonding' (融合) to merge the target's state, 'sporing' (植物/大量) to spread the effect, 'sust-husk' (坚果/承伤) to create a protective shell that absorbs damage, and 'arm-hardening' (坚果/承伤) to provide the structural defense characteristic of the family's debris.

draft.flavor: A defensive formation that shatters into a flurry of precious, hard-edged projectiles, seeking out those who dare strike.
draft.name: Diamond Shell Volley
draft.rationale: The action uses 'volley' to represent the 'bullet' and 'flat shot' motifs, while 'arm-plate' provides the 'hard' and 'diamond' essence for a defensive family's counter-attack. It creates a 'surrounding' effect of 'rare' projectiles that 'attract' enemy attention through their defensive payoff.

draft.flavor: A hard, crystalline layer that draws in the heat of battle to fortify the core.
draft.name: Diamond Shell
draft.rationale: The action creates a defensive shell (around/diamond/hard) that absorbs incoming force to increase the effectiveness of the target's subsequent frost-based retaliation (enabling chill-punisher).

draft.flavor: The family draws sustenance from the very decay they sow, turning the rot of their enemies into a protective shell for their kin.
draft.name: Nutrient Draw
draft.rationale: This action serves as the payoff for atom.rot-punisher by converting the damage dealt to afflicted targets into a defensive resource. It uses the '吸引' (attraction/draw) motif to pull vitality from the rot, '友方' (ally) to apply the benefit to the army, and '坚果' (nut/shell) and '坚硬' (hard/sturdy) to manifest the result as a protective layer.

draft.flavor: A protective swarm of hard, dense fragments that circles the user, intercepting threats and striking back with concentrated force.
draft.name: Orbiting Shell
draft.rationale: The action creates a defensive perimeter of orbiting projectiles (子弹/围绕) that possess high density (坚硬). These fragments act as a shield (arm-plate/shld-surge) by drawing incoming fire toward them (吸引) and can discharge in a flat trajectory (平射) to apply status effects like rot to enemies.

draft.flavor: A defensive formation that draws the enemy's gaze toward a shimmering, impenetrable barrier.
draft.name: Diamond Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive status to all allies (友方) by creating a protective perimeter (围绕) that increases the army's overall defense (warding) and hardens their structural integrity (arm-hardening) while boosting their capacity to hold a barrier (shld-surge), manifesting as a diamond-like shell (钻石/坚硬) that attracts attention (吸引).

draft.flavor: The drupe radiates a prickly, celestial menace, launching star-shaped barbs that pierce through the air to threaten all nearby.
draft.name: Star-Spike Threat
draft.rationale: The action describes a self-centered burst of star-shaped (杨桃, 星星) spikes (仙人掌) that are launched (发射) as a threat (威胁) to enemies. By using elpw-surge, the action scales the potency of the elemental power being unleashed, fulfilling the mid-tier power requirement through structural scaling.

draft.flavor: A defensive array of celestial-patterned barbs that punishes the frozen.
draft.name: Star-Spined Thorns
draft.rationale: The action causes the creature to launch a star-shaped burst of cactus-like spines that threatens the attacker with a chilling effect, setting up the target for a frost-based retribution.

draft.flavor: A celestial barrage of prickly warnings that punishes the afflicted.
draft.name: Star-Spike Threat
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's ability to launch star-shaped, prickly projectiles that act as a threat to those already suffering from rot, venom, or blight.

draft.flavor: A sudden, prickly burst of celestial energy that marks the target for decay.
draft.name: Star-Spike Volley
draft.rationale: The action describes a rapid discharge (发射) of star-shaped (星星/杨桃) prickly projectiles (仙人掌) that serves as a threat (威胁) to the target, enabling the rot-punisher effect by ensuring multiple hits land to apply or trigger status effects.

draft.flavor: A sudden, jagged burst of celestial thorns that pierces through the air to threaten all nearby.
draft.name: Star-Spike Volley
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Volley' to represent the '发射' (launch/fire) motif and 'Marking' to represent the '威胁' (threat) motif. The 'Star' motif is expressed through the celestial nature of the projectiles. This applies to the entire family as a standard status-inflicting burst.

draft.flavor: A sudden, pressurized release of fungal clouds and necrotic essence that saturates the air.
draft.name: Spore Burst
draft.rationale: The action triggers a pressurized eruption (喷射) of fungal clouds (烟雾) and spores (喷菇) that fills (充满) the immediate area. This release is fueled by the necrotic energy of the undead (僵尸), creating a thick, suffocating haze that serves as the primary delivery mechanism for the family's offensive capabilities.

draft.flavor: A thick, billowing haze of fungal spores and necrotic mist that chokes the air, fueling the rot within allies and spreading the blight to those caught in the cloud.
draft.name: Spore Cloud
draft.rationale: The action uses 'sporing' to fulfill the '喷菇' (mushroom spray) and '喷射' (spray/jet) motifs. The '烟雾' (smoke/mist) and '充满' (fill/full) motifs are expressed through the area-of-effect nature of the cloud. The '僵尸' (zombie/undead) motif is captured by the necrotic, rot-based nature of the spores which serves as the payoff for 'rot-punisher' and the enabler for the specified affliction families.

draft.flavor: A thick, choking haze of fungal spores erupts from the target, spreading a suffocating miasma that consumes the living and animates the fallen.
draft.name: Spore Cloud Burst
draft.rationale: The action triggers a burst (喷射) of fungal growths (喷菇) that release a thick cloud (烟雾) to fill (充满) the area. This cloud carries a rot (rotting) that turns the fallen into mindless thralls (summoner/僵尸).

draft.flavor: The target is encased in a blooming frost, shattering under the weight of its own frozen petals.
draft.name: Frostbloom Bloom
draft.rationale: The action targets an enemy to deliver a payoff for frozen targets. It utilizes the 'freezing' enabler to set up the 'chill-punisher' payoff. The motifs of furnace (炉), pine (小松), ice (寒冰), lotus (莲花), and absorption (吸收) are woven into the concept of a frozen, blooming floral strike that consumes the heat of the enemy to fuel its frost.

draft.flavor: As the petals descend, the air turns brittle, turning every impact into a frozen sanctuary.
draft.name: Frostbound Bloom
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer that utilizes the 'chilling' atom to set up 'chill-punisher' synergies. By applying frost to the self or immediate surroundings, the creature creates a defensive buffer that punishes attackers through the elemental interaction of cold and impact.

draft.flavor: As the frost recedes and the embers glow, life surges through the roots to mend the broken.
draft.name: Bloom of the Hearth
draft.rationale: The action provides a multi-target support effect that heals allies, drawing from the 'absorption' and 'regeneration' motifs to sustain the army through the warmth of the 'hearth'.

draft.flavor: The warmth of the furnace meets the frost of the winter, blooming into a cycle of life and decay.
draft.name: Bloom of the Hearth
draft.rationale: The action inflicts a status that combines the freezing chill of winter with the rot of decay, while simultaneously absorbing the essence of the target to fuel the user's own vitality.

draft.flavor: The weight of existence is cast aside as the self becomes the absolute center of a shifting reality, where the distinction between the striker and the strike dissolves into a singular, inevitable command.
draft.name: Unfettered Dominion
draft.rationale: This action functions as a payoff for targets already afflicted by freezing or rot. It allows the user to ignore the standard limitations of combat (不在意/不同), ensuring the effect cannot be resisted or ended (不了), asserting total control over the target's state (主宰), fulfilling the promise of the affliction (不负), and causing the target's essence to rise or be pulled into the user's orbit (上浮).

draft.flavor: The weight of the world becomes a mere suggestion as the essence rises, unburdened and unyielding.
draft.name: Unfettered Ascendance
draft.rationale: This action allows the family to transcend standard defensive limitations. By utilizing the 'Evade' mechanic, the creature achieves a state of 'unfettered' existence (不了/不在意), where the physical impact of an attack is bypassed or elevated (上浮) rather than merely absorbed. This creates a 'different' (不同) state of being that 'rules' (主宰) the flow of combat, ensuring the creature does not 'fail' (不负) its purpose of survival by remaining untouchable.

draft.flavor: The very air thickens with a heavy, inevitable decay that refuses to be ignored.
draft.name: Ascendant Blight
draft.rationale: This action facilitates the 'Blighted Reckoning' engine by ensuring targets are perpetually afflicted. It uses '上浮' (rising/ascension) to describe the spreading nature of the rot and '主宰' (dominance) to establish the inevitability of the status. By making the rot '不同' (different/distinct) from standard damage, it ensures the 'rot-punisher' multiplier has a consistent target. The movement is a slow, unstoppable surge that ignores standard defensive mitigation ('不在意'), ensuring the cycle of decay '不了' (never ends) and the family '不负' (does not fail) its purpose of spreading the blight.

draft.flavor: The presence of the lineage dictates the reality of the battlefield, rendering all lesser laws obsolete.
draft.name: Ascendant Sovereignty
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'Elemental Power' atom family to express the family's core essence: the ability to override, amplify, and dictate the fundamental laws of an element. This captures the 'Sovereignty' (主宰) and 'Differentiation' (不同) of the family, as they do not merely use power, but command it to rise above (上浮) and remain unyielding (不负/不了/不在意) against the standard rules of engagement.
