draft.name: Reflective Thorns
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Retribution' to represent the 'Reflective/Mirror' (映出) aspect of the family, where damage is cast back. It utilizes 'Spore Burst' to represent the 'Thorn/Spike' (刺/地刺) aspect, where the flora's physical presence manifests as a status-inflicting hazard. The 'Flame/Light' (焰光) is expressed through the visual manifestation of the status, and 'Distinction' (区别) is achieved by the specific way the thorns differentiate between the attacker and the environment.

draft.flavor: The weight of the fallen becomes a crushing momentum for the living.
draft.name: Kinetic Decay
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'bowling ball' motif by having the ghoul family members collapse or drop with immense 'gravitational potential energy' (重力势能), turning their 'immobile' (不动) state into 'kinetic energy' (动力) upon impact. This impact triggers 'decay' (僵尸/rot) on all nearby allies, specifically acting as a payoff for 'rot-punisher' by ensuring the afflicted targets are struck by the momentum of the falling horde.

draft.flavor: The weight of the fallen gathers force, rolling through the living like a heavy sphere.
draft.name: Gravitational Momentum
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'zombie advance' (动力/僵尸) and 'momentum' (动力/保龄球) to simulate a heavy, rolling force (重力势能/不动) that strikes targets in a rolled path, setting up the conditions for rot-punishment.

draft.flavor: The sheer weight of the fallen creates a crushing momentum, pulling everything toward the center of the impact.
draft.name: Kinetic Collapse
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'deathblast' atom to represent the kinetic energy of a falling body. It captures the 'bowling ball' motif through a localized, high-impact force that triggers upon the death of a member. It expresses 'potential energy' (gravity) being converted into 'momentum' (power) as the 'undead' (zombie) collapses, affecting the 'immobile' (stillness) state of the surrounding area.

draft.flavor: The air grows heavy and the ground begins to thrum with a deep, rhythmic vibration that slows the pulse of all nearby.
draft.name: Low-Frequency Resonance
draft.rationale: The action creates a low-frequency vibration (low pitch/low frequency) that acts as a defensive field, slowing enemies to enable the 'chill' status which in turn sets up the 'chill-punisher' pairing. It captures the essence of a heavy, rhythmic presence shared by the family.

draft.flavor: A low, vibrating resonance that calls to the many, thickening the air with a protective haze as they converge upon the fray.
draft.name: Low Hum of the Swarm
draft.rationale: The action provides a collective defensive buff (warding) to allies, representing the 'low hum' and 'swarming' nature of the family. It acts as a support mechanism that empowers the group through presence rather than individual strength.

draft.flavor: The collective weight of the horde surges forward, a low, rhythmic thrumming that precedes the crushing impact of their mass.
draft.name: Swarming Advance
draft.rationale: The action facilitates the movement of the family by increasing the speed of the horde's advance (tempo-stampede) while simultaneously ensuring the presence of the family's core essence (summoner) through the spawning of new members in the wake of the surge.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic, vibrating resonance that signals the approach of the many.
draft.name: Low Hum of the Swarm
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'summoner' atom to reflect the family's collective nature of bringing forth others (the swarm/zombies). It captures the 'low' (低沉) and 'swarming' (蜂拥而上) motifs through a status effect that manifests as a gathering presence.

draft.flavor: The gourd's internal pressure builds until the frozen core ruptures, releasing a jagged shard of ice through the enemy's defenses.
draft.name: Frost-Bitten Burst
draft.rationale: The action targets an enemy to deliver a payoff for the chill-punisher atom. It utilizes the freezing atom to enable the specific damage multiplier, fulfilling the requirement of being a mid-tier attack that rewards the presence of frost-based mechanics.

draft.flavor: The thick, frozen rind of the gourd hardens, turning the very air around it into a biting chill that shatters upon impact.
draft.name: Frost-Gourd Ripening
draft.rationale: The action provides the 'chill' status required by the target enabler, utilizing the gourd's thematic connection to thick, protective skins that can hold extreme temperatures.

draft.flavor: The gourd's internal decay erupts outward, turning every wound into a spreading blight.
draft.name: Rotting Reckoning
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for the rot-punisher atom by amplifying the damage dealt to targets already suffering from afflictions like bloodletting, spores, venom, or withering, fulfilling the multi-target support role for the gourd family.

draft.flavor: A heavy, rhythmic tumble that leaves a trail of decay in its wake.
draft.name: Rolling Rot
draft.rationale: The action describes a rolling movement (rolledTarget) that applies the rot status (atom.rotting), which serves as the necessary enabler for the rot-punisher pairing.

draft.flavor: The gourd's skin stretches to its limit before rupturing in a sudden, messy explosion of essence.
draft.name: Overripe Burst
draft.rationale: The gourd family is defined by its seasonal, bursting, and seed-bearing nature. This action captures the essence of a gourd's lifecycle—the moment of rupture that spreads its contents to the surrounding area.

draft.flavor: A radiant burst of solar energy, shaped like a star, that erupts from the user to strike down foes and nourish the soil.
draft.name: Sun-Drenched Starburst
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Sunbloom' and 'sporing' to represent the 'sunlight' and 'grass' motifs, while the 'star' shape (杨桃) and the 'partner' (好搭档) concept are expressed through the synergy of the elemental surge and the spreading spores that act as a companion to the initial strike.

draft.flavor: A radiant, star-shaped canopy of verdant growth that absorbs the warmth of the heavens to fortify the spirit.
draft.name: Sun-Drenched Star-Graft
draft.rationale: The action provides elemental resistance (defense) to the user, acting as a protective 'partner' (好搭档) of light. The star-shaped (杨桃) pattern of the defense is fueled by the sun (阳光) and manifests as a lush, protective layer of greenery (草). This provides the necessary elemental setup to enable the frost-based retribution of the target's subsequent chill-punishment.

draft.flavor: A radiant, star-shaped burst of solar energy that nourishes allies while spreading the seeds of decay among foes.
draft.name: Starfruit Sun-Graft
draft.rationale: The action provides a multi-target support effect that heals allies (the 'good partner' motif) and applies status effects (the 'grass/growth' motif) to enemies. By utilizing the enabler families, it creates a synergistic payoff for 'Blighted Reckoning' by ensuring targets are afflicted with bloodletting, spores, venom, or withering, while the star-shaped (starfruit) solar (sunlight) burst provides the necessary multi-target coverage.

draft.flavor: A radiant, star-shaped growth that pulses with solar energy, binding allies together through a shared, verdant vitality.
draft.name: Star-Fruit Symbiosis
draft.rationale: The action captures the 'Sun' (阳光) through sunbloom, the 'Star' (杨桃) through the shape of the effect, the 'Grass/Plant' (草) through the regenerative growth, and 'Partners/Bonding' (好搭档) through the shared status effect between allies.

draft.flavor: The cold does not merely bite; it remembers the warmth it was denied.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: This action targets the self to trigger a periodic retribution effect. When the user is struck, they release a burst of frost that punishes enemies, specifically scaling in potency against those already frozen by the family's freezing capabilities.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic surge of freezing energy that locks the target in a cycle of frost, preparing them for a devastating strike.
draft.name: Periodic Frost-Binding
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'freezing' to apply a status and 'chill-punisher' to exploit it, fulfilling the requirement of being an enabler for the latter. The 'periodic' motif is expressed through the rhythmic application of the freezing effect, creating a window for the bonus damage to trigger.

draft.flavor: Every time a member of this family lands a blow, they release a rhythmic pulse of decay that amplifies the potency of existing afflictions on their allies' foes.
draft.name: Periodic Rotting
draft.rationale: The action provides a periodic payoff for the rot-punisher motif by ensuring that as long as the family maintains its rhythm of attacks, the damage against afflicted targets scales effectively.

draft.flavor: As the pulse of the swarm quickens, the very air begins to fester.
draft.name: Rhythmic Decay
draft.rationale: This action establishes a periodic movement pattern that ensures targets are consistently afflicted, thereby enabling the rot-punisher multiplier to trigger with rhythmic regularity.

draft.flavor: A recurring pulse of decay that strikes with the inevitability of the tides.
draft.name: Rhythmic Blight
draft.rationale: The action applies a periodic blight to enemies, ensuring that the status effect recurs at set intervals, fulfilling the '定期' (periodic/regular) motif for the entire family.

draft.flavor: A sweeping motion that leaves a trail of frost and necrotic energy in its wake.
draft.name: Glacial Tail Sweep
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'tail' motif through a sweep, incorporates 'ice' and 'cold' via the freezing/chill mechanics, and uses 'blue' and 'zombie' as the visual/thematic descriptors for the necrotic frost effect. It serves as the payoff for chill-punisher by applying the freeze state required for the bonus damage.

draft.flavor: A sudden, biting chill emanates from the roots, coating the surrounding area in a layer of rime that punishes those who dare approach.
draft.name: Frostbound Thicket
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive aura of frost that applies a chill status to attackers, directly enabling the 'chill-punisher' atom by ensuring targets are susceptible to frost-based damage bonuses.

draft.flavor: A freezing blue wake trails behind the movement of the swarm, numbing the spirits of those who stand in their path.
draft.name: Frost-Tail Chill
draft.rationale: The action provides a payoff for the rot-punisher atom by applying a freezing blue trail (tail/blue/ice/cold) that amplifies the potency of rot-based afflictions on allies within the area, fitting the support/multi/ally/mid-tier requirements.

draft.flavor: A chilling, blue-hued rot that spreads through the frozen remains of the fallen.
draft.name: Frostbitten Blight
draft.rationale: The action enables 'rot-punisher' by ensuring targets are afflicted with both chill and blight. It utilizes the 'chilling' and 'blighting' atom families to create a synergistic movement-based setup. The motifs of frost, blue, and the undead are represented through the thematic application of these statuses.

draft.flavor: A lingering, cerulean chill that rises from the fallen, turning the very essence of life into a frozen, shambling echo.
draft.name: Frost-Bound Afterglow
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'chilling' to represent the cold/ice motifs, 'summoner' to represent the zombie/undead motif, and 'elemental surfeit' to amplify the blue/frost power. It targets enemies to inflict a status that leaves a lingering trail (tail) of frost and rising undead.

draft.flavor: The guardian channels the freezing essence of the tundra, turning the chill of the enemy into a devastating surge of frost-rimed power.
draft.name: Frostbound Retribution
draft.rationale: The action targets an enemy to deliver a strike that absorbs the essence of the frozen, creating a surge of frost that restores the guardian's vitality while punishing those caught in the deep freeze.

draft.flavor: A shimmering barrier of crystalline energy that absorbs the impact of incoming strikes to fuel a restorative surge.
draft.name: Frostbound Aegis
draft.rationale: The action creates a shield that absorbs incoming damage and converts a portion of that absorption into immediate health restoration, fulfilling the defensive requirement of the family while enabling the specific pairing role for frost-based retaliation.

draft.flavor: The guardian weaves the essence of the fallen into a protective tapestry, mending the wounds of allies while absorbing the weight of incoming strikes.
draft.name: Sustenance Weave
draft.rationale: This action fulfills the 'support' role by targeting multiple allies to provide healing (mending) and shielding (ward-link/sust-husk). It utilizes the 'absorption' motif by converting incoming pressure into protective layers, and the 'recovery' motif by restoring health to the group.

draft.flavor: The guardian shifts through the deck, absorbing the momentum of the fray to weave a protective barrier from the very cards drawn.
draft.name: Card-Draw Displacement
draft.rationale: The action uses movement to reposition the user, absorbing the energy of the movement to generate a shield (护盾) and restore health (回复), effectively manufacturing (制造) a defensive state from the current hand of cards (卡牌). It enables rot-punisher by ensuring the guardian remains present and sturdy to apply afflictions.

draft.flavor: A sudden burst of rapid, stinging growth that draws vitality from the enemy to mend the self.
draft.name: Thorned Resurgence
draft.rationale: The action triggers a rapid succession of strikes (tempo-haste/surge) that inflict thorns (植物) to drain life (lifesteal/mending) and bolster the user's own constitution (vitality/提升) as the momentum subsides (回落).

draft.flavor: As the roots deepen and the sap flows, the spirit quickens and the wounds close.
draft.name: Verdant Resurgence
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive surge of vitality and rapid recovery, utilizing plant-based growth to accelerate the user's tempo and mend their form, ensuring they remain standing to exploit frozen foes.

draft.flavor: As the forest breathes, the wounded find strength in the soil and the rhythm of the growing things.
draft.name: Verdant Resurgence
draft.rationale: The action provides a multi-target healing burst (治疗) that triggers a growth of flora (植物) at the allies' feet. This growth grants a temporary increase to attack speed (攻速) and power (提升), but the effect recedes (回落) once the plants wither away.

draft.flavor: A sudden, rhythmic pulse of life that accelerates the cycle of decay and regrowth.
draft.name: Verdant Surge
draft.rationale: The action triggers a rapid increase in attack rate (tempo-wildgrowth) and a burst of healing (regeneration) upon movement. As the effect recedes (回落), it leaves behind a trail of flora (植物) that provides a lingering boost (提升) to the user's vitality.

draft.flavor: A surge of life-force that blooms through the enemy, drawing strength from their decay to mend the living.
draft.name: Verdant Resurgence
draft.rationale: The action inflicts a botanical status on enemies that causes their vitality to fall (回落) as they are infested with spores (植物/sporing). This decay triggers a restorative surge (治疗/mending) for the caster's allies, while simultaneously increasing the caster's attack rate (攻速/tempo-wildgrowth) and boosting the potency of subsequent life-giving effects (提升/mending/life-surge logic).

draft.flavor: A clandestine chill that settles deep within the marrow, turning every strike into a frozen monument of what once was.
draft.name: Secretive Frost-Gaze
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to prepare for a payoff. By utilizing the freezing motif, the user prepares a state of frost that the enemy will eventually succumb to. The 'secretive' and 'handheld' motifs suggest a hidden, contained power that is unleashed upon the target, turning them into a frozen, zombie-like statue through the application of cold.

draft.flavor: In the quiet moments between the carnage, they clutch their cherished relics close, drawing strength from the very things they hold dear.
draft.name: Private Devotion
draft.rationale: The action describes a defensive posture where the creature holds (手中) a large (一大) cherished (喜爱) object privately (私下里) to sustain itself, a behavior shared by the undead (僵尸) in this family to ensure survival through life-stealing/regeneration.

draft.flavor: A sudden, frantic surge of vitality flows from the fallen, as the very ground begins to pulse with a dark, hungry affection for the living.
draft.name: The Carrion's Embrace
draft.rationale: The action targets allies to provide a massive burst of health restoration (一大) through a shared, intimate connection (手中/私下里) that manifests as a sudden surge of life (喜爱) amidst the presence of the undead (僵尸), serving as the perfect payoff for the rot-punisher's affliction.

draft.flavor: A clandestine gesture of affection, where the hand guides the spreading blight through the marrow.
draft.name: Private Hand of the Rotting
draft.rationale: The action represents a movement where the creature uses its hands to secretly guide a massive surge of rot toward a target, enabling the rot-punisher effect by ensuring the target is afflicted.

draft.flavor: A silent, grasping affection that marks the soul for the end.
draft.name: Private Devotion
draft.rationale: The action uses 'marking' to represent the 'private affection' (私下里/喜爱) and the 'grasping hand' (手中) that leaves a 'great' (一大) mark on the enemy, signaling their inevitable transformation into the 'undead' (僵尸) state.

draft.flavor: A sudden, chilling stillness descends upon the horde, turning their very presence into a frozen barricade that punishes those who dare strike them.
draft.name: Silver-Grey Stasis
draft.rationale: The action provides the 'chill' status required to enable the target's 'chill-punisher' motif. It captures the essence of a family of undead/stagnant creatures (僵尸) through a silver-grey (银灰色) defensive aura that absorbs/drains (吸取) the momentum of an attack, leaving the enemy in a state of confusion (不解) amidst a landscape of carnage (尸山血海).

draft.flavor: A silver-grey tide of the fallen rises to swallow the battlefield, turning the soil into a sea of gore to sustain the horde.
draft.name: Blood-Silt Surge
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for rot-punisher by amplifying the impact of afflictions. It targets multiple allies to provide a surge of vitality, drawing from the 'blood-sea' (尸山血海) and 'silver-grey' (银灰色) essence of the 'kin' (一族) to help the horde 'break through' (突出重围) the siege.

draft.flavor: A silver-grey tide of the undying, surging through the chaos of the battlefield to find the rot within.
draft.name: Unrelenting Onslaught
draft.rationale: The action represents the collective momentum of the horde (one family) as they push through a siege (突出重围) to deliver a blow that punishes those already afflicted by their decay (enabling rot-punisher).

draft.flavor: A silver-grey tide of hunger that turns the battlefield into a sea of blood, draining the life from those trapped within the fray.
draft.name: Sanguine Siphon
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the family's collective ability to drain vitality (lifesteal) and increase the potency of their affliction (affliction), embodying the 'horde' aspect of a blood-drinking, silver-grey swarm that thrives on the carnage of battle.

draft.flavor: The host undergoes a rapid, invasive growth, rooting itself deeply into the soil to prepare for a sudden, freezing burst of life.
draft.name: Perennial Bloom
draft.rationale: The action represents the 'planting' (种植) of a frozen seed within the self, which serves as the mechanical payoff for 'chill-punisher' by ensuring the target is frozen, thereby triggering the bonus damage. The 'water lily' (睡莲) motif is expressed through the thematic concept of a sudden, blooming frost.

draft.flavor: A thick, water-logged layer of petals forms a protective layer, chilling any who attempt to disturb the roots.
draft.name: Perennial Frost-Bloom
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer (the lotus/water lily motif) that enables the 'freezing' atom family, which in turn serves as the prerequisite for the 'chill-punisher' pairing role.

draft.flavor: The host spreads a layer of nutrient-rich sediment and dormant seeds across the battlefield, ensuring that any wound inflicted upon an ally becomes a fertile bed for growth.
draft.name: Verdant Siltation
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'Gardener' atom to manifest the 'planting' (种植) motif, creating a field of growth. By incorporating 'Mending', it fulfills the 'support' role for allies, mirroring the restorative and life-sustaining nature of a water lily (睡莲) ecosystem where decay fuels new life.

draft.flavor: The movement of the host leaves a trail of life that feeds upon the fallen.
draft.name: Rooted Sowing
draft.rationale: The action describes a movement that plants seeds (种植) which bloom like water lilies (睡莲) upon the remains of the enemy, specifically enabling the rot-punisher effect by ensuring targets are afflicted as the host moves through them.

draft.flavor: As the host settles into the soil, the surrounding area begins to sprout, turning the battlefield into a lush, treacherous garden of growth and decay.
draft.name: Perennial Bloom
draft.rationale: The action captures the essence of 'planting' (种植) by spawning flora where the host falls, and the 'water lily' (睡莲) motif is represented through the 'enduring bloom' (econ-endure) mechanic, where the host's presence provides sustained nourishment/sun to the ecosystem through the act of being struck.

draft.flavor: The air turns frigid as a sudden burst of elemental energy erupts from the user, shattering the stillness with a violent, freezing shockwave.
draft.name: Frostbite Surge
draft.rationale: This action serves as a high-impact payoff for freezing effects. By utilizing elemental surge and freezing mechanics, it fulfills the 'attack' category and 'self' target mode by projecting power outward from the user's own essence to deal massive damage to enemies, specifically amplifying the impact of existing frost conditions.

draft.flavor: The target is encased in a layer of permafrost, making them susceptible to the shattering impact of frost-based strikes.
draft.name: Frostbound Shell
draft.rationale: The action applies a freezing effect (atom.freezing) which serves as the necessary enabler for the 'Frost Reckoning' (atom.chill-punisher) pairing. It fulfills the 'defense' category by providing a defensive status/layer, targets a single entity, and relates to the self/target interaction through the application of a state. It avoids all anti-motifs and uses only the provided atom families.

draft.flavor: The very presence of the swarm amplifies the decay of those they touch, turning every wound into a spreading plague for their allies to feast upon.
draft.name: Rotting Resonance
draft.rationale: This action serves as a payoff for atom.rot-punisher by ensuring that targets afflicted by the enabler families (bloodletting, spores, venom, or withering) receive increased damage from the family's collective presence. It targets multiple allies to provide support through the spread of decay.

draft.flavor: The family surges forward, leaving a trail of decay in their wake to empower the rot.
draft.name: Blighted Surge
draft.rationale: The action provides a movement-based surge (tempo-surge) that acts as an enabler for rot-punisher by increasing the speed of the zombie advance and setting up the conditions for increased damage against afflicted targets.

draft.flavor: The collective essence of the lineage erupts, overwhelming the senses of the foe.
draft.name: Subspecies Surge
draft.rationale: The action represents a surge of power (力量) and a release (发射) of essence from the lineage (亚种) that inflicts damage (伤害) and spreads a status (affliction) upon the enemy, characteristic of the relentless advance of the horde (僵尸).

draft.flavor: The cold bite of a winter storm, turning every frozen strike into a shattering blow.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: The action targets an enemy to inflict a freezing status, which in turn enables a massive damage multiplier against that target, fulfilling the payoff requirement for the chill-punisher/freezing pairing.

draft.flavor: A layer of permafrost coats the skin, turning every impact into a freezing shockwave.
draft.name: Frostbound Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer (Shield Toughness) that reduces incoming damage, while simultaneously applying a freezing effect (Freezing) to attackers. This creates a tactical loop where the creature's defense (Protection/Shield) consumes the momentum of the enemy (Damage/Combat) and makes it highly unlikely (Unlikely) for the attacker to continue their assault without being slowed by the frost.

draft.flavor: The horde surges forward, their very presence a decaying tide that punishes the living for every wound they inflict.
draft.name: Rotting Onslaught
draft.rationale: This action functions as a payoff for atom.rot-punisher by amplifying the effectiveness of afflictions. It targets allies to provide a 'protective umbrella' of decay, where the presence of the horde causes the target to suffer damage and depletion (consumption) based on the number of afflicted enemies nearby, making it highly unlikely for an enemy to remain untouched by the rot.

draft.flavor: The relentless tide of decay surges forward, leaving a trail of corruption in its wake.
draft.name: Rotting Advance
draft.rationale: The action combines the movement of the family (swiftness/advance) with the core theme of decay (rotting/blight) to enable the rot-punisher pairing. It represents the collective movement of the horde during combat.

draft.flavor: A relentless surge of decay that consumes the living to fuel the march of the fallen.
draft.name: Blighted Onslaught
draft.rationale: The action combines the spreading decay of 'blighting' with the accelerated movement of 'tempo-surge', capturing the essence of a relentless, consuming horde that inflicts damage through rapid, infectious advancement.

draft.flavor: The target is enveloped in a cozy, vine-choked embrace that radiates a soothing heat, shattering their defenses from within.
draft.name: Warmth of the Gourd
draft.rationale: This action serves as the payoff for a frozen target. It uses the 'Warmth' (温馨) and 'Gourd' (窝瓜) motifs to describe a sudden, cozy thermal expansion that acts as an attack. It 'Summons' (召唤) vines/plants (植物) to form a 'Small Nest' (小窝) around the enemy, dealing damage through the rapid expansion of life.

draft.flavor: A lush sanctuary of growth that calls forth life to mend the weary and nourish the soil.
draft.name: Nurturing Grove
draft.rationale: The action manifests a verdant sanctuary that summons restorative growth to allies, providing a cozy haven that heals and accelerates the vitality of the surrounding flora.

draft.flavor: The movement of the family leaves behind a nurturing sanctuary that empowers those who have suffered the rot.
draft.name: Verdant Nesting
draft.rationale: The action uses 'gardener' to express the family's ability to plant life (植物/召唤/小窝) as they move, creating a 'warm' (温馨) environment that serves as a 'nest' (小窝/窝瓜) for allies to recover or thrive, specifically enabling the 'rot-punisher' by ensuring targets are caught within these growing zones.

draft.flavor: A three-pronged strike that pierces the soul, leaving a frost-bitten mark upon the living.
draft.name: Trident of the Unliving
draft.rationale: The action utilizes a three-pronged piercing strike (Trident) to deliver a freezing blow (Freezing) that empowers subsequent strikes against frozen targets (Chill-Punisher), embodying the relentless, cold advance of the undead.

draft.flavor: The three-pronged strike leaves a trail of biting frost, chilling the very air around the target.
draft.name: Trident Frost
draft.rationale: The action applies a chilling effect to a single target, setting up the specific synergy required for the chill-punisher enabler.

draft.flavor: The infantry advances in a jagged formation, their strikes leaving festering wounds that empower the next blow.
draft.name: Trident Rot
draft.rationale: The action provides a structural payoff for the rot-punisher motif by ensuring that enemies already afflicted by the family's signature decay take amplified damage, creating a synergistic loop for the infantry's multi-target support role.

draft.flavor: The infantry surges forward in a rhythmic, relentless march, their weapons carving a path through the living.
draft.name: Trident Advance
draft.rationale: The action provides a movement-based surge (tempo-surge) that facilitates the application and potency of rot-based afflictions (rot-punisher), fitting the relentless, advancing nature of the family's infantry.

draft.flavor: A jagged, three-pronged strike that leaves a festering wound in its wake.
draft.name: Trident Rot
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'rotting' and 'affliction' atoms to represent the spreading decay characteristic of the family's motif, while the 'trident' motif is expressed through the structural delivery of the status effect across the target.

draft.flavor: The instinct to survive is woven into their very essence, turning every strike into a desperate, cold necessity.
draft.name: Natural Instinct
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a reaction against the enemy. By utilizing the innate (天生) drive to protect one's state (安全感), the creature's presence (潜藏在) becomes a predatory trap. It leverages the natural (天生) cycle of decay (僵尸) to ensure that those who strike it find only the cold embrace of the frost they sought to break.

draft.flavor: A natural, creeping decay that seeks out the vulnerable, ensuring that those who fall become the foundation for the next wave of the infestation.
draft.name: Innate Rotting Presence
draft.rationale: The action targets allies to provide a sense of security (safety/security) through the natural (innate) presence of decay. It creates a cycle where the rot (rotting) is a fundamental part of the family's existence, ensuring that as members fall, they leave behind the conditions for more to emerge, effectively 'hiding' the potential for a new swarm within the remains of the old.

draft.flavor: A primal urge to settle and endure, turning the very ground into a sanctuary of rot and stillness.
draft.name: Instinctive Nesting
draft.rationale: The action captures the family's innate (天生) tendency to find comfort (安全感) in the act of spreading (喜欢) through the very essence of the undead (僵尸) as they lie hidden (潜藏在) within their own biological residue.

draft.flavor: With a sharp command, the leader directs the fallen to rise and strike, turning the very essence of the deceased into a relentless tide of retribution.
draft.name: The Commander's Decree
draft.rationale: The action represents the instructor's ability to command the dead (僵尸) through a direct order (喝令), personally (亲身) manifesting a surge of power that makes the enemy's defense a tragic oversight (可惜) as the frost-bound spirits emerge (出来) to punish them.

draft.flavor: The instructor issues a command, forcing the fallen to rise and the living to endure.
draft.name: Commanding Presence
draft.rationale: The action functions as a mid-tier support payoff. By commanding the battlefield, the instructor causes allies to rise (zombies/summoning) and forces the enemy to face the consequences of their ailments, specifically amplifying the effects of rot-punishment for the entire army.

draft.flavor: A sudden, authoritative command that forces the ranks to surge forward, leaving a trail of decay in their wake.
draft.name: Commanding Presence
draft.rationale: The action uses a 'Commanding Presence' to trigger a surge of movement. It enables 'Rot Punisher' by ensuring targets are afflicted through the movement of the summoned entities. The motifs are woven into the concept of a leader calling forth their minions (喝令, 出来, 僵尸) to personally lead the charge (亲身), while the '可惜' (pity/too bad) is represented by the inevitable decay left behind that the enemy cannot escape.

draft.flavor: A sudden, authoritative command that forces the fallen to rise and the living to falter.
draft.name: Commanding Presence
draft.rationale: The action uses 'Commanding Presence' to embody the instructor's role. It utilizes 'Summoner' to manifest the 'zombie' (僵尸) and 'come out' (出来) motifs through the physical manifestation of the fallen. It uses 'Affliction' to represent the 'command' (喝令) and the 'pity/shame' (可惜) of the target's weakened state. The 'personal/physical' (亲身) aspect is captured by the direct, authoritative nature of the status application.

draft.flavor: With a shrug of indifference and a history of broken hearts, the jester endures the struggle, turning every hardship into a sudden, explosive outburst of chaotic energy.
draft.name: The Relentless Jest
draft.rationale: The action captures the 'jester' family's essence by combining the endurance of hardship (刻苦) and the nonchalance of a shrug (耸耸肩) with a volatile, explosive payoff (一触即发) that stems from their chaotic history (恋爱史) and shifting form (外形). It functions as a mid-tier attack that scales based on the user's own survival and elemental buildup.

draft.flavor: A sudden, mocking display of nonchalance that leaves the attacker grasping at empty air.
draft.name: The Performed Shrug
draft.rationale: The action utilizes '耸耸肩' (shrugging) as the core mechanic of the 'evd-flinch' atom, where the creature's '外形' (appearance/posture) shifts into a mocking stance. The '一触即发' (imminent/volatile) nature of the defense triggers the dodge, while the '刻苦' (painstaking/diligent) repetition of the movement and the '恋爱史' (romantic history/dramatic flair) of the jester's performance define the defensive style. It acts as an enabler for 'atom.chill-punisher' by creating the opening needed for a freezing counter-strike.

draft.flavor: A mocking shrug and a sudden, volatile burst of energy that turns past suffering into present opportunity.
draft.name: The Jester's Grin
draft.rationale: The action captures the 'jester' essence by transforming the 'hardship' (刻苦) of previous afflictions into a 'volatile' (一触即发) payoff. It uses a 'shrug' (耸耸肩) to dismiss the 'physical form' (外形) of the enemy in favor of a 'dramatic' (恋爱史/drama) shift in momentum, specifically triggering the bonus damage from rot-punisher.

draft.flavor: A sudden, dramatic shift in posture that leaves the audience breathless and the stage trembling.
draft.name: The Grand Performance
draft.rationale: The action represents a dramatic, physical reconfiguration of the self (外形) born from years of rigorous practice (刻苦). This movement is highly volatile and poised to strike (一触即发), fueled by the chaotic emotional weight of past connections (恋爱史), and concludes with a nonchalant, dismissive shrug (耸耸肩) that sets the stage for the rot to take hold.

draft.flavor: A mocking display of indifference that leaves the enemy unsettled and the jester ready to strike.
draft.name: The Jester's Shrug
draft.rationale: The action captures the 'shrug' (耸耸肩) through the 'retribution' (atom.retribution) mechanic—turning an enemy's aggression into a mockery that strikes back. It embodies 'one touch and it's explosive' (一触即发) by reacting to contact, and 'hard work' (刻苦) through the constant, rhythmic cycle of provocation and response. The 'appearance' (外形) is defined by this reactive posture, and the 'romantic history' (恋爱史) is implied by the volatile, push-and-pull nature of the interaction.

draft.flavor: The rigid limbs snap into motion, driving the body forward with a sudden, unnatural surge of kinetic energy.
draft.name: 僵起
draft.rationale: The action represents the sudden, rigid movement characteristic of the family. It serves as a payoff for chilling/freezing effects by leveraging the momentum of a sudden strike to punish frozen targets.

draft.flavor: The body stiffens into an unyielding pillar, locking its joints to endure the coming impact.
draft.name: Rigid Stasis
draft.rationale: As a defensive action for the family, this represents the characteristic rigidity and sudden stillness (僵体/僵起) that allows them to withstand strikes. By applying a chilling effect to the self or the immediate vicinity, it sets up the necessary conditions for the 'chill-punisher' enabler to trigger upon the next interaction.

draft.flavor: The rigid limbs of the family twitch in unison, channeling a surge of vitality into their kin to ensure the march never falters.
draft.name: 僵起 (Rise of the Stiff)
draft.rationale: As a support action targeting allies, this action utilizes the mending atom to provide health restoration to the group, fulfilling the 'Rise' motif by revitalizing the family's collective strength.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic, jarring advance that leaves a trail of decay in its wake.
draft.name: Rigid Stride
draft.rationale: The action captures the characteristic stiff, hopping movement of the family (僵起/僵体) while utilizing the 'swiftness' and 'rotting' atoms to enable the 'rot-punisher' synergy through a rhythmic, aggressive advance.

draft.flavor: The kineticist channels the essence of the family to fortify allies, turning the very concept of growth into a protective barrier that rewards the persistence of life.
draft.name: Nurturing Husk
draft.rationale: This action provides a multi-target support payoff. It utilizes the 'mending' and 'vitality' atoms to provide health and max health benefits to allies, while 'fortitude' provides the structural durability required for a mid-tier support role. It serves as a payoff for 'rot-punisher' by ensuring the allies of a debuff-heavy kineticist remain standing to exploit the afflicted targets.

draft.flavor: The kineticist curls into a dense, hard-shelled sphere, spinning rapidly across the battlefield to crush everything in their path.
draft.name: Nut-Shell Roll
draft.rationale: The action uses the 'Nut' (坚果) motif to describe the defensive shell, the 'Squash' (窝瓜) motif to describe the crushing movement/impact, and the 'Learn' (学) motif to represent the kineticist's mastery over their own momentum. It functions as an enabler for rot-punisher by positioning the user to apply or benefit from afflictions through high-mobility contact.

draft.flavor: The kineticist channels the essence of growth, forcing the target's internal systems to over-process and swell with raw, unrefined vitality.
draft.name: Nutrient Infusion
draft.rationale: The action applies a status that increases the potency of all subsequent status effects applied to the target. This represents the 'learning' (学) of the target's biology to absorb more, the 'nut' (坚果) of concentrated energy, and the 'squash' (窝瓜) of the target's defenses under the weight of overwhelming growth.

draft.flavor: The kineticist hardens their outer layer into a frozen, jagged casing, causing any impact to shatter into a freezing, corrosive mist that clings to the attacker.
draft.name: Frost-Blighted Shell
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to create a defensive shell (坚果/Nut) that, upon being struck, releases a freezing (学/Study/Knowledge of the frost) and blighting (窝瓜/Squash/Crushing weight of rot) aura. It serves as the perfect payoff for chill-punisher by ensuring the target is frozen and blighted, setting up the elemental synergy.

draft.flavor: A layer of crystalline rime coats the exterior, turning every impact into a shattering shockwave of cold.
draft.name: Frost-Hardened Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides defensive mitigation through increased toughness, carapace, and status resistance, creating the structural stability required to enable the chill-punisher effect.

draft.flavor: The kineticist weaves a dense, nutrient-rich layer over their allies, ensuring that those already suffering from decay only find strength in their affliction.
draft.name: Nurturing Harvest
draft.rationale: As a support action targeting multiple allies, this provides a restorative layer that scales with the target's existing health or capacity, acting as the structural payoff for enemies already suffering from the rot, venom, or spores of the enabler families.

draft.flavor: The kineticist tucks into a tight, hard-shelled sphere and launches themselves forward, crushing everything in their path.
draft.name: Nut-Shell Roll
draft.rationale: The action uses the 'nut' (坚果) motif for the protective shell, the 'squash' (窝瓜) motif for the crushing impact of the roll, and the 'study/learn' (学) motif through the kineticist's calculated trajectory. It serves as an enabler for Rot-Punisher by positioning the user to strike afflicted targets.

draft.flavor: The kineticist draws upon the essence of the target, converting their vitality into a concentrated burst of growth.
draft.name: Nutrient Siphon
draft.rationale: The action applies a status that increases the potency of all currently inflicted statuses (Affliction) while simultaneously surging the kineticist's elemental power (Elemental Overflow/Surge), representing the 'learning' or 'absorbing' of the target's essence to fuel the user's own growth.

draft.flavor: The laborer drives their heavy tool into the earth, causing the ground to buckle and erupt beneath the enemy.

draft.rationale: The action describes a laborer using a tool to dig (挖掘) a tunnel (地道) that erupts under an enemy, causing a collision (撞到) with the force of a heavy object (南瓜). This action serves as the payoff for atom.chill-punisher by ensuring the target is caught in a frozen state within the impact zone.

draft.flavor: The laborer plants their weight deep within the earth, turning the soil to create a foundation that absorbs the impact of any strike.
draft.name: Subterranean Brace
draft.rationale: The action describes a defensive posture (Braced Footing) where the laborer uses their tools to dig into the ground (地道/挖掘), creating a stable base that prevents them from being knocked back or losing their footing when they collide with an enemy (撞到). This stability is a core trait of the family's labor-oriented nature.

draft.flavor: The laborer strikes the earth, unearthing a bounty of nutrients and structural support for the collective.
draft.name: Subterranean Harvest
draft.rationale: The action represents the laborer's role in excavating (挖掘) tunnels (地道) using their implements (工具) to strike (撞到) the ground, resulting in a yield (南瓜) that provides structural reinforcement (Shield Toughness) and restorative sustenance (Mending) to allies.

draft.flavor: The laborer drives their heavy tool into the earth, carving a path through the soil to strike with the weight of the world.
draft.name: Trench-Breaker Charge
draft.rationale: The action describes a heavy, tool-based movement that strikes (撞到) the ground to create a path (地道/挖掘), serving as a delivery mechanism for the rot-punisher enabler by ensuring targets are afflicted through the impact of the laborer's work.

draft.flavor: The ground trembles as a hidden tunnel erupts, forcing the enemy to collide with a sudden, heavy obstacle.
draft.name: Subterranean Ambush
draft.rationale: The action describes a laborer using tools to excavate a tunnel (挖掘, 地道, 工具) that causes an enemy to collide (撞到) with a heavy, rounded object (南瓜) as they emerge, applying a status effect (affliction) to the target.

draft.flavor: A rapid-fire burst of projectiles that bounce through the fray.

draft.rationale: The action describes a single launcher firing a volley of bullets that bounce off targets, fulfilling the 'triple-line' (three-shot) and 'ricochet' motifs inherent to the family's movement and projectile behavior.

draft.flavor: A defensive posture that converts incoming momentum into a sudden, scattered discharge.

draft.rationale: The action triggers a defensive burst upon being struck, launching a volley of projectiles that bounce across the battlefield to ensure coverage. This provides the necessary setup for frost-based retaliation by ensuring targets are hit with consistent, scattered strikes.

draft.flavor: The launcher launches a volley of projectiles that bounce through the air, releasing a cloud of spores to bolster the army.
draft.name: Spore Volley
draft.rationale: The action describes a multi-target support launch where projectiles (bullets/projectiles) are thrown/fired in a three-line pattern, bouncing to ensure coverage, specifically designed to trigger the 'sporing' atom family to enable the 'rot-punisher' payoff.

draft.flavor: A rapid-fire volley that bounces through the ranks, seeking out those already marked by decay.
draft.name: Triple-Shot Ricochet
draft.rationale: The action launches a three-line volley of projectiles that bounce upon impact, enabling the application of rot-punisher by ensuring multiple hits on targets already afflicted.

draft.flavor: A rapid succession of projectiles that bounce through the fray.
draft.name: Ballistic Volley
draft.rationale: The action describes a launcher firing a volley of bullets that bounce (弹跳) through the target area, expressing the concept of multiple projectiles (子弹) being launched (发射/投出) in a sequence (三行) to strike enemies.

draft.flavor: The sovereign command ripples through the marrow, turning every strike into a herald of the inevitable end.
draft.name: Royal Decree of the Unliving
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to amplify the potency of existing afflictions (rot/blight), embodying the 'King' who commands the 'Zombie' horde to 'Initiate' a 'Halloween' themed onslaught where the enemy's defenses are 'Useless' against the 'Blighted Reckoning'.

draft.flavor: A command that ripples through the ranks, ensuring the rot takes hold of all who resist.
draft.name: The Sovereign's Decree
draft.rationale: The action functions as a leader's command to initiate a widespread decay. By applying 'rotting' to targets, it serves as the necessary enabler for 'rot-punisher' to trigger its bonus damage against those already afflicted.

draft.flavor: The legion moves as a single, unstoppable tide, crushing all resistance through sheer, coordinated momentum.
draft.name: Legionnaire's Onslaught
draft.rationale: The action functions as a coordinated strike that capitalizes on frozen targets, embodying the unstoppable and unbreakable nature of a legionary advance.

draft.flavor: The legion moves as a single, impenetrable wall, where every step is a declaration of dominance and every strike is a calculated inevitability.

draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive fortification (arm-hardening) that scales with the collective strength of the legion, ensuring the entire group remains an unstoppable force (unbreakable/indestructible) as they deploy (advance/sortie) to crush all opposition.

draft.flavor: The legion moves as a single, unbreakable tide, where every strike carries the weight of the entire host.

draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive buff to the entire army (Resilience), embodying the 'unbreakable' and 'legion' motifs. It serves as a support mechanism that allows the family to maintain a cohesive front, enabling the offensive payoff of rot-punisher by ensuring the legion stays on the field to apply and exploit afflictions.

draft.flavor: The collective weight of the legion moves as one, an unstoppable tide that turns every strike into a catalyst for decay.
draft.name: Legion Advance
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'tempo-surge' to represent the 'Alpha' movement of the 'Legion' (军团/出动), providing the necessary momentum to ensure the 'rot-punisher' (unbreakable/indestructible force) can effectively exploit afflicted targets.

draft.flavor: The collective advance of the legion renders all opposition futile, a relentless tide that breaks any defense through sheer, unyielding presence.
draft.name: Legion's Phalanx
draft.rationale: The action applies a massive defensive fortification to the entire army, representing the 'indestructible' and 'unbreakable' nature of a legion in motion. By utilizing the 'Armour' and 'Plating' atom families, it captures the essence of a collective, unstoppable force that is both 'unbreakable' (坚不可摧) and 'invincible' (无坚不摧) as they 'deploy' (出动) as a 'legion' (军团) under the 'alpha' (阿尔法) command.

draft.flavor: The legionnaire strikes with the weight of a thousand winters, turning the frozen stillness of the enemy into a shattered shell of ice and stone.
draft.name: Call of the Hardened
draft.rationale: The action represents the collective strength of the legionnaire family. By utilizing the 'Freezing' enabler to set up the 'Chill Punisher' payoff, the action embodies the 'Hardened' (坚硬) and 'Nut/Shell' (坚果) motifs through the creation of ice-like structures, while the 'Call' (召集) and 'Commander' (团长) motifs are expressed through the tactical synergy of the family members working in unison to exploit the frozen state of the enemy.

draft.flavor: The legionnaire plants their feet and hardens their exterior, signaling the formation to brace for the coming frost.
draft.name: Call of the Hardened Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive fortification (arm-hardening/arm-welding) that serves as a structural enabler for the family. By increasing the defensive presence and bracing the formation, it sets the stage for the 'chill-punisher' synergy by ensuring the unit survives long enough to exploit frozen targets.

draft.flavor: The commander's command echoes through the ranks, hardening the resolve of the collective and ensuring the rot takes hold of the enemy.
draft.name: Legionnaire's Call
draft.rationale: The action functions as a support mechanism that calls upon the collective (召集/团长) to bolster the army's defense (坚硬/坚果) through a persistent, tireless effect (夜以继日), specifically serving as the structural payoff for rot-based damage by providing the necessary army-wide fortification.

draft.flavor: The legionnaire's rhythmic advance is a relentless tide, gathering strength from the very earth they tread upon.
draft.name: Call of the Hardened Legion
draft.rationale: The action represents the collective movement of the family, using 'Call' (召集) to signify the gathering of the legion, and 'Hardened' (坚硬/坚果) to reflect their defensive nature. The movement is 'Relentless' (夜以继日) as they advance, acting as a 'Commander' (团长) of the battlefield to enable the rot-punisher's effectiveness by positioning the legion effectively.

draft.flavor: Under the relentless gaze of the sun and moon, the commander's command echoes through the ranks, hardening the resolve of the collective.
draft.name: Call of the Hardened Legion
draft.rationale: The action 'Call of the Hardened Legion' uses 'atom.arm-hardening' to represent the '坚硬' (hard/hardened) motif. The '召集' (summon/call) and '团长' (commander/leader) motifs are expressed through the act of a collective call, while '夜以继日' (day and night/relentlessly) and '坚果' (nut/hard shell) are reflected in the enduring, protective nature of the status applied to the entire army.

draft.flavor: The pressure within the casing reaches its limit, releasing a rapid succession of projectiles that strike with the force of a sudden spring.
draft.name: Burst of the Pod
draft.rationale: The action describes a self-targeted burst that releases multiple projectiles (the 'pea' motif) in a rapid sequence (the 'launch' motif), fulfilling the 'volley' atom family requirement for a mid-tier attack.

draft.flavor: Upon impact, the shell ruptures to release a cloud of freezing essence.
draft.name: Burst Pod
draft.rationale: The action describes a projectile (豌豆) that undergoes a sudden release (发射) to trigger a freezing effect, acting as a prerequisite for chill-based damage multipliers.

draft.flavor: Upon striking a target afflicted by decay, the entity releases a rapid succession of seed-pods that seek out nearby allies to bolster their vitality.
draft.name: Burst Spore Volley
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'spore' motif (豌豆/pea-like pods) and the 'launch' motif (发射) to create a multi-target support effect. It acts as a payoff for 'rot-punisher' by triggering when an afflicted target is hit, fulfilling the 'support' and 'ally' requirements by transferring benefits to the team.

draft.flavor: The legume releases its concentrated essence, propelling small, potent seeds toward the target to ensure the rot takes hold.

draft.rationale: The action describes the movement of small, rounded units (豌豆) being propelled (发射) from the source. By utilizing the `atom.sporing` family, the action provides the necessary mechanism for the 'legume' family to apply the 'rot' status required by the `atom.rot-punisher` pairing role.

draft.flavor: Upon impact, the target releases a cloud of concentrated seeds that burst against nearby foes.
draft.name: Burst Spore
draft.rationale: The action describes a burst of seeds (豌豆) being launched (发射) upon impact. This is a characteristic behavior for the entire legume family, representing the biological mechanism of seed dispersal common to the group, applied here as a status effect on an enemy.

draft.flavor: A profound, bowing descent that freezes the very essence of the soul, preparing the vessel for the inevitable harvest.

draft.rationale: The action represents the entire lich family through the ritualistic act of bowing (俯身) to deliver a terminal, freezing lecture. It functions as the payoff for freezing targets, turning a frozen enemy into a brittle monument for the lich's academic pursuit of death.

draft.flavor: A sudden, heavy stillness descends, as if the very air has been commanded to cease its motion.
draft.name: Stasis of the Unspoken
draft.rationale: The action creates a state of frozen stillness (freezing) that serves as the necessary enabler for the subsequent chill-punisher effect. It captures the essence of a lich's control over the cessation of life and motion.

draft.flavor: The essence of the departed vibrates in sympathy with the living, turning decay into a conduit for revitalizing the collective.
draft.name: Soul-Siphon Resonance
draft.rationale: The action functions as a support mechanism that amplifies the effectiveness of rot-based afflictions. By resonating with the decay of others, the user provides a structural payoff that bolsters allies through the very process of decomposition, fulfilling the role of an enabler for the specified enabler families.

draft.flavor: A calculated, rhythmic bowing of the frame that marks the transition from life to a state of permanent, rotting study.
draft.name: The Scholarly Descent
draft.rationale: The action describes a mechanical, ritualistic bowing (俯身/机器人) that serves as a formal academic presentation (博士学位) of decay, fulfilling the movement requirement and enabling the rot-punisher pairing by ensuring the target is afflicted through a structured, repetitive motion.

draft.flavor: A command that echoes through the void, tethering the essence of the living to the inevitability of the grave.
draft.name: Soul-Binding Decree
draft.rationale: The lich family is defined by the imposition of their will upon the essence of others. By utilizing the 'Affliction' atom, they exert a status-based influence that scales in potency, representing the inescapable decay or spiritual weight they command. This action targets enemies to impose their mark, fitting the 'status' category and the 'enemy' relation.

draft.flavor: As the lineage falls, they release a final, desperate volley of projectiles, turning their very end into a tactical strike against the encroaching horde.

draft.rationale: The action 'Parting Salvo' captures the essence of a family that turns its demise into a combat maneuver. It utilizes the 'bullet' and 'fire/launch' motifs to express a 'combat' action triggered upon death (the 'zombie' motif of rising/falling). It avoids all anti-motifs by focusing on the offensive discharge rather than protection or cultivation.

draft.flavor: When the line is struck, the cold bites back through the very impact that landed.
draft.name: Frostbound Retaliation
draft.rationale: The action uses the 'Retribution' atom to reflect damage back at the attacker, fulfilling the 'defense' category and 'single' target mode. By reflecting damage, it creates the necessary conditions for 'chill-punisher' to trigger on the attacker, acting as its enabler. It avoids all anti-motifs and adheres to the constraint of expressing the family's combat-oriented nature without naming specific species or using forbidden atoms.

draft.flavor: A relentless barrage of projectiles that seeks out the decaying, turning every wound into a spreading blight.
draft.name: Rotting Volley
draft.rationale: The action represents a multi-target support volley (发射/子弹) that targets allies (Relation: ally) to bolster their combat effectiveness (作战) by punishing those already afflicted by rot (atom.rot-punisher). It captures the essence of a lineage that thrives on the cycle of decay and growth (向日葵/僵尸/变心) without violating anti-motifs.

draft.flavor: The lineage surges forward, a tide of relentless motion that turns every skirmish into a coordinated assault.

draft.rationale: The action focuses on the 'movement' category by increasing the speed of the zombie advance (tempo-surge), representing the collective momentum of the family. It avoids all anti-motifs and uses only the permitted atom family to enable the target's specific synergy.

draft.flavor: A sudden, rhythmic discharge that echoes the relentless advance of the lineage.
draft.name: Volley of the Unyielding
draft.rationale: The action captures the essence of a coordinated, projectile-based offensive characteristic of the family. It utilizes 'volley' to represent the rapid firing of 'bullets' (子弹/发射) and 'death-salvo' to represent the explosive, final 'combat' (作战) nature of the 'undead' (僵尸) lineage upon their fall, without specifying a single species or violating anti-motifs.

draft.flavor: The luminary erupts in a blinding burst of pure light, searing the essence of all nearby foes.
draft.name: Radiant Flare
draft.rationale: The action targets enemies with a burst of light (光照) that serves as a payoff for freezing targets, specifically amplifying damage against those already chilled.

draft.flavor: The luminary emits a blinding pulse of pure light, washing over itself to fortify its essence against the coming storm.
draft.name: Luminous Radiance
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer of elemental resistance (atom.elemental-defense) through a burst of light (光照), serving as a self-buff to protect the luminary.

draft.flavor: The luminary casts a brilliant glow that seeps into the wounds of allies, turning their afflictions into fuel for a revitalizing brilliance.
draft.name: Luminescent Radiance
draft.rationale: The action provides a support-based payoff for allies suffering from rot, blight, or venom. By illuminating the afflicted, the luminary amplifies the effectiveness of the rot-punisher motif, ensuring that the presence of decay in the army is met with a restorative, brilliant surge of energy.

draft.flavor: The luminary shifts through a spectrum of brilliance, leaving a trail of searing light that marks the unworthy for the rot to claim.
draft.name: Radiant Translocation
draft.rationale: The action facilitates movement (translocation) while expressing the 'luminary' motif through light. By moving through the area, the creature leaves a lingering presence that enables the rot-punisher effect on targets caught in its wake.

draft.flavor: A sudden, blinding burst of brilliance that sears the senses and leaves a lingering glow upon the foe.
draft.name: Radiant Flare
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'Elemental Power' family to represent the 'Luminary' family's core essence of light. By applying a surge of elemental power to an enemy, it fulfills the 'status' category and 'enemy' relation while embodying the 'light' (光照) motif through a high-intensity elemental burst.

draft.flavor: The descent begins with a rhythmic, mechanical churning, a grinding of gears and bone that turns the very air into a vortex of destruction.
draft.name: 螺旋桨 (Propeller) Descent
draft.rationale: The action functions as a mechanical payoff for frozen targets. It utilizes the 'Propeller' motif to describe a spinning, grinding descent that acts as a 'Grindstone' (磨刀石) for the 'Hell' (地狱) of the battlefield. It is a 'Dreamed-of' (梦寐以求) execution for those caught in the frost, ensuring the carnage 'does not stop' (不住/不了) until the target is pulverized.

draft.flavor: The rhythmic churning of the family's collective movement creates a localized vortex, accelerating the spread of their inherent decay.
draft.name: 螺旋桨 (Propeller) Resonance
draft.rationale: As a support action designed to enable 'rot-punisher', this action utilizes the 'propeller' motif to create a multi-target area effect. It acts as a 'whetstone' (磨刀石) for the family's offensive capabilities, ensuring that allies hitting afflicted targets trigger maximum 'hellish' (地狱) damage through the synergy of blood, spores, venom, and withering.

draft.flavor: The creature aligns its internal currents, creating a localized field that draws the essence of the cold toward its core.
draft.name: Magnetic Polarize
draft.rationale: The action uses the magnetic motif to create a defensive polarization that prepares the target for a specific elemental reaction. By applying a chilling effect through a magnetic alignment, it enables the specific synergy required for the target's subsequent vulnerability.

draft.flavor: The family exerts a pull that draws the essence of the afflicted toward the core, amplifying the potency of their decay.
draft.name: Magnetic Resonance

draft.flavor: The creature's internal polarity shifts, drawing all nearby essence toward its core.

draft.flavor: The magnetophyta shift their internal polarity, drawing the essence of the light toward their core to pull the very air into a swirling vortex of attraction.

draft.rationale: As a movement action for the magnetophyta, this action uses magnetic force to pull targets into a central point, facilitating the 'attunement' of elemental power required to enable the rot-punisher effect. draft.flavor: The magnetophyta draw strength from the radiance of the stars, pulling the very essence of light into their core to fuel their growth.

draft.flavor: The creature absorbs the kinetic energy of its own movement, compressing its mass into a singular point before violently ejecting the stored force as a concentrated burst.

draft.flavor: The target's essence is drawn inward, condensing into a singular point of immense pressure before erupting in a violent release of energy.

draft.flavor: A freezing surge that amplifies the decay of those already afflicted.

draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'rot-punisher' payoff mechanism by applying a freezing flow that scales based on existing afflictions, representing the family's ability to manipulate both frost and decay across multiple targets.

draft.flavor: The manipulator commands a surging tide of frost, driving the frozen masses forward in a relentless, numbing wave.

draft.rationale: The action provides movement (Advance) by increasing the speed of the undead (tempo-surge) while applying freezing effects (chilling/flash-freeze) to create the 'ice flow' (冰流) motif. draft.flavor: A sudden surge of frost locks the enemy in a frozen moment.
draft.name: Glacial Stasis
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'freezing' and 'chill-punisher' atoms to express the family's core identity of frost manipulation and the tactical advantage of frozen targets, fulfilling the motifs of ice, freezing, and flow without naming a specific species.

draft.flavor: The marine releases a cloud of microscopic spores that settle upon allies, accelerating the spread of decay.

draft.flavor: A sudden, rhythmic release of fungal clouds that coats the battlefield in a lingering haze.

draft.rationale: The marine family's shared trait is the ability to spread fungal life through contact. This action utilizes the sporing atom to represent the biological mechanism of the mushroom motif, applying a status effect to an enemy upon impact.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic surge of life-force that accelerates the natural cycles of growth and decay.

draft.flavor: A layer of frost-hardened metal that crystallizes upon impact, turning the cold into a steadfast barrier.

draft.flavor: A sudden frost coats the metal, hardening the resolve of those nearby.

draft.flavor: The weight of the lineage shifts forward, a crushing momentum of unyielding metal.

draft.flavor: The target's very essence is transmuted into a rigid, unyielding lattice of metal.

draft.flavor: A strike that ripples through the commonality of existence, leaving an unknowable mark upon the many.

draft.flavor: A heavy, coordinated discharge from the rear ranks that propels projectiles with overwhelming force toward the enemy.

draft.rationale: The action targets enemies within a specified area, imposing a status that slows their movement (freezing/chilling) and decays their physical form (rotting/sporing) through a pervasive, spreading network.

It captures the essence of a disciplined, unstoppable vanguard (the 'officer' of the family) that moves with overwhelming momentum to ensure their blight-based retribution finds its mark.

draft.flavor: The target's frozen essence becomes a catalyst for a violent release of energy, turning their own structural integrity into a weapon against the surrounding world.
draft.name: Frost-Shatter Detonation
draft.rationale: This action functions as a payoff for freezing a target. Upon the target's destruction or a specific trigger, it releases an explosive burst of damage that affects the entire field, fulfilling the 'explosion' and 'world/field' motifs while scaling with the 'damage' and 'chill-punisher' mechanics.

draft.flavor: A frozen barrier that turns the momentum of the world against those who dare breach the line.
draft.name: Frostbound Bastion
draft.rationale: The action establishes a defensive layer that punishes attackers by applying a chill effect, setting up the prerequisite state for the target to receive increased damage from frost-based retribution.

draft.flavor: The horde surges forward, leaving a trail of decay in their wake.
draft.name: Rotting Advance
draft.rationale: As a movement-based action for the ordnance family, this triggers a surge of zombie movement across the entire field (全场/僵尸/世界), resulting in an explosive burst of damage (爆炸/伤害) that facilitates the application of rot for the rot-punisher pairing.

draft.flavor: When the horde reaches its zenith, the very fabric of the world erupts in a final, catastrophic release of energy.
draft.name: World-Ender's Detonation
draft.rationale: The action targets the entire field (全场/世界) upon the death of the horde (僵尸), triggering a massive explosion (爆炸) that deals heavy damage (伤害) to the current stage (关卡) via a death-triggered burst (deathblast) and a board-wide detonation (dooming).

draft.flavor: The pilot's cockpit vibrates violently as the internal temperature drops below critical levels, causing the organism to shudder uncontrollably before venting a freezing blast from its core.
draft.name: Internal Thermal Discharge
draft.rationale: The action describes a self-targeted attack where the organism's internal temperature (摄氏度) drops below (低于) a certain threshold, causing the pilot (驾驶员) in the cockpit (驾驶舱) to shake (浑身发抖) as they discharge a freezing effect (atom.chilling) from within (体内).

draft.flavor: The internal temperature drops, causing the core to shudder as it locks the physical form in a state of frozen preservation.
draft.name: Thermal Stasis
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the defensive concept of hardening through temperature regulation (Celsius/shuddering/internal/preservation), providing the necessary defensive stability to enable a frost-based offensive synergy.

draft.flavor: The air grows heavy and the temperature drops as the blight takes hold, turning the very essence of the enemy into a vessel for decay.
draft.name: Rotting Reckoning
draft.rationale: As an organic support family, this action amplifies the effectiveness of existing afflictions. It triggers when an enemy is already suffering from rot, causing their internal temperature to plummet and their body to tremble as the decay accelerates, ensuring the payoff for the enabler families is realized through increased damage against afflicted targets.

draft.flavor: The pilot's frantic rhythm vibrates through the cockpit, causing the entire vessel to shudder as it vents heat into the surrounding air.
draft.name: Internal Combustion
draft.rationale: The action targets an enemy by inflicting a status (Affliction) that represents the internal, vibrating heat of the organism's core, affecting the target's internal state through a shared biological/mechanical resonance.

draft.flavor: The biting chill of the frozen reaches finds its vengeance through the very frost that binds its victims.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: This action functions as a payoff for freezing targets. It directs a burst of elemental frost toward an enemy, increasing the potency of the chill effect and ensuring the frost's direction is locked onto the target's most vulnerable point.

draft.flavor: The swarm moves as a single, decaying pulse, weaving a pattern of rot through the ranks to amplify the corruption of the fallen.
draft.name: Blighted Synchrony
draft.rationale: This action functions as a multi-target support mechanism that synchronizes the movement and offensive output of the family. It directs the swarm to converge on targets afflicted by rot, creating a dense pattern of attacks that scales the effectiveness of the rot-punisher effect across the entire group.

draft.flavor: The collective momentum of the horde shifts toward a chosen vector, crushing all in its path.
draft.name: Directional Swarm Advance
draft.rationale: This movement action defines the family's collective behavior: they do not move as individuals, but as a shifting pattern of mass. By selecting a direction, the swarm reallocates its density (crowding) to create a forward surge, setting the stage for the rot-punisher to exploit the clustered targets.

draft.flavor: The collective consciousness shifts, channeling a singular, overwhelming intent toward the enemy.
draft.name: Swarm Directive
draft.rationale: The action establishes a pattern of movement and targeting that dictates how the entire family advances and allocates their focus. It uses the 'tempo-surge' to drive the advance, 'marking' to designate targets for the swarm, and 'shld-breach' to ensure the collective fire overcomes defenses.

draft.flavor: The cold does not merely bite; it strikes back through the very frost it leaves behind.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: This action functions as a payoff for the freezing family. It utilizes the retribution motif to ensure that when a target is frozen, any damage they deal to the parasite is reflected back, scaling with the potency of the frost.

draft.flavor: The parasite weaves its essence into the lifeblood of its hosts, ensuring that as they wither, the collective thrives.
draft.name: Symbiotic Spore-Link
draft.rationale: As a support-oriented parasite family, this action utilizes the 'sporing' and 'withering' atoms to create a multi-target effect. It transforms (变为) allies into a spreading network of flora (植物) that mimics the relentless advance of the undead (僵尸), specifically designed to trigger the payoff of 'rot-punisher' by ensuring targets are afflicted.

draft.flavor: Upon being struck, the host erupts in a cloud of infectious matter, propelling itself backward while coating the attacker in a spreading blight.
draft.name: Spore Rebound
draft.rationale: The action captures the essence of a parasite: it uses the host's physical trauma (retribution/rebound) to facilitate its own spread (sporing/blight). It moves the entity (rebound) and transforms the state of the target (becoming a host/infestation) to enable the rot-punisher motif.

draft.flavor: The host becomes a vessel for the spreading blight.
draft.name: Infection
draft.rationale: The action infests the enemy, turning them into a biological extension of the parasite. This represents the core identity of the family: the ability to transform hosts into sub-species or plant-like zombies that eventually burst or reflect damage back to the source.

draft.flavor: A rapid succession of frozen projectiles that shatters upon impact, leaving a jagged trail of ice.
draft.name: Frost-Bitten Volley
draft.rationale: The action involves a rapid discharge (发射) of projectiles that, upon contact (触感), erupt into jagged ice spikes (地刺) from the ground, specifically designed to maximize the effectiveness of chilling and freezing effects.

draft.flavor: When struck, the creature's surface erupts with jagged protrusions that lash out at the aggressor.
draft.name: Spiked Thorns
draft.rationale: The action expresses the family's defensive nature by using 'touch' (触感) to trigger a 'projectile' (发射) of 'spikes' (地刺) back at the attacker, fulfilling the 'retribution' atom family requirement.

draft.flavor: A rapid succession of projectiles that leaves a trail of jagged, infectious debris in their wake.
draft.name: Spore-Laced Volley
draft.rationale: The action utilizes '发射' (firing) via a volley of projectiles. These projectiles carry '触感' (tactile/contact) properties through the application of status effects like bloodletting and venom. The '地刺' (ground spikes/thorns) motif is expressed through the resulting area of effect where the projectiles impact, creating a hazardous terrain for enemies.

draft.flavor: The family launches a rapid succession of jagged projectiles that embed themselves into the ground or the target, leaving a trail of sharp obstacles in their wake.
draft.name: Spike Volley
draft.rationale: The action uses 'volley' to represent the rapid firing (发射) characteristic of the family. It uses 'terraforming' to represent the creation of ground spikes (地刺) upon impact. The 'tactile' (触感) element is expressed through the physical presence of the spikes left in the target's path, which serves as an enabler for 'rot-punisher' by ensuring the target remains in contact with the hazards.

draft.flavor: A rapid succession of projectiles that leaves a trail of jagged barbs in their wake.
draft.name: Spiked Volley
draft.rationale: The action utilizes '发射' (firing) through the 'atom.volley' mechanic, '地刺' (ground spikes) via 'atom.terraforming' to affect the terrain, and '触感' (tactile/impact) through the 'atom.shld-breach' mechanic which interacts with the physical presence of shields.

draft.flavor: The air turns frigid as the target's blood turns to ice, shattering their resolve.
draft.name: Sudden Frostbite
draft.rationale: This action targets the self to trigger a payoff against an enemy. By utilizing the freezing mechanic, it enables the chill-punisher bonus damage, representing the 'change of heart' (变心) from warmth to frost and the 'undead' (僵尸) nature of the cold stasis.

draft.flavor: The air grows heavy and stagnant as a numbing chill seeps from the decaying essence, freezing the very spirit of those caught in its wake.
draft.name: Frostbite Rot
draft.rationale: The action applies a state of rot that transitions into a freezing decay, embodying the shifting nature of the soul (变心) and the lingering presence of the undead (僵尸). It serves as a defensive enabler by layering status effects that facilitate the execution of chill-punisher.

draft.flavor: As the spirit wavers, the flesh unravels, leaving only the hunger of the restless behind.
draft.name: Fickle Decay
draft.rationale: The action targets allies to amplify the potency of existing afflictions (rot, bloodletting, spores, venom, withering) by instilling a sense of 'changing hearts' or 'unstable essence' in the battlefield. This serves as a mid-tier support payoff that scales the damage of status-driven combatants without providing direct protection or healing, adhering to the 'pepper' family's theme of spreading instability.

draft.flavor: As the heart turns, the flesh follows, leaving a trail of rot in its wake.
draft.name: Shifting Decay
draft.rationale: The action captures the 'changing heart' (变心) through the movement of a shifting, unpredictable advance (tempo-surge) and the 'zombie' (僵尸) essence through the application of rot (rotting). It serves as an enabler for rot-punisher by ensuring targets are afflicted as the family advances.

draft.flavor: The target's essence wavers between a hollow shell and a restless spirit, leaving them vulnerable to the rot that follows.
draft.name: Fickle Decay
draft.rationale: The action captures the 'change of heart' (变心) through the instability of the status and the 'zombie' (僵尸) motif by creating a lingering presence or a new entity upon the target's expiration or through the rot itself.

draft.flavor: The performer enforces a strict, frozen discipline upon the battlefield, ensuring every strike lands with the weight of an inescapable winter.

draft.flavor: The performer maintains a strict, unyielding posture, hosting a defensive ritual that hardens their presence against the coming storm.

This action serves as an enabler for 'chill-punisher' by providing the necessary defensive layer (via atom.ward-harden) to survive long enough to exploit frozen targets.

draft.flavor: A rigid, rhythmic ritual that amplifies the potency of every affliction spread across the battlefield.
draft.name: The Grand Ceremony
draft.rationale: The action functions as a structured, ceremonial payoff (举办/从事) that enforces a strict (严格) rhythmic pulse (一大跳) across the battlefield. It treats the afflicted targets and their lingering ailments as the essential components (东西) of the ritual, turning the presence of rot or venom into a synchronized surge of power for allies, effectively turning the battlefield into a choreographed dance of decay.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic, unyielding advance that ensures every strike carries the weight of decay.
draft.name: Rigid Rot-Dance
draft.rationale: The action describes a highly disciplined (严格) and rhythmic (举办/从事) movement pattern (一大跳) characteristic of a relentless, advancing horde (僵尸) that carries its burden (东西) into battle to ensure the effectiveness of their decay (rot-punisher).

draft.flavor: The entire congregation gathers to host a grim ceremony, ensuring every movement follows the rigid laws of the grave.
draft.name: Strict Ritual of the Unyielding Host
draft.rationale: The action represents a collective status where the family members perform a synchronized, rigid ritual (举办, 严格) that increases their collective resilience and advance (stalwart, arm-hardening, tempo-surge), embodying the relentless nature of a coordinated horde (僵尸, 一大跳).

draft.flavor: The photovore absorbs the intensity of the zenith, channeling a concentrated beam of searing light through its thorns to strike the enemy.

draft.flavor: When struck, the creature's skin hardens into jagged, light-infused needles that punish the aggressor.

draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'Retribution' atom to express the family's defensive nature.
