draft.flavor: When the light strikes, the thorns react, turning the radiance into a searing sting that punishes those already decaying.

It fulfills the 'support' category by acting as a payoff for allies who inflict rot, amplifying the damage dealt to those targets. It avoids all anti-motifs and adheres to the single-family constraint.

draft.flavor: The photovore lunges through the light, driving its jagged, sun-soaked protrusions into the target to leave a searing, festering wound.
draft.name: Solar Spikes
draft.rationale: The action describes a movement-based strike using jagged, cactus-like protrusions (仙人掌) that utilize light (光照) to inflict damage (伤害). By applying a status that increases damage against afflicted targets, it serves as the perfect enabler for the rot-punisher atom family.

draft.flavor: The photovore radiates a piercing, sun-drenched aura that punishes those who approach, turning its very presence into a jagged, luminous hazard.
draft.name: Solar Spines
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'sporing' to represent the spreading, prickly nature of the cactus motif and 'searing-strike' to represent the intense light/heat of the sun motif, resulting in damage (伤害) to enemies. draft.flavor: A flawless sequence of rapid fire that leaves nothing but destruction in its wake.

It utilizes the 'volley' and 'quickening' mechanics to satisfy the 'machine gun' and 'rapid fire' motifs, while 'precision' satisfies the 'sniper' and 'perfection' motifs. It functions as a high-tier offensive payoff that scales with the speed and accuracy of the user.

draft.flavor: A flawless barrage that leaves nothing but frost in its wake.

draft.flavor: The family unleashes a coordinated barrage, ensuring every strike lands with devastating precision upon those already weakened by their toxins or rot.

draft.flavor: A rapid-fire barrage of projectiles that saturates the battlefield, ensuring no target can evade the inevitable impact.

draft.flavor: The target is frozen in a crystalline lotus, their essence harvested as the frost shatters.

draft.flavor: The family unleashes a rapid succession of projectiles, each one designed to accelerate the spread of decay.
draft.name: Volley of Rot
draft.rationale: The action uses 'volley' to represent the 'bullet' (子弹) motif and 'making/manufacturing' (制成) the rapid sequence of attacks. It functions as an enabler for 'rot-punisher' by ensuring multiple hits occur to trigger and benefit from the 'rotting' status.

draft.flavor: The rhythmic percussion of production, forging projectiles to be unleashed upon the enemy.

draft.rationale: The action focuses on the 'manufacturing' (制成) of 'bullets' (子弹) to be used against an 'enemy' (Relation: enemy). draft.flavor: The cold grip of the grave turns the enemy's own chill against them.

draft.rationale: This action targets the self to trigger a payoff against enemies. It leverages the freezing/chill-punisher synergy, where the predator's own necrotic frost punishes those caught in the freeze.

draft.flavor: The very air around the fallen grows heavy and frigid, slowing the pulse of the living as the cold of the grave takes hold.

draft.flavor: The horde moves with a singular, rhythmic purpose, closing the distance through sheer, unyielding momentum.

The '概率' (probability) is inherent in the chance of each projectile successfully applying the status effects required to trigger the 'rot-punisher' payoff.

draft.flavor: The air thickens with a cloud of microscopic decay, ensuring that every strike carries the seeds of corruption.

draft.flavor: A high-density holographic shimmer that coats the ground, hardening into a dark, nut-like shell that amplifies the rot within.

draft.flavor: A swarm of projectiles rains down, each one carrying the weight of decay to bolster the fallen.

draft.flavor: A relentless tide of many, moving as one to consume all in their path.
draft.name: Overwhelming Swarm
draft.rationale: The action captures the essence of a 'swarm' (成群) and 'filling' (充满) the battlefield. It utilizes the 'zombie' (僵尸) motif through the 'summoner' atom, the 'pitcher' (投手) motif through the 'swiftness' of their advance/delivery, and the 'watermelon' (西瓜) motif via the 'rotting' status which implies a bursting, messy destruction of targets.

draft.flavor: The user erupts in a violent, pressurized blast of heat, projecting their internal fever outward to scorch everything in their path.
draft.name: Red-Hot Surge
draft.rationale: The action uses 'Red-Hot Surge' to represent the 'Red-Hot' (红温) state of the user. It involves a 'Blast' (喷射) of 'Flame' (火焰) that 'Applies' (施加) an elemental power boost (atom.elpw-overflow) to the user, fulfilling the requirement of a self-targeted attack that scales with the family's core identity.

draft.flavor: The air around the user shimmers and warps as they vent intense heat, creating a protective shroud of rising embers.
draft.name: Thermal Surge
draft.rationale: The action describes the 'pyro' family's defensive mechanism: venting heat (red temperature/thermal surge) via a jet (喷射) of flames (火焰) to apply (施加) elemental resistance (atom.elemental-defense) to themselves.

draft.flavor: A searing surge of heat that ignites the spirit of allies, fueling their potential through a rhythmic, burning intensity.
draft.name: Pyro Support Action
draft.rationale: The action applies a burning surge (喷射/火焰) to allies (Relation: ally), increasing their elemental power (atom.elpw-surfeit) and inducing a state of heightened heat (红温) to empower them (施加) in a multi-target area.

draft.flavor: The air ripples and ignites as a concentrated stream of heat erupts from the source, leaving a scorching trail in its wake.
draft.name: Thermal Surge
draft.rationale: The action describes a high-velocity projection of heat (喷射, 火焰) that applies a state of intense thermal energy (施加, 红温) to the target area, serving as a mid-tier movement-based offensive enabler.

draft.flavor: A searing torrent of heat that leaves the air trembling and the enemy's skin glowing with a feverish intensity.
draft.name: Red-Hot Jet
draft.rationale: The action describes a continuous jet (喷射) of flame (火焰) that applies (施加) a state of overheating (红温) to the enemy. It utilizes atom.elpw-surge to represent the escalation of elemental power inherent to the pyro family's status-based mechanics.

draft.flavor: A synchronized surge of steel and heraldry, marking the path for the coming tide.
draft.name: Trident's New Round: The Vanguard's Mark
draft.rationale: The action represents a collective charge where the family marks their enemies (marking) while reinforcing their own defenses (arm-plate) and increasing their striking power (might) to initiate a new wave of combat.

draft.flavor: The vanguard's helm catches the light as they signal the next wave of the assault.
draft.name: Trident's New Round
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive surge to the user, representing the collective strength of the raider family. It acts as a representative shield for their companions, preparing them for a new round of combat.

draft.flavor: The representative of the pack raises their trident, signaling a fresh wave of coordinated strikes for all who follow.
draft.name: A New Round of the Vanguard
draft.rationale: The action functions as a support mechanism that empowers allies (同行) by marking or preparing them for a fresh wave (新一轮) of attacks. It utilizes the representative (代表) to signal a tactical shift, where the trident (三叉戟) and helmet (头盔) motifs are integrated into the visual execution of the support buff, specifically designed to maximize the payoff of rot-punisher by ensuring afflicted targets are met with overwhelming force.

draft.flavor: A coordinated surge that marks the path for the rot to follow.
draft.name: Trident Advance
draft.rationale: The action facilitates a movement-based 'new round' of engagement, where the raider's 'trident' strike leaves a 'mark' (representing the path/companion) that allows the 'rot-punisher' to find its target. The 'helmet' and 'representative' motifs are expressed through the structural axes of the movement's impact.

draft.flavor: A rallying cry that marks the enemy for the coming onslaught.
draft.name: Standard of the Vanguard
draft.rationale: The action represents the collective identity of the raider family by marking an enemy for a new round of coordinated assault, utilizing the shared motif of the trident/standard to signal the group's presence.

draft.flavor: The raider descends with reckless abandon, striking from above to claim what is not theirs.
draft.name: Plunge of the Scavenger
draft.rationale: The action describes a high-risk descent (adventure/from the sky) that targets enemies to seize resources (theft/experience), utilizing the freezing mechanic to set up the payoff for chill-punisher.

draft.flavor: The raiders drop from the heavens, striking with sudden violence to claim what is not theirs.
draft.name: Plunderous Descent
draft.rationale: The action facilitates a high-impact movement from above (from heaven) that initiates a state of decay (rotting), setting the stage for the rot-punisher synergy. It captures the essence of a raid: the sudden arrival, the theft of vitality, and the chaotic experience of the descent.

draft.flavor: The raiders descend with a chaotic hunger, leaving a trail of rot and stolen vitality in their wake.
draft.name: Plunderer's Scourge
draft.rationale: The action captures the essence of a raider family by combining the 'summoner' motif (raising zombies/the fallen), 'rotting' (the status of the afflicted), and 'lifesteal' (the act of stealing life/resources). This represents the collective behavior of the family: descending upon targets to plunder their vitality and leave a wake of the undead.

draft.flavor: A heavy, metallic collision that reinforces the user's own defenses while shattering the enemy's resolve.
draft.name: Iron-Clad Impact
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'ironwork' and 'protection' motifs to describe a self-buffing attack. The user hardens their own plating (armour/metal) while the impact creates a chaotic, popping spray of debris (popcorn) that serves as a commonality for the family's heavy, industrial combat style.

draft.flavor: A heavy, metal-clad supply line that bolsters the front lines.
draft.name: Ironclad Provisions
draft.rationale: The action provides a shared defensive buff (防护力) to all allies (共同点) by deploying a heavy, metal-clad (铁制品) supply cart (手推车) that scatters protective debris (爆米花) to reinforce the army's plating (arm-plate, arm-riveting, arm-op).

draft.flavor: A heavy, metallic surge that carries the weight of a thousand rusted wheels, crushing everything in its path.
draft.name: Ironclad Momentum
draft.rationale: The action represents a heavy, rolling movement (handcart/ironwork) that provides defensive utility (protection/armor) while creating a shared momentum (commonality) that triggers explosive, popping effects (popcorn) upon impact, specifically enabling the rot-punisher by ensuring the target is caught in the heavy, crushing advance.

draft.flavor: The air turns frigid as the reanimated strike, turning the frozen stillness of their enemies into a shattering opportunity.
draft.name: Frostbite Reckoning
draft.rationale: The action targets an enemy to deliver increased damage specifically when they are already frozen, fulfilling the role of a payoff for the chill-punisher atom while requiring the freezing atom as an enabler. It captures the relentless, cold-driven nature of the family without specifying a single species or violating anti-motifs.

draft.flavor: The very air around the reanimated freezes, turning every strike into a numbing frost.
draft.name: Frostbite Chill
draft.rationale: The action applies a chill effect to the target, which serves as the necessary enabler for the atom.chill-punisher family's bonus damage. This is a core characteristic of this reanimated family's presence on the battlefield.

draft.flavor: The stench of decay ripples through the ranks, turning every wound into a spreading plague.
draft.name: Rotting Resonance
draft.rationale: As a support action for the zombie family, this action leverages the 'rotting' motif to amplify the effects of existing afflictions. It functions as a payoff for enemies already suffering from rot, venom, or spores, turning the collective decay of the horde into a synergistic force that strengthens the impact of their ailments on allies' foes.

draft.flavor: The collective weight of the fallen surges forward, a relentless tide of decaying muscle and bone.
draft.name: Lurching Advance
draft.rationale: The action provides a movement-based surge (tempo-surge) that characterizes the relentless, forward-driving nature of the zombie family, serving as a prerequisite to ensure they reach targets to apply rot-based effects.

draft.flavor: The very presence of the reanimated causes the air to thicken with the scent of decay, leaving a lingering corruption upon all they touch.
draft.name: Carrion Rot
draft.rationale: The action expresses the core essence of the 僵尸 (zombie) family through the application of rot and blight, which are universal traits of the reanimated dead, without specifying a single species or using forbidden motifs.

draft.flavor: The very air around the reanimated turns brittle and frigid, locking their movements into a frozen, unstoppable momentum.
draft.name: Frostbitten Rigor
draft.rationale: The action applies a chilling effect to the target, which serves as the necessary enabler for the chill-punisher atom family to trigger its bonus damage.

draft.flavor: The horde moves with a singular, rhythmic hunger, closing the distance with an inexorable momentum that leaves nothing untouched.
draft.name: Relentless Advance
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the core characteristic of the zombie family: their relentless, advancing movement. By utilizing the tempo and swiftness atoms, the action facilitates the 'advance' mechanic inherent to the family, serving as a mid-tier movement enabler that sets the stage for the rot-punisher synergy.

draft.flavor: The very air around the fallen grows heavy with the scent of decay, leaving a lingering sickness upon those who strike them.
draft.name: Rotting Affliction
draft.rationale: The action applies a status that combines the core identity of the family (decay/rot) with an increased potency of that affliction, ensuring the 'reanimated' nature is felt by the enemy through a persistent, worsening sickness.

draft.flavor: The cycle of the frost-bound harvest, where every frozen fragment is reclaimed to fuel a greater bloom.
draft.name: Reclamation
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff mechanism for the freezing/chill-punisher synergy. It recycles (回收) existing status effects or frozen states to fill (填充) the target with an ultimate (过究极) elemental surge, effectively converting (变为) the battlefield state into a high-impact card-like (卡牌) burst of power.

draft.flavor: The essence of the fallen is gathered, refined, and cast forward to fuel the next cycle of growth.
draft.name: Reclamation Surge
draft.rationale: This movement action allows the user to reposition by consuming existing resources (cards/status/essence) to fill a void, transforming the state of the battlefield to enable the specific potency of the rot-punisher motif.

draft.flavor: The cycle of the harvest is never truly broken; it only waits to be replayed.
draft.name: Reclamation Card
draft.rationale: The action functions as a status-based 'card' (卡牌) that, upon reaching a threshold (过究极), transforms (变为) the target's current elemental power into a specific value (overriding/filling), which is then recycled (回收) to replenish the user's resources or status (填充).

draft.flavor: The relic manifests a sequence of shifting, surreal geometries that freeze the target in a state of perpetual, distorted existence.
draft.name: Ritual of the Unchanging Form
draft.rationale: The action uses 'Elemental Attunement' to prepare the target for the 'Killing Frost' payoff. It expresses the family's motifs through the 'Form' (形式) of the ritual, the 'Strange' (怪异) geometry of the cards (卡牌), and the 'Unchanging' (不化) nature of the resulting frozen state, all while channeling the 'Path' (得道) of the elemental essence.

draft.flavor: The essence of the relic remains constant, even as the vessel decays.
draft.name: Unfading Form
draft.rationale: The action allows the user to move through the battlefield by manifesting their essence into a new form, leaving a trail of rot that empowers the rot-punisher effect. It captures the 'unfading' (不化) and 'form' (形式) motifs by allowing the user to shift their presence, and the 'strange/uncanny' (怪异) nature of their movement. By applying a state of decay to the area through which they move, it enables the rot-punisher atom family.

draft.flavor: The sudden release of stored energy shatters the frozen surface, turning a static chill into a violent explosion of heat.
draft.name: Thermal Rupture
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a reaction upon hitting an enemy. It utilizes the 'freezing' enabler to set up the 'chill-punisher' payoff, fulfilling the requirement of being a payoff for a specific atom while utilizing the family's shared motifs of attack and scorching/burning (烧焦) to achieve a thorough (彻底) effect.

draft.flavor: The remnant hardens its essence, turning the very air into a frozen barrier that punishes those who dare strike it.
draft.name: Frost-Bound Bulwark
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer (Shield Toughness) and a guarantee of evasion (Braced Footing) against elemental attacks, creating the necessary environmental and structural conditions to enable the chill-punisher pairing.

draft.flavor: The very presence of the swarm causes the air to thicken with decay, amplifying the potency of every affliction shared among the collective.
draft.name: Blighted Resonance
draft.rationale: As a support action designed to enable 'rot-punisher' and its related enabler families, this action focuses on the 'affliction' atom to ensure that any status applied by the family's members is amplified. It fulfills the 'support' role by enhancing the effectiveness of allies' debuffs, fulfilling the 'multi' target mode by spreading this potency across the battlefield.

draft.flavor: The remnant moves with a singular, devastating purpose, leaving a trail of ash and broken terrain in its wake to ensure no target can escape the rot.
draft.name: Scorched Pathfinding
draft.rationale: The action utilizes terraforming to scorch the terrain, creating a path of fire that renders movement impossible for others, while simultaneously applying rot to ensure any target caught in the wake is primed for the rot-punisher's devastation.

draft.flavor: The very ground erupts in a desperate, burning mimicry of the family's hunger, summoning a landscape of ash and fury to consume all who stand upon it.
draft.name: Call of the Scorched Terrain
draft.rationale: The action utilizes terraforming to alter the terrain, summoning effects to populate the area, and searing-strike to provide the offensive status. It captures the family's essence by turning the environment into a weaponized extension of their own biological/mechanical hunger.

draft.flavor: The collective advance of the swarm, crushing all resistance in a singular, unstoppable surge.
draft.name: Legion's Onslaught
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Surging Advance' to represent the 'Alpha' (first/leading) and 'Legion' (army) motifs through a coordinated, unstoppable movement. It fulfills the 'Deployment' (出动) and 'Indestructible/Unstoppable' (坚不可摧/无坚不摧) motifs by increasing the speed of the collective advance, turning the family into a relentless, crushing force.

draft.flavor: A synchronized surge of unyielding strength, where the legion moves as one to freeze the very air in defiance of all harm.
draft.name: Alpha Phalanx
draft.rationale: The action provides the defensive foundation (Armour Reinforcement) and the elemental setup (Freezing) required to enable the target atom (Chill Reckoning) for the entire family.

draft.flavor: The collective weight of the host surges forward, turning every wound into a fortification for the many.
draft.name: Legion's Unyielding Advance
draft.rationale: The action provides a collective defensive buff to the entire army (Resilience/Arm-hardening), embodying the 'Legion' and 'Indestructible' motifs. It serves as a support payoff by reinforcing the front line, allowing members of the family to endure the attrition required to apply their various afflictions.

draft.flavor: The legion moves as a single, unstoppable tide, crushing all resistance in its path.
draft.name: Phalanx Advance
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Tempo Surge' to represent the 'Alpha' movement of a 'Legion' in 'Deployment'. The 'Unstoppable' and 'Indestructible' motifs are expressed through the inherent momentum and structural cohesion of a massed advance that ignores individual limitations to act as a singular, crushing force.

draft.flavor: The collective weight of the host moves as a single, unstoppable force, crushing all resistance in its path.
draft.name: Legion's Unyielding Advance
draft.rationale: The action applies a massive defensive fortification to the entire group, embodying the 'Legion' and 'Indestructible' motifs through collective armor reinforcement, while the 'Unstoppable' and 'Deployment' motifs are expressed through the sheer scale of the status effect applied to the whole army.

draft.flavor: A sudden, frigid discharge that shatters the stillness of the battlefield.
draft.name: Frostbite Release
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's ability to discharge freezing energy. It serves as the necessary setup (freezing the target) to enable the payoff (increased damage against frozen targets), fulfilling the requirement of being the enabler for the chill-punisher payoff.

draft.flavor: When struck, the rider releases a burst of freezing energy that marks the attacker for a devastating frost-strike.
draft.name: Frost-Bound Retaliation
draft.rationale: The action functions as a defensive trigger (defense/self) that 'fires' (发射) a freezing effect upon being hit, which serves as the necessary enabler for the chill-punisher atom family.

draft.flavor: The rider unleashes a concentrated burst of corruption, ensuring that every strike carries the weight of decay to bolster the coming harvest.
draft.name: Blighted Volley
draft.rationale: This action serves as the multi-target support payoff for the rot-punisher motif. By firing a spread of afflictions, the rider ensures allies can capitalize on the increased damage dealt to targets already suffering from the family's signature ailments.

draft.flavor: A sudden burst of projectiles that leaves a lingering brand upon every enemy struck.
draft.name: Marking Volley
draft.rationale: The action combines the 'volley' (firing multiple projectiles) with 'marking' (applying a status to the target), fulfilling the '发射' (launch/fire) motif for the entire family while adhering to the status/offensive/enemy/mid-tier requirements.

draft.flavor: A surge of righteous fury that turns every strike into a crushing momentum, shattering the resolve of those who stand in the way of the inevitable.
draft.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
draft.rationale: The action represents the collective momentum of a family that gains strength from their relentless advance. By combining the ability to freeze targets with a specialized payoff for hitting frozen enemies, the action captures the 'all-in' spirit of a sudden charge (一鼓作气) and the relentless, unstoppable nature of a coordinated rush (橄榄球/僵尸) fueled by righteous indignation (愤愤不平) to ensure a fair and crushing resolution (公平).

draft.flavor: A sudden, forceful surge of collective resolve that hardens the spirit against the coming tide.
draft.name: Unyielding Momentum
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive surge (stalwart) that reflects the 'unyielding' and 'momentum' motifs. It represents the family's collective resilience and the 'all-in' nature of their defense, setting the stage for a counter-strike.

draft.flavor: The collective resentment of the fallen fuels a spreading decay, turning every wound into a catalyst for further corruption.
draft.name: Vengeful Rot
draft.rationale: The action targets multiple allies to distribute the weight of an affliction, ensuring that as one falls, the rot spreads to others in a shared, inevitable cycle of decay. It embodies the 'fairness' of the rot, the 'momentum' of the spread, and the 'resentment' of the afflicted.

draft.flavor: A sudden, unstoppable momentum that punishes the afflicted with overwhelming force.
draft.name: Unrelenting Surge
draft.rationale: The action provides a burst of movement and power (Surging Advance/Savagery) that acts as a catalyst for rot-based retribution. It captures the momentum of a rugby charge (橄榄球), the relentless advance of the undead (僵尸), the sudden burst of energy (一鼓作气), the righteous indignation of a counter-attack (愤愤不平), and the balanced distribution of force (公平) required to trigger the target's vulnerability.

draft.flavor: A surge of collective fury that refuses to be quelled, driving the horde forward with a singular, righteous purpose.
draft.name: Unstoppable Momentum
draft.rationale: The action captures the 'Stampede' essence (tempo-surge) to represent the 'all-in' momentum (一鼓作气) and the physical drive of a rugby charge (橄榄球). It reflects the relentless nature of the undead (僵尸) and the collective drive born from perceived injustice (愤愤不平/公平) as they push through obstacles to settle the score.

draft.flavor: The monarch commands the very air to freeze, turning the battlefield into a tomb of ice for those who dare defy the crown.
draft.name: Sovereign's Decree
draft.rationale: The action initiates a frost-based assault that punishes frozen targets, embodying the 'royalty' through a command that makes resistance unnecessary and evokes the macabre themes of the family.

draft.flavor: The sovereign issues a command that turns the fallen into a vanguard for the crown.
draft.name: Royal Decree
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for rot-punisher by leveraging the 'zombie' and 'king' motifs to initiate a surge of support. It allows the user to 'initiate' a command where the 'unnecessary' (不用) fallen are repurposed, turning the 'Halloween' (万圣节) theme of the undead into a structural support mechanism for allies.

draft.flavor: The sovereign's command ripples through the ranks, turning the fallen into a relentless tide.
draft.name: Royal Decree
draft.rationale: The action represents the 'Royalty' of the family by issuing a command (发起/国王) that utilizes the dead (僵尸/万圣节) without requiring further input (不用), manifesting as a surge of summoned entities or a final, explosive discharge of the fallen (death-salvo).

draft.flavor: A measured observation that dictates the terms of engagement.
draft.name: Scholarly Precept
draft.rationale: The action establishes a scholarly condition where the target is treated as a subject of study; specifically, if the target is currently frozen, the user's subsequent strikes are empowered by the weight of their academic certainty.

draft.flavor: The scholar observes the spreading decay, identifying the precise moment where affliction yields its greatest potency.
draft.name: Scholarly Analysis
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for rot-punisher by amplifying the effectiveness of existing afflictions. It targets allies to provide a structural advantage, aligning with the 'scholar' archetype's role of enhancing the potency of status effects through calculated observation.

draft.flavor: The scholar presents a thesis so undeniable that the enemy's very existence becomes a secondary concern, a mere footnote in a much larger argument.
draft.name: Scholarly Discourse
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Foregone Verdict' to represent the scholar's ability to dictate the terms of engagement. By setting a fixed critical rate, the scholar imposes their intellectual authority (status) upon the enemy, treating the combat as a predetermined conclusion to a logical argument.

draft.flavor: The creature ruptures its own hardened exterior, releasing a dense cloud of seeds and thorns that absorb the impact of the strike.
draft.name: Verdant Shellburst
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a defensive payoff. It utilizes 'fortitude' and 'arm-plate' to represent the 'nut/shell' (坚果) and 'damage absorption' (承伤) motifs, while 'sporing' provides the 'plant' (植物) and 'mass/abundance' (大量) motifs through the release of many seeds. The 'fusion' (融合) is expressed through the integration of the shell's essence into the released spores.

draft.flavor: When struck, the creature absorbs the impact into its fibrous layers, merging the kinetic force with its internal sap to weave a dense, protective thicket of nutrients.
draft.name: Verdant Fusion
draft.rationale: This action enables 'chill-punisher' by providing the defensive sustain and structural integrity required to survive long enough to apply freezes. It utilizes the 'sust-husk' and 'mending' mechanics to address '承伤' (damage taken) through '融合' (merging/fusing) of incoming force into '大量' (large amounts) of '植物' (plant/fibrous) based recovery or shielding.

draft.flavor: A sudden, violent eruption of flora that feeds on the decay of the fallen.
draft.name: Overgrowth Infestation
draft.rationale: This action triggers when an afflicted target is defeated, causing a massive burst of seeds and vines to erupt from their remains. These botanical growths fuse with the surrounding terrain, creating a dense thicket that provides a shield to all nearby allies and grants them a portion of the damage they take as health regeneration. This fulfills the 'support' role by protecting the army through the 'plant' and 'fusion' motifs, utilizing 'large amounts' of 'nutrients' (seeds/vines) to mitigate 'damage taken' via 'growth'.

draft.flavor: A sudden, overwhelming burst of growth that carries the weight of the forest's fury.
draft.name: Verdant Surge
draft.rationale: The action represents a sudden, massive release of organic matter (大量, 植物) that fuses with the environment (融合) or the self. It utilizes the seeds/nut-like properties of the family (坚果) to react to damage taken (承伤), triggering a movement-based spread of spores or growth.

draft.flavor: The target is consumed by a massive, rapid surge of botanical matter that fuses with their very essence, causing them to endure heavy damage as the growth takes hold.
draft.name: Overgrowth Fusion
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'sporing' to represent the massive influx of plant matter (植物, 大量), 'mending' and 'vitality' to represent the fusion of life force (融合), and the resulting damage/shielding mechanics to represent the physical toll and the hard, nut-like shell of the growth (坚果, 承伤).

draft.flavor: A dense, shifting mass of bodies that piles high to absorb the impact of the world, wrapping around the core in a rhythmic, dancing formation of protection.
draft.name: The Swarming Bulwark
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'arm-hardening' to provide the structural defense required by the 'defense' category, 'shld-surge' to allow the 'pile' of bodies to expand its capacity, and 'sust-husk' to represent the constant, rhythmic replenishment of the mass. This creates a defensive 'sculpture' of layered, regenerating entities that act as a single, undulating wall.

draft.flavor: The family moves as a single, undulating mass, layering themselves over the battlefield to ensure every strike carries the weight of the whole.
draft.name: Enveloping Swarm
draft.rationale: The action allows the family to 'wrap' or 'pile' around targets, creating a rhythmic, dancing movement that ensures the 'rotting' status (the enabler) is applied with overwhelming consistency through sheer mass and layering.

draft.flavor: The family gathers in a rhythmic, unsettling dance, piling their collective weight and discarded remnants into a growing mound to overwhelm the foe.
draft.name: Ritual of the Swarming Heap
draft.rationale: The action captures the essence of the family's 'sculpture' by combining the concept of a growing, rhythmic mass (伴舞, 堆起来) with the physical manifestation of their presence (包裹, 小沙兽) and their nature as a collective force (僵尸). It utilizes 'Summoner' to represent the proliferation of members, 'Shield Surge' to represent the expanding physical volume/protection of the pile, 'Tempo Surge' to represent the rhythmic dance, and 'Rot Punisher' to represent the status-based decay inherent to the family's nature.

draft.flavor: A sudden eruption of frozen shards that scatters across the battlefield, seeking out those already numbed by the cold.
draft.name: Glacial Volley
draft.rationale: The action performs a mass projection (大量/投掷) of frozen projectiles (冰环) that summons (召唤) frost-based effects (冰神瓜) upon impact. It functions as the primary payoff for atom.chill-punisher by ensuring targets are subjected to the freezing status (atom.freezing) required to trigger the bonus damage.

draft.flavor: The creature shatters its own frozen essence, launching a massive swarm of crystalline shards that orbit the target in a freezing whirlwind.
draft.name: Glacial Ring Volley
draft.rationale: The action utilizes '投掷' (throw) and '大量' (large amount) to describe the 'Volley' of shards. The '冰环' (ice ring) is expressed through the orbital movement around the target. '召唤' (summon) is represented by the creation of the shards/entities, and '冰神瓜' (ice god melon/core) is the source of the shattered essence. It acts as an enabler for 'atom.chill-punisher' by applying the necessary frozen status to the target.

draft.flavor: A sudden deluge of frozen shards that coats allies in a protective frost.
draft.name: Glacial Volley
draft.rationale: The action involves the mass throwing of frozen objects (ice rings/melons) that spawn frost-based utility or offensive status effects on allies, fulfilling the support role through area-of-effect frost application.

draft.flavor: A sudden eruption of frost and life, scattering frozen seeds across the battlefield.
draft.name: Glacial Bloom Surge
draft.rationale: The action triggers a massive (大量) projection (投掷) of frozen, melon-like shards (冰神瓜) that form expanding frost rings (冰环) upon impact. This movement-based surge (elpw-surge) leaves behind a multitude of frozen seeds that blossom into new entities (召唤) upon contact with the ground.

draft.flavor: A sudden, overwhelming surge of frost that consumes the battlefield.
draft.name: Glacial Torrent
draft.rationale: The action invokes a massive surge of elemental power (elpw-surfeit) that manifests as a volley (volley) of frozen projectiles (freezing) which, upon impact, summon (summoner) a multitude (大量) of frost-rings (冰环) to freeze the enemy.

draft.flavor: The seedling tightens its outer layer, turning its very skin into a weapon of impact.
draft.name: Hardened Shell
draft.rationale: This action targets the self to trigger a defensive reaction that punishes enemies. By hardening its shell (坚果/Nut), the seedling creates a physical impact that interacts with the freezing state of an enemy, fulfilling the requirement of being a payoff for atom.chill-punisher and an enabler for the freezing mechanic.

draft.flavor: The seedling's protective casing hardens, preparing to withstand the frost.
draft.name: Hardened Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides resistance to elemental critical hits, which serves as a defensive enabler for the chill-punisher motif by ensuring the target survives long enough to be frozen or by protecting the user from frost-based retaliation.

draft.flavor: The seedling shatters its hard casing to release a concentrated surge of essence, fueling the growth of those nearby.
draft.name: Nutrient Burst
draft.rationale: The action represents the 'seedling' stage of the family, where the protective shell (nut/坚果) is broken to provide support to allies. By releasing the contents of the shell, it acts as a payoff for enemies already afflicted by the enabler families (bloodletting, spores, venom, or withering), turning the target's decay into a restorative burst for the ally group.

draft.flavor: The seedling's outer layer thickens, turning into a protective casing that resists the impact of the world.
draft.name: Hardened Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive increase to carapace, representing the hardening of a nut-like shell common to the entire family of seedlings.

draft.flavor: The target's own stillness becomes a weapon, as the cold stillness of the grave erupts from within.
draft.name: Rigor Mortis
draft.rationale: This action targets the self to trigger a burst of frozen energy (发射) that punishes enemies already afflicted by the cold, mimicking the sudden, violent release of energy seen in a reanimated corpse (僵尸).

draft.flavor: Upon the fall of a fallen, the lingering essence erupts in a final, frost-laden discharge.
draft.name: Undead Volley
draft.rationale: The action triggers upon the death of a member (zombie motif), discharging a burst of projectiles (发射 motif) that applies a freezing status, thereby enabling the specific synergy with atom.chill-punisher.

draft.flavor: The family releases a wave of necrotic energy, turning fallen foes into a relentless tide of mindless soldiers.
draft.name: Undead Volley
draft.rationale: The action combines the 'volley' (发射) of projectiles with the 'summoner' (僵尸) aspect, allowing the family to discharge multiple entities or projectiles that manifest as undead, serving as a perfect enabler for rot-punisher by increasing the number of targets afflicted.

draft.flavor: A sudden discharge of necrotic energy that leaves a trail of restless spirits in its wake.
draft.name: Undead Volley
draft.rationale: The action uses the 'summoner' atom to fulfill the 'zombie' motif by spawning entities, and the 'volley' concept (implied by the 'launch/fire' motif) to satisfy the '发射' requirement, creating a status-based offensive discharge.

draft.flavor: The seeker burrows through the layers of the world, driven by an insatiable hunger for what lies beneath.
draft.name: Deep Digging
draft.rationale: The action represents the seeker's core drive to unearth hidden value. By focusing on the 'chill-punisher' payoff, the seeker's frantic, head-down search (burying themselves in the task) results in a devastating strike against those frozen in their path, treating the enemy as a mere obstacle to the treasure they seek.

draft.flavor: The seeker remains motionless, head bowed, as the earth itself rises to shield them, waiting for the moment to strike.
draft.name: Buried Treasure
draft.rationale: The action represents the 'seeker' family's defensive posture: burying themselves (埋头) like a tuber (土豆) to protect their hidden wealth (宝藏/寻找) while being busy (忙于) preparing a frozen trap (atom.chilling) for those who approach.

draft.flavor: The seeker's frantic digging unearths a hidden cache, nourishing their allies with the spoils of the earth.
draft.name: Buried Bounty
draft.rationale: The action represents the 'seeker' family's core identity: the act of burying one's head (埋头) and being busy (忙于) searching (寻找) for treasures (宝藏) like tubers (土豆) to support their allies. It serves as a payoff for rot-punisher by rewarding the application of afflictions with a burst of utility/support.

draft.flavor: The seeker plunges into the earth, unearthing hidden riches through relentless toil.
draft.name: Buried Bounty
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's core drive to dig, search, and toil (埋头, 寻找, 忙于) to uncover what is hidden (宝藏) within the soil (土豆), acting as a prerequisite to trigger the rot-punisher effect.

draft.flavor: The seeker's obsession drives them to unearth what is hidden, leaving nothing but the spoils behind.
draft.name: Buried Treasure
draft.rationale: The action represents the 'seeker' family's core drive: the frantic, single-minded pursuit of value. By utilizing the 'Rot Bounty' atom, the action captures the essence of 'searching' (寻找) and 'being busy' (忙于) with the task of 'unearthing' (埋头) the 'treasure' (宝藏) or 'spoils' (土豆/metaphorical yield) from the fallen.

draft.flavor: A sudden, frigid eruption that punishes those who dare strike the sentinel.
draft.name: Frostback Retaliation
draft.rationale: The action triggers upon being struck (retaliation/counter-attack), releasing a burst of frost that freezes the attacker and sets up a massive damage payoff for any subsequent chill-punisher effects.

draft.flavor: When struck, the sentinel releases a freezing cloud of spores that punishes those who dare approach.
draft.name: Frost-Burst Retaliation
draft.rationale: The action triggers a defensive reaction (retaliation/counter-attack) upon being hit, releasing a spray (jet/burst) of spores (spores) that creates a cloud (smoke/mist) and applies a freezing (cold) effect to the attacker, setting up the conditions for chill-based punishment.

draft.flavor: A thick, swirling haze of infectious particles that coats allies in a layer of reactive essence.
draft.name: Spore Cloud
draft.rationale: The action releases a cloud of spores (孢子) via a sudden burst (喷射) that creates a lingering haze (烟雾). This fulfills the 'support' role by providing a multi-target area effect that enables the 'rot-punisher' payoff for allies by applying the necessary afflictions.

draft.flavor: The sentinel erupts in a sudden, pressurized burst of particulate matter, coating the immediate area in a thick, choking haze that clings to everything it touches.
draft.name: Spore Cloud Volley
draft.rationale: The action uses '喷射' (jet/spray) and '烟雾' (smoke/haze) to describe the movement of the '孢子' (spores) and '寒冷' (cold) particles through the air. It functions as a mid-tier movement-based area effect that enables 'atom.rot-punisher' by applying the necessary status effects to targets within the cloud.

draft.flavor: Upon being struck, the sentinel releases a freezing cloud of spores that retaliates against the aggressor.
draft.name: Reactive Spore Burst
draft.rationale: The action triggers a 'retaliation' (反击) via a 'spray' (喷射) of 'spores' (孢子) that applies a 'cold' (寒冷) status to the attacker. It utilizes the sporing, chilling, and retribution atom families to define the mechanic without specifying a single species or using forbidden numbers.

draft.flavor: As the target freezes, the sentry's jagged exterior erupts with crystalline spikes, shattering the frost to deal massive damage.
draft.name: Frost-Bound Thorns
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a reaction against an enemy. It utilizes the 'planting' of frost/spikes (种植) and the 'piercing' of the target (刺上) to deliver 'damage' (伤害) that is 'carried' (对载) through the 'specialized' (具特) interaction between freezing and the punisher effect.

draft.flavor: The sentry's defensive posture becomes a frozen thicket, punishing those who dare strike its surface.
draft.name: Frost-Bound Thorns
draft.rationale: The action provides the necessary 'chill' status to enable the 'chill-punisher' pairing. It expresses the family's defensive nature through a reactive, thorny mechanism that inflicts damage and applies a specific status upon being struck.

draft.flavor: The sentry lunges forward, trailing a cloud of infectious spores that settle into the soil and cling to the wounded.
draft.name: Spore-Laden Surge
draft.rationale: This movement action uses 'sporing' and 'rotting' to fulfill the family's requirement of planting (种植) and inflicting damage (伤害) via a specialized (具特) coating (刺上) that carries (对载) the rot. It acts as a mid-tier enabler for rot-punisher by ensuring targets are afflicted upon the sentry's advance.

draft.flavor: The shambler hurls its entire weight forward, grinding through the target like a blade through tall grass.
draft.name: Lawnmower Charge
draft.rationale: The action uses the 'shambler's' momentum (前进/橄榄球) to turn their own body (利用自身) into a blunt, grinding force (除草机) that strikes with primal hunger (僵尸/savagery). It functions as a mid-tier attack that scales with the creature's own physical momentum.

draft.flavor: The shamblers surge forward, their heavy, grinding bodies acting as a living barrier that punishes those who stand in their path.
draft.name: Lawnmower Charge
draft.rationale: The action uses 'Surging Advance' (tempo-surge) to represent the '前进' (advance) and '橄榄球' (football/charge) motifs. The 'shamblers' use their own mass ('利用自身') to act as a '除草机' (lawnmower/grinder) against enemies, embodying the '僵尸' (zombie/shambler) nature of a relentless, crushing defense.

draft.flavor: The shamblers surge forward, using their own weight to crush obstacles and bolster the advance of those behind them.
draft.name: Horde Momentum
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'shambler' motif of relentless forward movement (前进) and physical mass (橄榄球/利用自身) to act as a living lawnmower (除草机) for the horde (僵尸). By utilizing their own bodies to clear a path, they provide a support-based tempo boost to allies, fulfilling the 'Surging Advance' mechanic.

draft.flavor: The shamblers surge forward, using their own weight to crush anything in their path.
draft.name: Relentless Momentum
draft.rationale: The action describes a charging movement (橄榄球/前进) where the creature uses its own mass (利用自身) to plow through targets like a lawnmower (除草机), which is the quintessential behavior of a shambling horde (僵尸). By applying atom.rotting, the movement ensures that the target is afflicted, thereby enabling the specific synergy with atom.rot-punisher.

draft.flavor: A dark, glass-like hardening that rises from the surface, turning the body into a high, unyielding fortress.
draft.name: Obsidian Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer of high, hard, obsidian-like plating (arm-plate) that serves as a prerequisite for the target to be frozen and subsequently punished by chill-punisher.

draft.flavor: The family hardens their exterior into a dark, jagged casing, providing a sturdy foundation for their allies to stand upon.
draft.name: Obsidian Nut-Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive buff (armour reinforcement) to the entire army, fulfilling the 'support' and 'multi' requirements. It utilizes the 'sturdy' and 'defensive' nature of the family's shell (nut/hard/obsidian) to create a high-standing defensive perimeter for allies.

draft.flavor: A sudden, jagged eruption of volcanic glass that hardens into an impenetrable, towering barrier.
draft.name: Obsidian Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive status (Armour Reinforcement) that embodies the family's shared traits: the hardness and obsidian-like quality of a shell, the height of a defensive wall, and the nut-like protective layer.

draft.flavor: The fury of the frozen horde manifests as a biting, crystalline backlash.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a retaliatory effect. When an enemy strikes, the user's fury and frozen essence (ice mushrooms/high frost) erupt, dealing bonus damage to the attacker if they are already frozen, fulfilling the payoff for the chill-punisher/freezing synergy.

draft.flavor: A defensive stance that hardens the shell against the elements, preparing the body to punish those who dare strike with frost.
draft.name: Frostbound Bulwark
draft.rationale: The action provides elemental resistance and shield toughness, serving as a defensive enabler that allows the user to withstand hits to set up a chill-based retaliation.

draft.flavor: The fury of the swarm amplifies the rot within.
draft.name: Blighted Resonance
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for rot-punisher by scaling the effectiveness of afflictions applied to targets, specifically targeting allies to bolster their presence through the shared essence of the family's decay and fury.

draft.flavor: A sudden, violent eruption of decay that propels the swarm forward.
draft.name: Rancid Surge
draft.rationale: The action uses the 'rotting' atom to enable 'rot-punisher' by ensuring targets are afflicted. The movement aspect is expressed through a surge of necrotic energy that propels the user, capturing the 'angry' and 'zombie' essence of the family without specifying a single species.

draft.flavor: The target is struck by a concentrated beam of pure radiance, accelerating the process of photosynthesis to a violent, explosive degree.
draft.name: Solar Flare
draft.rationale: The action uses 'searing-strike' to represent the offensive 'solar' energy (sunlight/heat) and 'flourishing' to represent the 'production' motif, creating a mid-tier attack that scales with the target's state.

draft.flavor: The brilliance of the sun coalesces into a protective aura, fueling the growth of the soul while hardening the spirit against the coming frost.
draft.name: Solar Radiance
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the solar family's core identity: the conversion of light into vital production. By generating sun through the act of defense, the creature embodies the cycle of solar energy. This provides the necessary 'sun' resource required to enable the frost-based mechanics of the target atom.

draft.flavor: As the light intensifies, the rot begins to bloom.
draft.name: Solar Harvest
draft.rationale: The action provides a payoff for the Rot Punisher family by converting the presence of decay into a surge of solar energy, effectively 'producing' light from the afflicted.

draft.flavor: The solar essence radiates outward, nourishing the soil to accelerate the cycle of growth and decay.
draft.name: Photosynthetic Bloom
draft.rationale: The action enables the rot-punisher motif by ensuring the target is consistently afflicted through rapid, sun-driven production cycles. It focuses on the movement of energy (sunlight) into tangible growth (production) to set the stage for subsequent decay-based damage.

draft.flavor: The enemy is bathed in a blinding radiance that accelerates the cycle of growth and consumption.
draft.name: Solar Harvest
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the production of sun through the presence of light, capturing the essence of the solar family's ability to generate resources via their thematic connection to sunlight.

draft.flavor: The veteran soldier's instinctual reflex: a flurry of strikes that turns a defensive stance into a winning streak.
draft.name: Champion's Habitual Retaliation
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'habitual' nature of a soldier to trigger a flurry of attacks (snowballing/打雪仗) when an enemy is frozen, rewarding the 'champion' (蝉联冠军) for maintaining a defensive 'shield' (持盾者) through repetitive, practiced motions (习惯) to ask 'is there any' (有没有) weakness left in the foe.

draft.flavor: The unwavering rhythm of a defender who has held the line through countless seasons, turning every impact into a familiar cadence of survival.
draft.name: Champion's Habitual Guard
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the 'habitual' (习惯) and 'champion' (蝉联冠军) nature of the defender (持盾者). By utilizing Shield Cycling and Callusing, the soldier creates a rhythmic, repetitive defensive loop—much like the repetitive motion of a snowball fight (打雪仗)—ensuring they always have the means to endure (有没有) the onslaught.

draft.flavor: The relentless rhythm of the vanguard, where every strike carries the weight of a thousand victories.
draft.name: Champion's Habit
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for rot-punisher by ensuring that the presence of an afflicted target triggers a heightened response. It utilizes the 'habit' of the soldier to maintain a 'champion's' momentum, effectively turning the 'shield-bearer's' defensive stance into an offensive cycle of 'snowballing' (snowball fight) damage against those already weakened by rot.

draft.flavor: The rhythmic, practiced motion of a veteran who has held the line through countless seasons, turning every strike into a repetitive ritual of conquest.
draft.name: Champion's Habit
draft.rationale: The action establishes a repetitive, ritualistic movement (Habit/Champion) that applies a status effect (Blight) to prepare the target for the specific damage multiplier of the target atom (Rot Punisher). It captures the 'snowball' essence of a champion's streak and the defensive posture of a shield-bearer.

draft.flavor: As the trident strikes, the drowning masses surge forth, an endless tide of righteous fury that marks the fall of the unworthy.
draft.name: Rising Tide of the Nameless
draft.rationale: The action represents the collective surge of an army (义军) that rises up (揭竿而起) like an unstoppable tide (源源不绝/不可胜计). It utilizes the trident (三叉戟) as the instrument of the sovereign to drown the enemy (溺水者) in a wave of frost, turning the frozen into a historical footnote (史望/史望者) through the synergy of freezing and the subsequent punishment of the cold.

draft.flavor: As the names of the fallen are etched into the annals of history, their legacy becomes a barrier that no tide can wash away, turning every strike against the righteous into a frozen monument of retribution.
draft.name: The Unyielding Tide
draft.rationale: The action establishes a defensive presence that ensures the target is perpetually chilled, thereby enabling the 'Frost Reckoning' effect for the family's sovereign. It captures the essence of an unstoppable, historical momentum (the 'unyielding tide') that marks the battlefield with the names of those who rose up.

draft.flavor: As the righteous rise, their legacy flows through the ranks, turning every struggle into a source of inexhaustible strength for the cause.
draft.name: The Unending Uprising
draft.rationale: The action provides a support-based payoff for targets already afflicted by the enabler families. It represents the 'unending' nature of the uprising by converting the presence of these statuses into a cascading, multi-target benefit for allies, mirroring the 'rising up' (揭竿而起) and 'inexhaustible' (源源不绝) motifs.

draft.flavor: A relentless surge of presence that drowns the opposition, marking the rise of a name that cannot be erased from history.
draft.name: The Unending Tide
draft.rationale: The action represents a status-based offensive pressure where the target is overwhelmed by an accumulating, uncountably vast force (源源不绝, 不可胜计). It functions as a 'rising tide' (溺水者) that marks the target (名姓, marking) for a historical reckoning (史望者, 史望), signifying the inevitable uprising (揭竿而起, 义军) of the family's influence.

draft.flavor: The sound of a strike lingers, vibrating through the air to find its mark.
draft.name: Echoing Resonance
draft.rationale: The action creates a lingering resonance (余音) that allows for a subsequent strike to find its target (倾听/传唱), specifically designed to amplify the effectiveness of chilling effects (atom.chilling) for the specialist.

draft.flavor: The sound of decay is not a silence, but a rhythmic, spreading resonance that amplifies the potency of every blight it touches.
draft.name: Echoing Rot
draft.rationale: The action functions as a resonance for the rot-punisher payoff. It amplifies the potency of existing afflictions (bloodletting, spores, venom, withering) by 'singing' or 'echoing' the decay across the target group, ensuring the specialist's debuffs reach their maximum structural potential.

draft.flavor: The air vibrates with a lingering cadence, amplifying the weight of every strike.
draft.name: Echoing Resonance
draft.rationale: The family's shared trait is the amplification and persistence of their presence. By utilizing 'Affliction', the action ensures that the status effects they impose are more potent, reflecting the 'Echoing' nature of their influence on the battlefield.

draft.flavor: The spectral essence surges through the vessel, hardening the spirit against the coming frost.
draft.name: 僵起
draft.rationale: The action '僵起' (Stiffen/Stiffen Up) represents the spectral family's ability to brace their ethereal forms. In this context, it acts as the self-buffing payoff that enables 'chill-punisher' by ensuring the user is prepared to exploit the 'freezing' status applied to enemies.

draft.flavor: The air curdles with a restless, translucent weight as the spectral essence hardens into a shimmering, unyielding barrier of frost-touched spirit.
draft.name: Spectral Phantasmagoria
draft.rationale: The action manifests a defensive surge of spectral energy that chills the surrounding atmosphere, creating a protective shield that grows in capacity as the spirit's fury intensifies, setting the stage for frost-based retribution.

draft.flavor: The air ripples with a hollow, rhythmic thrumming as the spectral presence synchronizes its essence with the suffering of those it has marked.
draft.name: Spectral Resonance
draft.rationale: As a support action for the spectral family, this resonance amplifies the potency of existing afflictions (the enabler families) by striking with a rhythmic, haunting force. It acts as the payoff for rot-punisher, turning the presence of blight or venom into a resonant surge of spectral energy that bolsters the collective through the shared suffering of the enemy.

draft.flavor: The target's essence hardens into a state of unyielding, petrified fury, making them susceptible to the crushing weight of the spectral tide.
draft.name: 僵起 (Rigid Rise)
draft.rationale: This action applies a status that increases the potency of all subsequent afflictions (affliction) while simultaneously granting the target a form of unyielding resistance (stalwart), capturing the essence of a creature that is both a rigid, unmoving obstacle and a vessel for growing, unstoppable fury.

draft.flavor: A heavy, unyielding presence that freezes the very flow of conflict, ensuring that those caught in its wake remain susceptible to the coming frost.
draft.name: Stagnant Decree
draft.rationale: The action provides the necessary 'chill' status required to enable the target for 'chill-punisher' (Frost Reckoning). It captures the '僵体' (corpse/stiff) and '为官' (official/decree) motifs through the concept of a rigid, authoritative freezing effect that halts movement and vitality.

draft.flavor: A relentless, systemic advancement that ensures the rot takes hold through sheer, inevitable momentum.
draft.name: The Unyielding Mandate
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Tempo Surge' to represent the unstoppable, rhythmic movement of a family defined by systemic expansion and inevitable decay. It captures the 'spirit' of a lineage that moves with the weight of bureaucracy (为官), the accumulation of wealth (富商), and the relentless, encroaching nature of a corpse (僵体) that refuses to be contained (不纳) and always follows in the wake of its predecessor (后入).

draft.flavor: A mandate of absolute authority that demands tribute and enforces the hierarchy of the unyielding.
draft.name: The Gilded Decree
draft.rationale: The action embodies the 'status' category by combining the authority of a ruler (为官/prec-verdict), the unyielding nature of a corpse/statue (僵体/arm-plate), the refusal to yield or accept loss (不纳/arm-plate), the accumulation of wealth (富商/econ-muster), and the imposition of order upon the fallen (后入/prec-verdict).

draft.flavor: As the curtain rises, the spitter unleashes a flurry of crimson petals that freeze the very air, turning the battlefield into a stage for the inevitable end.
draft.name: The Grand Performance
draft.rationale: The action triggers a burst of cherry blossoms (樱桃) that freeze the target (freezing/chill-punisher payoff), while the performance (上演) culminates in the summoning of a zombie (僵尸/summoner) from the site of the impact.

draft.flavor: As the curtain rises, the stage is set with a crimson bloom that freezes the very air, turning the battlefield into a macabre theater of frost and decay.
draft.name: The Grand Performance
draft.rationale: The action triggers a cherry bloom (樱桃) that, upon bursting, applies a freezing effect (freezing/chill-punisher enabler) to the target. The 'performance' (上演) is the theatrical burst of the bloom, and the 'zombie' (僵尸) motif is represented by the inevitable, cold stillness of the frozen target, setting the stage for the death-driven mechanics of the family.

draft.flavor: As the stage is set, the audience is forced to watch the rot bloom into a final, crimson spectacle.
draft.name: The Grand Performance
draft.rationale: The action triggers a burst of cherry-colored decay upon the death of an afflicted target, turning the battlefield into a stage of rot for the entire army to witness.

draft.flavor: A choreographed display of decay, where every movement is a rehearsed step toward a blooming, necrotic finale.
draft.name: The Grand Performance
draft.rationale: The action uses 'rotting' to represent the zombie motif and 'cherry bloom' to represent the cherry motif. The 'performance' aspect is captured by the movement-based 'Grand Performance' which acts as an enabler for the rot-punisher pairing.

draft.flavor: As the curtain rises, the stage is set with a flurry of petals and the relentless march of the undead.
draft.name: The Grand Performance
draft.rationale: The action integrates the 'Cherry Bloom' (樱桃) motif through the burst of petals, the 'Summoner' (僵尸) motif by raising undead from the fallen, and the 'Grand Performance' (上演) motif through the synchronized tempo shift that accelerates the advance of the horde.

draft.flavor: The very air around the fallen turns to jagged shards, punishing those who dare strike the frozen.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a retaliatory effect against enemies. It leverages the 'freezing' family to set up the condition, and the 'chill-punisher' family to provide the specific payoff, creating a cycle of frost-based vengeance characteristic of the family's theme.

draft.flavor: The very air around the shambling horde turns frigid, crystallizing the rot within their veins to harden their necrotic forms.
draft.name: Frostbound Decay
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer through hardened, frost-encrusted plating (arm-plate) while simultaneously applying a chilling effect (chilling) that enables the specific synergy required for the target atom.

draft.flavor: The stench of decay vibrates through the air, amplifying the potency of every affliction spread by the swarm.
draft.name: Rotting Resonance
draft.rationale: As a support action for the 'spore' family (the 僵尸 motif), this action acts as a payoff for 'rot-punisher'. It targets multiple allies to amplify the effectiveness of existing afflictions (bloodletting, spores, venom, or withering) already present on the battlefield, fulfilling the multi-target support role.

draft.flavor: The relentless, rhythmic shuffling of a thousand decaying limbs, closing the distance with inevitable momentum.
draft.name: Lumbering Advance
draft.rationale: The action provides a movement-based enabler for the 'rot-punisher' motif by increasing the speed of the zombie advance, ensuring the family can reach targets to apply the necessary afflictions.

draft.flavor: The fallen do not rest; they rise to serve the swarm.
draft.name: Reanimation
draft.rationale: The family motif '僵尸' (Zombie) implies a cycle of death and rising. The 'summoner' atom family allows members to spawn a zombie upon death or impact, capturing the essence of the entire family's ability to propagate through the fallen.

draft.flavor: A sudden, violent discharge of ionic energy that ripples through the target's very essence.
draft.name: Electrolytic Surge
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a massive elemental discharge. By utilizing the freezing atom family, it creates the necessary conditions for the payoff of the chill-punisher motif, turning a frozen state into a devastating electrolytic reaction.

draft.flavor: A relentless surge of vitality that flows through the ranks, turning every setback into a renewed momentum for the collective.
draft.name: The Unyielding Tide
draft.rationale: The action provides a multi-target support payoff by restoring health to allies, effectively 'returning' them to the fight. This creates a cycle where even when the situation is 'unfavorable' or 'severe', the group remains 'invincible' through constant replenishment. It acts as the structural payoff for affliction-based builds by ensuring the army survives long enough to let rot and blight take their course.

draft.flavor: The very air thickens with a caustic, electric haze as the target's defenses dissolve into nothingness.
draft.name: Corrosive Surge
draft.rationale: The action provides an elemental surge that amplifies the potency of afflictions, specifically enabling the rot-punisher motif by ensuring the target is sufficiently afflicted to trigger its bonus damage.

draft.flavor: A relentless momentum that consumes everything in its path, leaving only the echo of its passage.
draft.name: Unstoppable Surge
draft.rationale: The action captures the essence of an unstoppable, advancing force (所向披靡/Stampede/Surge) that moves with increasing speed (tempo-surge) and overwhelming power (elpw-surge). It represents a collective momentum that ignores the 'unfavorable' (不利) conditions of the battlefield, moving like a wave across 'continents' (七大洲) or a 'ball' (橄榄球) being propelled forward, leaving a trail of 'electrolytes' (电解质) or 'bitterness' (苦不堪言) in its wake.

draft.flavor: The sudden release of thermal tension shatters the frozen shell.
draft.name: Frostbite Thaw
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a payoff mechanism. By utilizing the synergy between freezing and the subsequent punishment of frozen targets, the family member converts their own state or presence into a burst of elemental retribution.

draft.flavor: The sprout hardens its core, preparing to strike with freezing force.
draft.name: Subspecies
draft.rationale: The action provides the necessary condition (chilling) to enable the target-specific interaction of the chill-punisher atom, fulfilling the role of an enabler for the family's defensive/offensive transition.

draft.flavor: The family moves with a rhythmic, spreading momentum, ensuring that every strike leaves a lingering trace of decay to be harvested later.
draft.name: Sprout Family Action
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the movement of the family to apply a spreading, decaying state (rotting) which serves as the necessary prerequisite for the 'Blighted Reckoning' (rot-punisher) effect.

draft.flavor: The very essence of the sprout family manifests as a spreading blight, ensuring that even in defeat, their lineage claims the soil.
draft.name: Subspecies Infestation
draft.rationale: The 'sprout' family is defined by the concept of sub-species (亚种) spreading and proliferating. By utilizing Spore Burst, the family expresses its ability to infest enemies, representing the biological expansion and diversification inherent to the family's nature.

draft.flavor: A thick, drifting haze of infectious pollen that settles upon allies, turning their very presence into a catalyst for growth and decay.
draft.name: Sprouter Spore-Cloud
draft.rationale: The action creates a lingering area of effect that applies spores to all allies within it. This fulfills the 'support' role by enabling the 'rot-punisher' payoff through the 'sporing' atom family. It uses '制造' (manufacturing) and '传播' (spreading) to create the cloud, '传染' (infecting) to apply the spores, '毒瘴' (miasma) to describe the resulting area, and '实现' (realizing/manifesting) the potential of the enabler families.

draft.flavor: The sprouter releases a cloud of infectious spores that lingers in the air, ensuring that every strike carries the weight of decay.
draft.name: Spore Propagation
draft.rationale: The action uses 'sporing' to create a localized miasma (毒瘴) that spreads (传播) and infects (传染) targets. This manufacturing (制造) of a persistent area effect ensures that the conditions required for the target to be considered 'afflicted' are realized (实现), thereby enabling the 'rot-punisher' effect.

draft.flavor: The air thickens with a heavy, sweet rot as the spores find purchase, turning the very ground into a breeding ground for the swarm.
draft.name: Sprouting Contagion
draft.rationale: The action utilizes Spore Burst to manufacture a cloud, Rotting to ensure the status takes hold, and Affliction to ensure the spread is potent. This captures the essence of a family that grows, infects, and pollutes its surroundings.

draft.flavor: A violent, rhythmic eruption of growth that catches enemies off guard.
draft.name: Sprout's Sudden Spasm
draft.rationale: The action triggers a sudden, explosive burst of spores (Spore Burst) that mimics the rapid, forceful emergence of a bamboo shoot (冬笋) or a sudden bristling of hair (炸毛). This burst acts as a reactive, aggressive response (对抗) to the presence of enemies, functioning as a mid-tier offensive payoff that scales with the target's vulnerability.

draft.flavor: A sudden, bristling chill that punishes the unwary.
draft.name: Sprout's Frost-Bite
draft.rationale: The action applies a chilling effect to the target, setting up the conditions required for the chill-punisher enabler to trigger.

draft.flavor: As the rot takes hold, the very ground erupts in a defensive surge, turning the decay of enemies into a revitalizing burst for the kin.
draft.name: Sprouting Retribution
draft.rationale: The action provides a payoff for the rot-punisher motif by triggering a burst of support when an afflicted target is struck. It captures the 'sprouting' essence through a sudden, defensive eruption (winter bamboo/sprouting) that reacts to the presence of decay (zombie/rot), turning the confrontation (resistance/defiance) into a moment of sudden, bristling growth (fright/hair-standing) that occurs at a specific juncture (time/event).

draft.flavor: A sudden, violent eruption of growth that propels the swarm forward.
draft.name: Sprout Surge
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'tempo-surge' atom to represent the rapid, explosive movement characteristic of the family. It captures the 'winter bamboo shoot' (冬笋) motif through sudden upward/forward momentum, the 'zombie' (僵尸) motif through relentless advancement, and the 'defiance/resistance' (对抗) motif by forcing a change in the battlefield's tempo. The 'bristling' (炸毛) and 'seasonal timing' (时会) motifs are expressed through the sudden, jarring nature of the movement burst.

draft.flavor: When the battlefield becomes too heavy, the family yields to the pressure, turning the very impact of their departure into a protective layer for the survivors.
draft.name: Squash Defense
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's defensive nature by consuming their own presence (消耗) and leaving the field (离场) to create a protective barrier. This act of self-sacrifice is performed with absolute certainty (自信) upon the battlefield (战场), manifesting as a physical, crushing weight (窝瓜) that grants a shield to the user upon their departure.

draft.flavor: As the fray intensifies, the fallen nourish the living, turning the cost of war into a surge of renewed vigor for the remaining host.
draft.name: Battlefield Harvest
draft.rationale: The action triggers upon the departure of a unit from the battlefield, consuming the essence of the fallen to bolster the confidence and vitality of allies. It specifically scales the potency of afflictions like rot, bloodletting, and spores, turning the battlefield into a source of replenishment for the survivors.

draft.flavor: A sudden, rhythmic surge of movement that leaves the battlefield transformed, consuming the very ground to fuel a relentless advance.
draft.name: Skittering Swarm
draft.rationale: The action triggers a movement-based surge (confidence/consumption) that scatters spores across the battlefield (battlefield/squash), creating a lingering presence even as the unit departs (exit/consumption).

draft.flavor: The air vibrates with a lingering, rhythmic pulse that strikes long after the initial impact, turning the silence into a weapon.
draft.name: Echoing Resonance
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for freezing targets, utilizing the 'Echoing' (余音) motif to ensure the impact resonates through the target, allowing the 'Listening' (倾听) aspect of the family to find the perfect moment to strike with increased power.

draft.flavor: The air vibrates with a rhythmic, haunting cadence that amplifies the potency of every affliction spreading through the fray.
draft.name: Echoing Resonance
draft.rationale: The action functions as a support mechanism that amplifies the effectiveness of existing afflictions (the payoff for rot-punisher), fulfilling the 'support' role for 'allies' by ensuring the 'multi' target field is saturated with the family's signature resonance.

draft.flavor: The air trembles with the rhythmic pulse of a dying song, marking every step with the scent of decay.
draft.name: Echoing Blight
draft.rationale: The action functions as a movement-based enabler that sets the stage for rot-punisher. It utilizes the 'Echoing' (余音/传唱) and 'Listening' (倾听) motifs to imply a rhythmic, coordinated advance (特种部队/阿尔法) that prepares the target for the subsequent rot-punisher application.

draft.flavor: The silence is broken by a rhythmic, synchronized pulse that resonates through the air, leaving a lingering vibration in the wake of the strike.
draft.name: Echoing Command
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Affliction' to represent the spreading 'song' (传唱) of the status, and 'Tempo Shift' to represent the 'Alpha' (阿尔法) rhythmic command (特种部队) that dictates the flow of battle. The 'Echo' (余音) is captured by the lingering potency of the status, and the 'Listening' (倾听) is implied by the reactive, rhythmic nature of the tempo shift.

draft.flavor: The target is struck by a rapid succession of projectiles that shatter upon contact, splintering into a cloud of shrapnel.
draft.name: Bursting Fragmentation
draft.rationale: The action describes a multi-shot 'volley' (五发/发射) of 'bullets' (子弹) that 'splits' (分裂) upon 'contact' (接触) with the enemy, functioning as a 'payoff' for freezing effects by ensuring multiple hits land.

draft.flavor: Upon contact, the shell fractures into a cloud of projectiles, scattering the impact across the target.
draft.name: Fragmented Salvo
draft.rationale: The action triggers a defensive reaction upon contact, causing the entity to split into multiple projectiles (bullets) that fire in a burst, fulfilling the family's shared motif of fragmentation and rapid discharge.

draft.flavor: Upon contact, the entity undergoes a rapid fission, discharging a volley of projectiles that fragment into a cloud of smaller bursts to saturate the surrounding area.

draft.rationale: The action describes a multi-target support burst triggered by contact. It utilizes the concept of splitting (分裂) and firing (发射) projectiles (子弹) in a volley (五发) to apply status effects to allies or targets, serving as the perfect payoff for rot-punisher by spreading the necessary afflictions.

draft.flavor: The creature erupts in a rapid sequence of projectiles that fracture upon impact.
draft.name: Bursting Volley
draft.rationale: The action describes a movement-based burst of projectiles (bullets) that split (fragment) upon contact (contact) in a rapid sequence (five-shot/volley), fulfilling the family's shared kinetic identity.

draft.flavor: A rapid-fire sequence of projectiles that fragment upon impact, saturating the target with a flurry of strikes.
draft.name: Starburst
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'volley' atom to represent the 'five-shot' (五发) and 'bullet' (子弹) motifs. The 'burst' nature of the action covers 'launch' (发射) and 'split' (分裂) through the fragmentation of the projectiles upon 'contact' (接触) with the enemy.

draft.flavor: The striker descends with a heavy blow, shattering the frozen essence of the enemy to release a burst of frost.

draft.flavor: The striker lunges forward, crushing the enemy underfoot to release a burst of life from the impact.

draft.rationale: The action describes a movement-based strike (砸击) against an enemy (敌人) that results in the release of something small and growing (娃子/小瓜), serving as the enabler for rot-punisher by applying the rotting status through the impact.

draft.flavor: The striker delivers a crushing blow that leaves a lingering mark upon the enemy, causing the small ones to swarm the target.
draft.name: 砸击娃子
draft.rationale: The action uses '砸击' (smash/strike) to trigger 'atom.marking' (marking the enemy) and 'atom.summoner' (summoning the '娃子' or small ones/minions) to fulfill the family's thematic requirement of a striker's impact.

draft.flavor: The stump remains, even as the forest falls.

It functions as a payoff for freezing effects, dealing increased damage to targets already afflicted by cold, effectively turning the battlefield into a frozen graveyard of splintered wood.

draft.flavor: The stump embeds itself deep into the earth, drawing strength from the soil to withstand the coming frost.
draft.name: Rooted Anchor
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive anchor (the stump motif) that enables the chilling effect to be more devastating by setting up the target for a frost-based retaliation.

draft.flavor: The stump anchors the forest's fury, turning the rot of the fallen into a crushing weight upon the living.
draft.name: Rooted Retribution
draft.rationale: The action provides a structural payoff for the rot-punisher motif by anchoring the target's affliction to the terrain, ensuring that the decay inflicted by the family's various toxins and blights results in increased devastation.

draft.flavor: The stump anchors the decay, ensuring the blight takes hold deep within the grain.

draft.rationale: The action allows the creature to root itself like a stump, enabling the rot-punisher effect to trigger more effectively by ensuring the target remains within the reach of the spreading decay.

draft.flavor: The target is anchored to the earth, unable to escape the inevitable decay of the forest floor.

draft.flavor: A spinning barrier of concentrated essence that accelerates the impact of frost.

draft.flavor: Through painstaking effort and the relentless acceleration of thought, the essence of the collective is spun into a crystalline clarity that empowers all nearby.
