By using 'Precision' (atom.prec-focus), the action provides a structural axis of accuracy/focus to allies, acting as a support mechanism that refines their output.

draft.flavor: Through relentless acceleration and the distillation of essence, the core truth is spun from the dross of existence.
draft.name: Centrifugal Refinement
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the concept of centrifugal force (离心机) and acceleration (加速度) to spin the target, concentrating their essence into a crystallized form of wisdom (智慧结晶) through painstaking effort (苦心孤诣). This process serves as the essential enabler for rot-punisher by ensuring the target is properly attuned to the state of affliction required for the reckoning.

draft.flavor: The relentless spin of the centrifuge, driven by the wisdom of the calculated path, accelerates the momentum of the strike.
draft.name: Centrifugal Acceleration
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'elpw-surge' atom to represent the family's shared ability to amplify their inherent elemental essence through rotational momentum (centrifuge/acceleration) and calculated effort (wisdom/toil).

draft.flavor: A sudden, jagged release of sub-zero shards that pierces through the heat of battle to freeze the very air around allies.
draft.name: Frost-Spike Burst
draft.rationale: The action represents the family's ability to launch frozen projectiles (发射, 冰块, 冰寒) that deal damage (伤害) to enemies, specifically acting as a payoff for afflicted targets via the freezing mechanic.

draft.flavor: The succulent's rigid exterior erupts, launching a flurry of frozen needles toward the target.

It represents the '仙人掌' (cactus) family through the concept of needle-like projectiles and '亚种' (subspecies) via the elemental variation of the burst.

draft.flavor: A sudden, jagged eruption of frozen needles that pierces through the warmth of life.
draft.name: Frost-Spike Volley
draft.rationale: The action captures the essence of the succulent family by utilizing a volley of ice-based projectiles (freezing/ice/launching) to deal damage, fulfilling the shared traits of the family without specifying a single species.

draft.flavor: The air grows heavy with the scent of decay as the target's frozen limbs become brittle, ready to shatter under the weight of a final, crushing blow.

draft.rationale: This action serves as the payoff for atom.chill-punisher, specifically targeting enemies already afflicted by atom.freezing. It represents the family's ability to exploit the structural weakness of frozen, necrotic flesh.

draft.flavor: The body refuses to yield, hardening even as the spirit departs.

draft.flavor: A heavy, momentum-driven movement that uses the weight of the body to crush through obstacles and absorb the impact of the world.

draft.flavor: The family captures the intensity of the sun, focusing it through a molten, crystalline lens to strike back at those who approach.

draft.flavor: The intensity of the zenith is focused through a crystalline lens, turning light into a piercing, molten streak.
draft.name: Solar Refraction
draft.rationale: The action focuses the 'sunlight' motif into a 'molten' (melting/refraction) 'bullet' (projectile) via an elemental power surge, fulfilling the family's core identity without specifying a single species or using forbidden anti-motifs.

draft.flavor: As a loyal companion, this provides a sheltering umbrella for the group, acting as a shield for those under its shade.

This provides a shield (sust-callus) that serves as the necessary prerequisite to enable the chill-punisher effect by ensuring the target remains within the reach of the symbiont's reactive defenses.

draft.flavor: When the roots take hold in wounded soil, the life force of the fallen nourishes the living.

draft.rationale: The action triggers when an ally receives damage, causing a floral growth to bloom from the impact site. This growth provides a restorative effect to all nearby allies, fulfilling the support role and connecting the motifs of plant life, damage received, and the restorative nature of a bloom.

draft.flavor: When the soil is disturbed, the garden strikes back.
draft.name: Rooted Retribution
draft.rationale: The action triggers upon receiving damage (受到), causing the target to suffer from a spreading decay (rotting/植物) while reflecting a portion of that harm (retribution/伤害) back at the source, embodying the cycle of a garden's defense (花盆/本格).

draft.flavor: The target is ensnared by frost-rimed brambles, making them vulnerable to the crushing weight of the cold.
draft.name: Frost-Blighted Thorns
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a reaction against an enemy. By utilizing the 'freezing' enabler to apply a status, it sets up the 'chill-punisher' payoff, fulfilling the requirement of a mid-tier attack/utility hybrid that defines the family's interaction with the environment.

draft.flavor: The air thickens with a fine, drifting dust that settles into the lungs and pores of the enemy, blooming from within.

draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'sporing' and 'blighting' atoms to represent the core biological mechanism of the plant family: the dispersal of infectious, decaying matter that weakens the target from the inside out.

draft.flavor: The target is overtaken by a sudden, aggressive surge of life, drawing strength from the very nutrients it once held.

draft.rationale: The action represents the family's ability to use biological proliferation (spores/growth) to drain or transform the enemy's essence (withering/nourishing) into a weaponized state.

draft.flavor: As the family moves, they weave a tapestry of life through the soil, turning every step into a source of sustenance for the rot to follow.

draft.flavor: The target is overtaken by a relentless, nourishing bloom that feeds the soil while draining the life from the foe.

draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'sporing' to represent the botanical spread (植物) and 'mending' to represent the nourishing aspect (滋养) of the symbiotic relationship, applied to an enemy to reflect the status-based nature of the request.

draft.flavor: The tactician orchestrates a freezing lockdown, ensuring that those caught in the chill are held fast for the inevitable harvest.

draft.flavor: The tide of the fallen moves with a singular, terrifying purpose, closing the distance to claim what remains.

draft.flavor: A suspended, hardened seed that pulses with a protective aura, hardening its shell to absorb the impact of the world.

draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive shield regeneration boost (atom.shld-cycle) which serves as a mid-tier enabler for the target's vulnerability to frost-based punishment by maintaining the technocrat's operational integrity while setting up the thermal conditions required for the chill-punisher synergy.

draft.flavor: A precise, systematic application of rot, executed with the cold efficiency of a master's design.

draft.flavor: The subject executes a calculated sequence of adjustments, imposing a rigid, systemic order upon the chaos of the battlefield.
draft.name: Technocrat Protocol
draft.rationale: The technocrat family is defined by the imposition of systemic, calculated order and the manipulation of fundamental variables. By utilizing 'Foregone Verdict', the family expresses their core identity: the ability to override natural variance and force a target into a predetermined, mathematically certain state, reflecting the cold, calculated nature of their hierarchy.

draft.flavor: A rhythmic, manufactured cadence of defense that echoes with the weight of a thousand footsteps.
draft.name: Standardized Phalanx
draft.rationale: The action creates a manufactured, standardized defensive formation (制式/制造) that mimics the presence of multiple defenders (分身) through a rhythmic, earth-shaking impact (震天撼地/埃德加) to reinforce the user's structural integrity.

draft.flavor: A synchronized surge of manufactured spores that echoes through the ranks, amplifying the rot within allies and enemies alike.
draft.name: Manufactured Blight-Echo
draft.rationale: The action utilizes '制造' (Manufactured) and '制式' (Standardized/Patterned) through the deployment of 'atom.sporing' and 'atom.withering' to create a '分身' (Duplicate/Echo) effect of the affliction. The '震天撼地' (Earth-shaking) aspect is represented by the multi-target area shape, and '埃德加' (Edgar/Legacy) is reflected in the structural payoff for the 'rot-punisher' lineage.

draft.flavor: The very essence of the family manifests as a synchronized, structural resonance, replicating their presence through a systematic and earth-shaking imposition of their will.
draft.name: Manufactured Echoes of the Great Design
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'summoner' to represent the '分身' (clones/splitting) motif, 'arm-op' to represent '制造' (manufacturing) and '制式' (standardized/patterned), 'prec-sync' to represent the '制式' (systematic/patterned) nature of their coordination, and 'tempo-pulse' to capture the '震天撼地' (earth-shaking/rhythmic) aspect of their collective presence. This creates a status effect that manifests their structural, manufactured essence across the battlefield.

draft.flavor: The frozen remains of the fallen strike back with a numbing chill, punishing those who dare to disturb their slumber.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: The action targets the enemy with a freezing effect that sets up a massive damage payoff against frozen targets, embodying the relentless and punishing nature of the family's undead essence.

draft.flavor: The horde moves with a singular, rhythmic hunger, closing the distance with terrifying inevitability.
draft.name: Relentless Advance
draft.rationale: The action focuses on the 'movement' category and the 'zombie' motif by accelerating the advance of the horde. By utilizing tempo-based atoms, it enables the 'rot-punisher' motif by ensuring targets are caught within the reach of the family's afflictions through increased movement speed.

draft.flavor: The ground heaves as the restless dead surge forward in a coordinated, mindless tide.
draft.name: Undead Surge
draft.rationale: The family of the undead is defined by their relentless, rhythmic advance. This action applies a status that accelerates their movement toward the enemy, capturing the collective momentum inherent to the entire family's nature.

draft.flavor: The starch within swells with volatile pressure until the very skin can no longer contain the force, resulting in a violent, earth-shaking rupture.
draft.name: Tuberous Detonation
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'deathblast' atom to represent the '爆炸' (explosion) motif, triggered upon the destruction of the 'tuber' (土豆) family member, fulfilling the requirement of a shared payoff/death-triggered mechanic for the entire family.

draft.flavor: When struck, the tuberous body undergoes a rapid, pressurized expansion, detonating its internal starch to create a localized shockwave.
draft.name: Tuberous Detonation
draft.rationale: The action describes a defensive reaction (triggered upon being struck or dying) where the creature's core (tuber/potato) undergoes a violent expansion (explosion). This fits the 'deathblast' atom as it provides a burst of damage upon the creature's destruction, serving as a mid-tier defensive enabler for frost-based retaliation.

draft.flavor: The ground trembles as the starch-heavy mass undergoes a violent, pressurized expansion, rupturing the soil to release a concussive burst of earth and energy.
draft.name: Tuberous Detonation
draft.rationale: The action describes a movement-based 'rolledTarget' burst (explosion) originating from a tuberous mass (potato/starch) that serves as an enabler for 'rotting' status effects, which in turn triggers 'rot-punisher' bonuses.

draft.flavor: The starch-heavy core of the family swells with volatile energy, erupting upon impact to scatter fragments of itself.
draft.name: Tuberous Detonation
draft.rationale: The 'tuber' family is characterized by their explosive, starch-like nature. By utilizing 'dooming', the action captures the essence of a sudden, catastrophic burst (爆炸) triggered by the creature's core (土豆) upon death, fulfilling the status/enemy/mid-tier requirements without specifying a single species.

draft.flavor: The tuber absorbs the zenith's radiance, swelling with volatile energy until it erupts in a thunderous, sun-scorched burst.
draft.name: Solar Flare Detonation
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a massive explosion (爆炸) fueled by solar energy (阳光) and lightning (雷). By utilizing the enabler family (freezing) and the payoff family (chill-punisher), the action creates a temporal (时) window where frozen enemies are struck by the explosive discharge, maximizing the synergy between the cold and the burst.

draft.flavor: A sudden surge of electrical energy erupts from the soil, detonating the rot within allies to revitalize their essence.
draft.name: Thunderous Harvest
draft.rationale: The action provides a payoff for rot-punisher by utilizing an elemental overflow to trigger a multi-target burst. It captures the 'tuber' essence through the concept of a subterranean harvest that explodes with solar and electrical energy, synchronizing the timing of the burst to support the army.

draft.flavor: A sudden, crackling discharge of energy that ruptures the skin of the earth, releasing a cloud of electrified spores.
draft.name: Thunderous Spore Burst
draft.rationale: The action describes a sudden burst (爆炸) of energy (雷) that occurs in a rhythmic pulse (时) to release spores (sporing) that thrive in the light (阳光) from the soil (土豆). It acts as an enabler for rot-punisher by ensuring targets are afflicted with spores, which then triggers the bonus damage from the rot-punisher atom.

draft.flavor: A sudden discharge of energy that erupts from the earth, leaving the ground scorched and the air heavy with static.
draft.name: Thunderous Harvest
draft.rationale: The action triggers a timed explosion (爆炸, 时) that draws upon solar energy (阳光) to release a burst of lightning (雷) from the soil (土豆/earth). It utilizes 'Dooming' to represent the explosive death-trigger, 'Elemental Attunement' to manifest the lightning, and 'Sunbloom' to tie the energy to the solar motif.

draft.flavor: The cold does not merely bite; it remembers the warmth it has stolen.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a conditional payoff. When the user is struck by an enemy, the frost within them lashes out, dealing bonus damage specifically to targets already afflicted by freezing effects.

draft.flavor: The air grows heavy and brittle around the creature, turning every impact into a shattering of frozen essence.
draft.name: Frostbound Resonance
draft.rationale: The action provides the necessary condition (freezing) to enable the specific enabler atom (chill-punisher) for the family.

draft.flavor: The presence of decay within the ranks amplifies the potency of every spreading contagion, turning a single wound into a systemic collapse.
draft.name: Blighted Resonance
draft.rationale: This action serves as the structural payoff for atom.rot-punisher. By linking the potency of existing affliction-based families (bloodletting, sporing, venomous, withering) to the damage dealt to afflicted targets, it creates a synergistic loop where the more a target is corrupted, the more devastating the rot becomes.

draft.flavor: The air thickens with a fine, drifting haze as the creature shifts its weight, shedding a cloud of infectious particles with every movement.
draft.name: Spore Drift
draft.rationale: The action provides movement that facilitates the application of blight, acting as the necessary enabler for rot-punisher to scale its damage against afflicted targets.

draft.flavor: The very presence of the swarm leaves a lingering corruption upon the foe, ensuring that every subsequent wound strikes deeper into their essence.
draft.name: Blighted Mark
draft.rationale: The action applies a status that increases the potency of all subsequent status effects applied to the target, fulfilling the 'status' category and 'enemy' relation while utilizing the 'marking' and 'affliction' atom families to define the family's shared mechanic of escalating debuffs.

draft.flavor: The very air around the fallen turns brittle and sharp, shattering against those who dare approach.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: This action targets the self to trigger a retaliatory effect. When the creature is struck, it releases a burst of freezing energy that punishes enemies who have been chilled, embodying the inevitable and cold nature of the undead family.

draft.flavor: The air around the fallen grows heavy and frigid, slowing the pulse of the living.
draft.name: Stagnant Chill
draft.rationale: The action applies a chilling effect to the target, which serves as the necessary enabler for the atom.chill-punisher family to trigger its bonus damage. This represents the pervasive, numbing aura shared by the undead family.

draft.flavor: The stench of decay ripples outward, amplifying the corruption within the ranks.
draft.name: Blighted Resonance
draft.rationale: As a support action for the undead, this action amplifies the effectiveness of existing rot/blight effects on allies, turning their decay into a shared strength. It functions as a payoff for the 'rot-punisher' atom by ensuring that once a target is afflicted by the family's signature decay, the damage or status potency is amplified across the battlefield.

draft.flavor: The relentless, shuffling momentum of the restless dead.
draft.name: Putrid Advance
draft.rationale: The action provides a movement-based enabler that facilitates the application of rot, fitting the 'undead' family motif of relentless, decaying progression without specifying a single species or using forbidden anti-motifs.

draft.flavor: The very air around the fallen grows heavy and stagnant, carrying the scent of decay to those who linger too close.
draft.name: Blighted Presence
draft.rationale: The action applies a status of decay (rotting/withering) to enemies, representing the pervasive, infectious nature of the undead family without specifying a single species or using forbidden motifs.

draft.flavor: The target is overtaken by a sudden, violent blooming of internal essence, exposing their core to the world.
draft.name: Rooted Revelation
draft.rationale: The action targets the self to trigger a burst of spores (植物) that carries a surge of elemental power (情報/信息), effectively stripping away defenses to reveal the target's vulnerability (揭晓).

draft.flavor: The forest reveals its secrets through a sudden, frost-touched blooming, turning the very air into a chilling testament of growth.
draft.name: Verdant Revelation
draft.rationale: The action uses 'sporing' (植物) to deliver the mechanism. The 'revelation' (揭晓) and 'information' (信息) motifs are expressed through the act of exposing a target's vulnerability to the frost-punishment cycle, acting as the necessary enabler for the chill-punisher pairing by ensuring the target is sufficiently infested to trigger the elemental reaction.

draft.flavor: The forest exhales a cloud of spores that reveals the structural weaknesses of all nearby foes, nourishing the soil as they falter.
draft.name: Verdant Revelation
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'sporing' to fulfill the '植物' (plant) motif. The act of releasing spores serves as the '揭晓' (reveal) mechanism, providing '信息' (information) by marking targets for the 'rot-punisher' payoff. It functions as a support/utility action that enables the specific enabler families mentioned.

draft.flavor: The air thickens with a heavy, drifting haze of spores that carry the weight of ancient, decaying secrets.
draft.name: Spore-Drift Dissemination
draft.rationale: The action uses movement to spread spores (植物) across the area, which reveals (揭晓) the hidden vulnerabilities of targets by imbuing them with data (信息) that amplifies the potency of rot-based afflictions.

draft.flavor: The target's essence is laid bare, blooming into a visible pattern of vulnerability.
draft.name: Verdant Revelation
draft.rationale: The action reveals (揭晓) the target's internal patterns (信息) by causing them to sprout invasive growths (植物), marking them for the family's benefit.

draft.flavor: The sudden cessation of motion leaves a trail of frost that shatters upon contact.
draft.name: Glacial Impact
draft.rationale: The action functions as a payoff for frozen targets, utilizing the momentum of a 'driving' force that 'exits' the target's defenses to deliver a crushing blow. It represents the collective momentum of the family, turning a frozen state into a devastating impact.

draft.flavor: The air grows heavy and stagnant as the unit anchors itself, freezing the very momentum of the battlefield to ensure the coming frost finds its mark.
draft.name: Glacial Lockdown
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive anchor that applies a chill effect, acting as the necessary enabler for the chill-punisher atom by ensuring targets are frozen for the subsequent offensive payoff.

draft.flavor: The engine roars and the passengers never depart, driving through the rot to ensure the journey never ends.
draft.name: The Unending Drive
draft.rationale: The action provides a continuous restorative flow to allies (mending) that scales with the momentum of the unit, ensuring the 'drive' (驾驶证/冰车) continues 'without end' (不止) for the 'undead' (僵尸) who 'never disembark' (下车).

draft.flavor: The momentum of the horde becomes a crushing weight, leaving nothing but ruin in its wake.
draft.name: Unstoppable Advance
draft.rationale: The action facilitates the 'Unstoppable Advance' (不止) by accelerating the movement of the 'Horde' (僵尸) through the area, effectively 'driving' (驾驶证) through obstacles to ensure the target remains vulnerable to the rot-punisher's effects.

draft.flavor: The momentum of the horde is an unstoppable force, driving forward through every obstacle.
draft.name: Relentless Pursuit
draft.rationale: The family's shared identity is defined by an unstoppable, advancing momentum (不止). By utilizing tempo-based mechanics, the entire unit gains a collective increase in their advance speed, representing the collective drive of the group rather than an individual's strength.

draft.flavor: The fallen rise to reclaim their former glory, channeling the essence of their previous works to bolster the current horde.
draft.name: Reanimated Legacy
draft.rationale: The action allows the user to manifest a remnant of their past work (a previous iteration or 'work' of the entity) to summon a new member of the family (a zombie/undead variant) to the field, facilitating the spread of the horde.

draft.flavor: The essence of the progenitor's work manifests, ensuring that even in death, the lineage remains a formidable barrier against the living.
draft.name: Legacy of the Undead
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the concept of 'Hardened Husk' and 'Calcified Hide' to represent the defensive resilience of the family. It draws from the 'work' (作品) of the 'progenitor' (前作) to ensure the 'zombie' (僵尸) 'king' (僵王) is 'convenient' (便于) for the defender by providing a persistent layer of protection.

draft.flavor: The horde moves with a singular, inevitable momentum, driven by the weight of those who fell before.
draft.name: Relentless Advance
draft.rationale: This movement action captures the essence of a relentless, advancing horde (the family) by increasing their collective speed and pressure. It serves as a perfect enabler for rot-punisher by ensuring targets are constantly being engaged and pressured by the advancing mass.

draft.flavor: The weight of the frost-laden core collapses upon the frozen, shattering them into a thousand icy shards.
draft.name: Frost Harvest
draft.rationale: This action functions as a payoff for freezing targets. It utilizes the strength of the family to deal massive damage specifically to those already afflicted by the chill, fulfilling the requirement of being a payoff for atom.chill-punisher while being enabled by atom.freezing.

draft.flavor: A thick, chilled layer of rind that hardens upon impact, numbing the very air around the defender.
draft.name: Frosting Shell
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive layer that applies a freezing status to attackers, which serves as the necessary enabler for the 'Frost Reckoning' (atom.chill-punisher) motif by ensuring targets are frozen.

draft.flavor: The roots of the family entwine beneath the soil, pulsing with a shared vitality that nourishes all who stand together.
draft.name: Subterranean Sprout
draft.rationale: As a support family, the action focuses on the collective strength and restorative essence shared by the group. By utilizing atom.mending, the action provides a restorative burst to allies, embodying the nourishing and regenerative nature of the vegetable family's shared life force.

draft.flavor: The creature erupts in a cloud of infectious dust, ensuring that those who survive the impact are marked for decay.
draft.name: Spore Burst
draft.rationale: The action uses Spore Burst to apply an affliction, which serves as the necessary enabler for the Rot Punisher motif. This represents the biological spread characteristic of the family.

draft.flavor: The very essence of the garden turns frigid, turning frozen foes into brittle sustenance.
draft.name: Frost-Bitten Thorns
draft.rationale: This action represents the core biological mechanism of the vegetation family: the ability to convert environmental temperature shifts into offensive force. By utilizing the freezing process as a catalyst, the family exploits the structural vulnerability of frozen targets, turning a defensive state into a source of devastating impact.

draft.flavor: A dense, frozen thicket of thorns that thrives on the cold, waiting to shatter those who dare strike it.
draft.name: Frost-Blighted Thicket
draft.rationale: The action provides a defensive reaction where being struck triggers a frost-based retaliation. This fulfills the 'defense' category and 'self' relation. It enables 'atom.chill-punisher' by applying the necessary frost status. The motifs are expressed through the concept of a biological reactor (reaction furnace) of growth that distinguishes between the attacker and the defender via elemental status application.

draft.flavor: The collective vitality of the grove erupts, channeling the sun's raw energy through every vein and stem to bolster the strength of the forest.
draft.name: Photosynthetic Surge
draft.rationale: As a support action for the vegetation family, this action provides a burst of vitality to allies. It utilizes the 'life-surge' atom to represent the shared biological essence of the family, fulfilling the 'strength' (力量) and 'plant' (植物) motifs through a restorative surge of growth.

draft.flavor: The target is overtaken by a sudden, violent surge of life, their very essence becoming a vessel for the forest's expansion.
draft.name: Overgrowth
draft.rationale: The action targets an enemy to inflict a status that represents the overwhelming power of vegetation. By utilizing spores, blight, and withering, the action captures the essence of a family that spreads through infestation and decay, distinguishing the living from the inanimate through the spread of organic matter.

draft.flavor: The ground becomes a treacherous expanse of slick, unyielding frost, turning every movement into a struggle for stability.
draft.name: Glacial Surface
draft.rationale: The action creates a frozen terrain (ice path/ice surface) that applies a chilling effect to targets, setting up the conditions required for Frost Reckoning to deal bonus damage.

draft.flavor: A sweeping motion across the frozen expanse, leaving a trail of frost in its wake.
draft.name: Glacial Drift
draft.rationale: The action describes a movement across a frozen surface (ice path, ice surface, flat ground) that facilitates the spread of rot by ensuring the target is afflicted, thereby enabling the rot-punisher synergy.

draft.flavor: The relentless advance across the frozen expanse, where every step echoes with the weight of the master's will.
draft.name: Glacial Momentum
draft.rationale: The action captures the essence of a family that thrives on movement across frozen surfaces (ice/path/flat ground) and the momentum of their advance (zombie/master/enthusiast/start/swan/buy), utilizing the 'chilling' effect to represent the frozen state and 'tempo-surge' to represent the accelerating advance characteristic of the family's movement.

draft.flavor: When the structural integrity reaches a critical threshold, the vessel initiates a high-velocity evasive maneuver, leaving a trail of frost in its wake to mitigate the impact of the coming collision.
draft.name: Emergency Flight Protocol
draft.rationale: The action functions as a 'remedy' (补救措施) for 'serious' (严重) damage by utilizing 'flight' (飞行器) to reposition. It 'entrusts' (托付给) the survival of the unit to a high-speed 'excellent' (优秀) burst of elemental energy, specifically acting as the 'payoff' for freezing effects.

draft.flavor: When the structural integrity of the formation is compromised, the fleet deploys a corrective surge to stabilize the frontline and ensure the mission's continuity.
draft.name: Emergency Remediation Protocol
draft.rationale: The action addresses a 'serious' (严重) breach by providing 'remedial measures' (补救措施). It 'entrusts' (托付给) the survival of the unit to the 'excellent' (优秀) restorative properties of the 'vessel' (飞行器) through a multi-target healing burst that scales with the severity of the damage taken by allies.

draft.flavor: When the structural integrity of the craft is compromised, the pilot initiates a high-risk corrective maneuver, sacrificing stability for a sudden burst of momentum to rectify the situation.
draft.name: Emergency Overdrive
draft.rationale: The action represents a high-stakes corrective maneuver (补救措施) performed by a vehicle (飞行器) to address a critical failure (严重). This maneuver is an excellent (优秀) tactical choice that entrusts (托付给) the survival of the unit to a sudden surge of power, specifically enabling the effectiveness of rot-based damage (atom.rot-punisher) through the momentum of the movement.

draft.flavor: When the flight path is compromised, the vessel executes a high-velocity descent to stabilize the situation through immediate intervention.
draft.name: Emergency Aerial Deployment
draft.rationale: The action describes a high-stakes aerial maneuver (飞行器) triggered by a critical failure (严重). The deployment serves as a rapid corrective measure (补救措施) that entrusts the survival of the unit to a sudden surge of restorative energy (托付给) through an optimized, high-tier restorative effect (优秀).

draft.flavor: A dense, suffocating mesh of vines that ensnares the unwary, turning the battlefield into a frozen trap of tangled limbs.
draft.name: Entangling Thicket
draft.rationale: The action creates a defensive thicket of vines (缠绕/水草) that deals damage (伤害) to enemies, serving as a setup for the chill-punisher enabler by ensuring targets remain trapped and vulnerable.

draft.flavor: The vines lash out, binding allies and foes alike in a suffocating embrace of life.
draft.name: Entangling Overgrowth
draft.rationale: The action uses 'entangling' (缠绕) to create a multi-target support effect. It treats allies as 'good partners' (好搭档) by providing utility, and uses 'seaweed' (水草) imagery to describe the spreading, restrictive nature of the vines.

draft.flavor: The family surges forward, weaving a dense thicket of projectiles that ensnare and shred everything in their path.
draft.name: Entangling Volley
draft.rationale: The action uses 'entangle' (缠绕) and 'volley' (发射/子弹) to create a movement-based area effect that applies 'damage' (伤害) to targets, serving as the perfect enabler for 'rot-punisher' by ensuring targets are afflicted and grouped.

draft.flavor: A sudden eruption of grasping vines that constricts the enemy, slowing their movements and leaving them vulnerable to the swarm.
draft.name: Entangling Thicket
draft.rationale: The action uses the 'entangle' atom to represent the family's core ability to bind enemies. It increases the damage taken by the target (提高/伤害) through the constriction of the vines (缠绕), fulfilling the status category requirement for the entire family.

draft.flavor: A defensive formation where the scarcity of resources is met by a torrential outpouring of protection, turning the very lack of sustenance into a rigid, unyielding tribunal of steel.
draft.name: Trident of the Unmet Supply
draft.rationale: The action utilizes Shield Surge to represent the 'torrential outpouring' (倾泻) of protection, Sustained Husk to provide a continuous 'supply' (供应) of shields to mitigate 'scarcity' (不足), and Armour Reinforcement to create the 'rigid tribunal' (军事法庭) of the 'trident' (三叉戟) formation.

draft.flavor: A systematic depletion that leaves only the verdict of the void.
draft.name: The Triad of Scarcity
draft.rationale: The action functions as a three-pronged (三叉戟) depletion of the enemy's resources (不足/供应). It imposes a final judgment (军事法庭) by overwhelming the target with a sudden outpouring (倾泻) of status potency and elemental power.

draft.flavor: The warrior enters the fray with predatory intent, their very presence reinforcing the front line as they strike with overwhelming force.
draft.name: Unyielding Onslaught
draft.rationale: This action captures the essence of a warrior family by combining offensive power (Might/Ferocity) with the defensive necessity of a front-line combatant (Armour/Plating/Hardening). It represents the transition from a state of readiness to an active, unified assault.

draft.flavor: The unit surges forward, their collective presence hardening their resolve and preparing a devastating strike against those already weakened.
draft.name: Phalanx Advance
draft.rationale: The action facilitates a movement-based surge (入阵/前排) that increases the unit's physical presence and defensive cohesion (一体/佩戴), providing the necessary survivability and strength (力量/利爪) to act as a frontline enabler for rot-based retaliation.

draft.flavor: A sudden, freezing surge of energy that punishes those caught in the cold.
draft.name: Frostbite Reckoning
draft.rationale: The action targets the enemy to provide a payoff for chilling effects. It captures the essence of a cold, laboratory-born charge that punishes frozen targets.

draft.flavor: A cold, clinical preservation of the essence, ensuring the subject remains frozen for further study.
draft.name: Laboratory Frost-Graft
draft.rationale: The action applies a chilling effect to the target, serving as the necessary enabler for the frost-punishment cycle while embodying the cold, experimental nature of the family's shared motifs.

draft.flavor: The cold precision of the laboratory meets the relentless surge of the grave, turning every strike into a catalyst for systemic decay.
draft.name: Experimental Necrosis
draft.rationale: This action functions as a multi-target support mechanism that amplifies the effectiveness of existing afflictions. By synchronizing with the family's tendency toward biological and chemical decay, it ensures that once a target is marked by rot, venom, or spores, the subsequent surge of necrotic energy maximizes the impact of those specific ailments.

draft.flavor: A cold, systematic surge that pushes the horde forward with unyielding momentum.
draft.name: Relentless Advance
draft.rationale: The action captures the 'Charge' (冲锋) and 'Zombie' (僵尸) motifs through a surge in movement speed, while the 'Cold' (冷酷) and 'Laboratory' (实验室) themes are reflected in the mechanical, systematic nature of the tempo increase, representing a controlled, unstoppable advance.

draft.flavor: The air thickens with an unyielding, mindless intent that refuses to be disturbed.
draft.name: Stagnant Focus
draft.rationale: The action utilizes 'Precision' (atom.prec-focus) to represent the '专注' (Focus) and '博学' (Knowledge/Scholarship) motifs through a fixed, unerring accuracy. The '僵尸' (Zombie/Undead) and '请勿打扰' (Do Not Disturb) motifs are expressed through the 'status' nature of the effect, creating a state of mindless, unstoppable momentum that ignores external interference, while the '危险' (Danger) is inherent in the target's inability to evade the focused strike.

draft.flavor: The target's physical integrity is systematically dismantled through a calculated sequence of structural failures.
draft.name: Kinetic Dissolution
draft.rationale: The action targets the enemy to reduce their structural stability (削减) through a calculated application of physical forces (物理学), treating the destruction of the target like a final, perfected execution of a design (毕业设计). The process of decay (僵尸) is met with a sense of inevitable, rhythmic satisfaction (享受).

draft.flavor: A calculated reduction of vitality, applying the laws of decay to ensure the inevitable conclusion of the experiment.
draft.name: The Final Thesis
draft.rationale: The action functions as a structural payoff for afflicted targets. It applies a mathematical reduction to the target's remaining essence, turning the process of decay into a structured, inevitable conclusion—much like a final thesis or a controlled experiment in physics. It rewards the presence of rot, spores, or venom by accelerating the 'graduation' of the target from life into the state of the undead.

draft.flavor: A systematic reduction of the target's structural integrity, stripping away their defenses to reveal the core essence beneath.
draft.name: The Final Thesis
draft.rationale: The action represents a 'final thesis' or 'graduation project' (毕业设计) through the lens of 'physics' (物理学), applying a 'reduction' (削减) of the enemy's status. It utilizes 'withering' (withering) to represent the decay of a 'zombie' (僵尸) and 'shield breach' (shld-breach) to represent the systematic dismantling of a subject, turning the combat into a process of 'enjoyment' (享受) for the user through the efficient removal of the target's layers.

draft.flavor: A sudden, artificial reconfiguration of the battlefield where the target is carved away from reality, leaving only a hollowed shape where they once stood.
draft.name: The Sculpted Severance
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the 'freezing' enabler to set up the 'chill-punisher' payoff. It embodies the 'wraith' family through the motifs of artificiality (人造), the sharp edge of a blade (利刃), the shaping of a void (塑造), the sudden departure (再见), and the unknowable nature of their passing (不知).

draft.flavor: The phantom edge carves a silhouette of what was, leaving only a hollow void where the strike should have landed.
draft.name: Unknowing Shape of the Blade
draft.rationale: The action uses ward-flux to create a defensive, arcane barrier that 'shapes' the space around the user. It embodies 'the blade' (利刃) through its cutting nature, 'goodbye' (再见) by erasing the incoming threat, and 'unknown' (不知) by obscuring the user's true form, effectively 'shaping' (塑造) the battlefield's defensive geometry.

draft.flavor: The air curdles as the boundary between existence and void thins, leaving only the echo of what was once whole.
draft.name: Unmaking Presence
draft.rationale: The action shapes the battlefield by imposing a state of unknown decay upon allies, effectively 're-making' their essence into a vessel for the rot to follow. It acts as a catalyst that prepares the target for the subsequent payoff of Blighted Reckoning.

draft.flavor: The unknown edge of a forged destiny.
draft.name: Manufactured Fate
draft.rationale: The action uses 'Foregone Verdict' to represent the 'shaping' (塑造) of an 'artificial' (人造) outcome. It targets an enemy to deliver a 'sharp blade' (利刃) of 'unknown' (不知) consequence, effectively saying 'goodbye' (再见) to their current state by forcing a fixed critical rate that ignores all other variables.

draft.flavor: The very chill of the grave turns against those who dare disturb the slumber.
draft.name: Frostbite Retribution
draft.rationale: The action targets the enemy to reward the user for having the 'freezing' enabler, specifically scaling damage when the target is already frozen, fulfilling the 'payoff' role for the 'chill-punisher' atom.

draft.flavor: The very air around the fallen turns brittle and cold, freezing the blood of those who dare approach.
draft.name: Frostbite
draft.rationale: The action applies a freezing effect to the target, which serves as the necessary enabler for the 'chill-punisher' atom family. It represents the shared essence of the family by inflicting a state of coldness upon contact.

draft.flavor: The stench of decay ripples outward, amplifying the corruption within the afflicted.
draft.name: Rotting Resonance
draft.rationale: As a support action for the zombie family, this action amplifies the effectiveness of existing decay-based statuses (rot, blight, venom, wither) on allies' targets, serving as the payoff for the rot-punisher atom family.

draft.flavor: The relentless, shuffling momentum of the undead, leaving a trail of decay in their wake.
draft.name: Rotting Advance
draft.rationale: This action combines the family's characteristic relentless movement (tempo-surge) with their inherent decaying nature (rotting). By increasing the speed of the zombie advance while simultaneously applying rot to those they encounter, it creates the perfect setup for the 'rot-punisher' enabler, as targets will be afflicted by rot while the horde closes the distance.

draft.flavor: The fallen do not rest; they rise to serve the hunger.
draft.name: Reanimate
draft.rationale: The action expresses the core essence of the zombie family—the ability to rise again or bring others into the fold—without specifying a single species or using forbidden motifs.

draft.flavor: The target is forced into a synchronized, frantic dance, their movements dictated by a flashing, erratic cadence that leaves them vulnerable to the coming frost.
draft.name: Rhythmic Signal
draft.rationale: The action uses 'Tempo Shift' (atom.tempo-pulse) to create a rhythmic, signal-like pattern (信号灯) that forces the enemy into a 'dance' (伴舞) with the user. This rhythmic synchronization (different/不同 rhythms) eventually (久而久之) overwhelms the target, setting up the payoff for freezing effects.

draft.flavor: As the rhythm of the dance aligns, the signal flashes, marking the moment for the frost to take hold.
draft.name: Synchronized Signal
draft.rationale: The action creates a rhythmic, synchronized state (伴舞, 信号灯) that allows different members (不同) of the group to act in unison (人们) with excellence (优秀) over time (久而久之), setting the stage for the chill-punisher effect to trigger.

draft.flavor: As the rhythm shifts, the group moves in a different cadence, flashing a signal that turns the crowd into a dance of decay.
draft.name: Synchronized Signal
draft.rationale: The action creates a rhythmic, signal-based pulse that synchronizes allies to a different tempo, enhancing the effectiveness of rot-based afflictions through a coordinated, dance-like movement that rewards the group over time.

draft.flavor: As the signal changes, the crowd moves in a rhythmic, unsettling unison, their different motions weaving a pattern of inevitable rot.
draft.name: Synchronized Decay
draft.rationale: The action describes a movement-based synchronization (伴舞/人们) where individual variations (不同) follow a rhythmic pattern (信号灯/优秀) that leads to a cumulative, inevitable state (久而久之), specifically designed to enable the potency of rot-based effects.

draft.flavor: As the rhythm of the horde shifts, the signals change, marking the different movements of the dance that people will witness until the end.
draft.name: Synchronized Signal
draft.rationale: The action uses 'Tempo Shift' to represent the 'different' (不同) rhythms and 'signals' (信号灯) of the family. The 'dance' (伴舞) is expressed through the rhythmic pulse, and the 'people' (人们) are the observers of this 'excellent' (优秀) display that persists 'over time' (久而久之).
